Please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or resumes from external recruiters or staffing agencies.

Location: Remote (must be located in MST/PST time zone)

Background Check Requirement

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Frontline Wildfire Defense is the fastest-growing company in the wildfire protection industry, serving as the premier manufacturer and installer of exterior wildfire defense systems for residential and commercial structures. Operating across 12 Western states, our organization is dedicated to safeguarding residential properties, commercial sites, communities, and critical infrastructure from the destructive impact of wildfires.

As wildfires rapidly intensify across the West, they threaten communities and destabilize property insurance markets—creating a vital need and a powerful market opportunity for proven structural defense solutions. Beyond our core technology, Frontline is strategically positioning itself to capture high-growth adjacent opportunities, including strategic insurance partnerships and municipal fire service integration.

Our proprietary defense platform integrates real-time wildfire tracking and data fusion with an advanced hydration system designed to increase moisture levels on and surrounding structures to prevent ignition. The efficacy of this technology is well-documented: during the 2025 Los Angeles fire events, Frontline successfully defended 59 of 61 equipped properties, representing a 96% success rate. This performance has earned notable industry honors, including recognition as one of TIME Magazine’s Best Inventions, the National Association of Homebuilders IBS Best Home Technology of 2025, and recognition in Inc. Magazine’s ranking of the fastest-growing enterprises in the Pacific Region.

Frontline was founded by Harry Statter and is headquartered in Jackson Hole, Wyoming. The company is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. Frontline maintains a modern, flexible corporate culture supported by a predominantly distributed workforce. We welcome inquiries from qualified professionals seeking to contribute to a high-growth enterprise dedicated to preserving lives and property.

About This Opportunity

Frontline is seeking a strategic, operationally minded Chief Financial Officer to lead our finance function and help drive the company’s next phase of growth. Frontline is scaling quickly, and wildfire risk is reshaping the availability and affordability of property insurance across the West. This creates a large market for effective structure defense, along with strategic opportunities in the insurance sector, recurring-revenue services, and fire department and public-sector partnerships.

As a member of the executive team, you will partner closely with the CEO, COO, leadership team, and Board to turn strategic priorities into clear plans and measurable results. You will bring financial rigor, operational discipline, and a commercial mindset to company-wide decisions, and you will help identify, evaluate, and execute new growth opportunities, including strategic insurance partnerships and financial offerings.

This role reports directly to the CEO and leads the existing finance organization, as well as Frontline’s legal function.

We’re looking for a finance leader who has helped a company through this kind of growth before, and who can build the foundation for our next stage, including a potential IPO and/or other strategic growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership & Planning

  • Lead financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, cash management, and reporting.
  • Give the CEO, COO, and leadership team clear analysis of business performance, risks, investment needs, and the financial impact of key decisions.
  • Establish financial models, performance KPIs, and cross-functional processes that support disciplined growth.
  • Develop the processes, systems, and leadership capacity needed to support growth while keeping the organization practical and focused.

Strategy, Growth & Corporate Development

  • Partner with the CEO, COO, and leadership team to identify, evaluate, and prioritize strategic growth opportunities.
  • Help sequence strategic initiatives, set the operating plan for each, connect them to commercial and operating plans, and hold teams accountable to outcomes and ROI.
  • Develop the economics, value proposition, and execution plan for new initiatives such as strategic insurance opportunities and other expansion areas.
  • Lead corporate development, including partnerships, M&A screening, and strategic investments.
  • Support insurance and mortgage-market partnerships, including conversations with insurance carriers.
  • Support recurring-revenue strategy, including pricing, packaging, service contracts, and monitoring.
  • Lead public-private partnerships and the company’s non-profit affiliates.
  • Lead select initiatives from evaluation through completion, aligning internal teams and external partners around milestones, ownership, and measures of success, then assess results and refine or scale them.

Capital, Board & Investor Relations

  • Prepare the company for future capital events, including M&A, debt financing and credit facilities, and potential IPO or other strategic equity opportunities.
  • Prepare and present financial and strategic materials to the Board, investors, and other external stakeholders.
  • Build relationships with external partners, lenders, and stakeholders, representing Frontline with sound judgment and commercial credibility.

Legal, Risk & Compliance

  • Lead the legal function, overseeing state operating licensure and tax, intellectual property, vendor and customer contracts, recurring-revenue contract structures, and lender relationships.

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead the finance organization, including the existing VP of Finance and accounting team, and develop a high-performing team as the company scales.

Qualifications

  • Senior finance leadership experience as a CFO or comparable executive position.
  • Experience leading financial planning, analysis, and company-level decision support, including resource allocation that balances growth investment with financial discipline.
  • Proven experience leading finance through an IPO, rapid growth rates, and major capital raises.
  • Strong financial modeling skills, including unit economics, ROI, and forecasting, and the ability to assess the economics of new business models, partnerships, and revenue streams.
  • Experience shaping commercial or strategic initiatives from evaluation through implementation, and turning broad priorities into business cases, operating plans, milestones, and clear ownership.
  • Experience leading work beyond the finance function and partnering closely with a CEO, COO, and executive team on company priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage effectively with a Board and investors.
  • Experience building and developing a high-performing finance team.
  • Clear, concise communication with executives, employees, Board members, investors, and external partners, including explaining financial concepts to non-financial audiences.
  • A pragmatic, low-ego leadership style: willing to push back on assumptions and strategy, comfortable working hands-on as a builder, and decisive in a lean, high-growth environment where priorities can shift quickly.
  • Experience in growing a profitable hardware and software business or a company with complex operating economics.
  • Experience in insurance, construction, home services, property technology, climate resilience, data, or a related field.
  • Direct experience taking a company public or leading IPO readiness, including audit readiness, public-company reporting, and internal controls.
  • Experience evaluating and structuring new commercial models, including strategic partnerships, new products and channels, pricing, and recurring revenue or lease-based models, ideally including a shift from one-time to recurring revenue.
  • Experience with debt financing (including credit facilities), investor relations, and/or M&A transactions.
  • Experience with consumer financing or asset-backed financing, and/or consumer-finance regulations and compliance.
  • Experience with project-based accounting.
  • Experience implementing and optimizing financial systems and using data and technology to improve reporting and decision-making.
  • Experience in a private equity or venture-backed business.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary Range:$350,000 - $400,000 OTE. Placement within this range is based on experience, skill set, and location.
  • Equity: Stock options subject to stock option agreement, which in addition to other terms and conditions includes a 4 year vesting period and a 1 year cliff.
  • Company-provided cell phone and laptop.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance.
  • 401(k) Plan.
  • Flexible time-off policy + 14 paid holidays per year (yes, your birthday is one of them!).
  • Work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup.
  • Remote-first work environment, fostering work-life balance and autonomy.
  • Join a high-performing, mission-driven team doing work that truly matters.
  • And much more!

Join Our Mission!

If you're excited about building technology that protects homes and families from wildfire disasters, we want to hear from you! Apply today and become part of a fast-growing team with purpose and innovation at its core.

Diversity and inclusion are essential values at Frontline. We know we'll do our best and most impactful work when we feel represented, and we belong. We encourage talented people from a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences to apply. raw.description:
Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.

We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more.

MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving operational efficiency and clinical quality.

About the AI Receptionist Team:

At MEDvidi, the AI Receptionist Team builds and improves Voice AI Agents that interact directly with patients and automate critical parts of the patient journey.

Our AI systems handle real-world patient conversations across voice and text channels, support operational workflows, and help patients navigate care more efficiently.

The team works on complex patient support scenarios, including prescription-related inquiries, pharmacy communications, patient verification, and operational processes involving healthcare providers.

As these agents become more autonomous and handle increasingly complex interactions, understanding how they behave in production becomes a critical product and business challenge.

We're looking for an AI Product Analyst who can help us evaluate, monitor, and continuously improve these systems.

You'll work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Operations, and AI, helping the team understand how AI behaves in the real world, where it creates value, where it fails, and what should be improved next.

We're building an AI-first team where experimenting with emerging technologies, challenging traditional workflows, and using AI to accelerate everyday work are part of our culture.

Why This Role:

  • Real-world AI impact: Work on one of the most visible AI products inside MEDvidi, directly influencing patient interactions.
  • Shape the future of Voice AI: Help build and improve AI Agents that handle increasingly complex healthcare workflows.
  • AI-first environment: Join a team that actively explores new AI technologies and integrates them into daily workflows.
  • High ownership: Take responsibility for analytical initiatives, from identifying problems to measuring product impact.
  • Fast-moving product culture: Work closely with Product Managers and Engineers, where insights turn into product decisions and improvements.
  • Meaningful challenges: Investigate complex AI behavior, uncover hidden failure patterns, and improve the reliability of systems operating in production.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze production behavior of Voice AI Agents, identifying hallucinations, silent failures, quality issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Investigate call transcripts, logs, and operational data to uncover patterns and actionable insights.
  • Design AI evaluation frameworks and monitor agent quality, reliability, and performance.
  • Build dashboards and monitoring systems to track key product metrics, AI performance, and business impact.
  • Conduct product discovery, hypothesis validation, experiments, and post-release analysis.
  • Leverage modern AI tools to accelerate analytical workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and improve productivity.
  • Deliver timely, actionable recommendations by balancing analytical depth with speed and business priorities.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Operations to drive AI product improvements.

This role is not for you if

  • You prefer working only with structured datasets and predefined metrics.
  • You are uncomfortable analyzing raw conversations, transcripts, and AI-generated outputs.
  • You expect clearly defined answers rather than investigating ambiguous problems.
  • You are not interested in understanding how AI systems fail in production.
  • You rarely use AI tools in your daily work and are not interested in experimenting with new AI-driven workflows.
  • You prefer exhaustive research over delivering timely, actionable insights when speed is critical.
  • You find it challenging to turn complex analytical findings into clear recommendations for product teams.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analytics, or Operational Analytics within complex product environments.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills for data analysis, investigations, and automation.
  • Experience working with ML pipelines or AI-powered products.
  • Understanding of LLM limitations, hallucinations, prompt sensitivity, evaluation challenges, and AI failure modes.
  • Experience building analytical frameworks, monitoring systems, and product dashboards.
  • AI-first mindset: Active use of modern AI tools in daily workflows, with a proactive approach to experimenting with new technologies and improving productivity.
  • Strong product thinking: Ability to independently investigate problems, validate hypotheses, and translate data into actionable product decisions.
  • Speed and pragmatism: Ability to prioritize high-impact opportunities, deliver insights quickly, and balance analytical depth with execution speed.
  • Clear and structured communication: Ability to communicate findings concisely and collaborate effectively with Product Managers and Engineers.
  • Comfortable working independently in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.
  • Fluent Russian and English at B2 level or higher.
  • Ability to work CET-overlapping hours.

Would be a plus

  • Experience with conversational AI, Voice AI, or AI agents.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation, AI quality metrics, and prompt experimentation.
  • Experience analyzing conversation transcripts, unstructured text, or agent execution logs.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered development and analytics tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar.
  • Experience in AI-first startups, healthcare technology, or regulated industries.

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to influence how AI is used in real patient interactions.
  • Growth & compensation: Competitive compensation and clear growth opportunities.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote, long-term B2B collaboration.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Career growth, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 working days of vacation per year, 4 additional wellness days, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for important life events.

If you're a product-minded analyst who enjoys solving complex problems, actively experiments with AI technologies, and wants to improve how AI systems perform in real-world healthcare environments, we'd love to hear from you.

Send us your profile and let's build something meaningful together.

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

As Manager, Technical Enablement, you will be the founding people leader of a dedicated technical enablement function, built to support our large and growing global Sales Engineering team. Our Sales Engineers are central to how we win, and as the team scales, it needs enablement that matches the depth of the work. You will hire, lead, and develop a team of enablement professionals, and you will serve as a player-coach, contributing directly to the programs your team delivers.

Working in partnership with the Director of Revenue Enablement and global Sales Engineering leadership, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of advanced technical enablement. You will identify capability gaps, establish proficiency standards, and build the technical onboarding, hands-on workshops, certifications, and ongoing coaching that take our field well beyond foundational product knowledge. You will partner closely with Product and Product Marketing to turn each release into field-ready technical content, and you will measure readiness and program effectiveness so that the function earns its place as a trusted partner to the field and to leadership.

Technologies You’ll Use

Notion, Salesforce, Gong, Thought Industries, Claude, Sumble, Hex, Nook, Jira, Navan, Nooks, Sales Navigator, AI role play tools

What You’ll Do

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of advanced technical enablement in partnership with the Director of Revenue Enablement for the global Field Engineering team
  • Lead and develop a team of enablement professionals while serving as a player-coach, contributing directly to the execution of team priorities.
  • Partner with global Field Engineering leadership to identify capability gaps, establish proficiency standards, and prioritize readiness programs across regions.
  • Build and maintain deep technical product training, hands-on workshops, certifications, and ongoing coaching that go beyond foundational seller education.
  • Define technical onboarding curriculum, ramp milestones, and proficiency benchmarks in partnership with the existing onboarding team.
  • Partner closely with Product and Product Marketing to translate releases and product differentiation into field-ready technical content and practical exercises.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Revenue Enablement to connect seller-facing technical fluency with advanced solution discovery, demonstrations, evaluations, and technical sales processes.
  • Build a structured feedback loop between field teams and Product, and measure technical readiness, training adoption, demo environment health, and program effectiveness.
  • Lead cross-functional programs through influence, clear stakeholder alignment, and disciplined execution in a global matrix environment.
  • Monitor completion rates, assessment results, field feedback, and ramp outcomes, and use these insights to refine programs and report progress to leadership.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, field engineering, or related technical go-to-market roles, with demonstrated leadership of complex programs or teams.
  • Previous people management experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing team members
  • Deep working knowledge of modern data platforms, data integration, analytics engineering, cloud data architectures, and technical evaluation practices.
  • Experience designing enablement programs, such as and delivering advanced technical training, coaching, and developing on-demand learning modules
  • Ability to partner credibly with Product, Product Marketing, Sales, and senior Field Engineering leaders across a global organization.

Description

Does it ever feel like you’re spending more time navigating processes than actually underwriting? Frustrated by legacy systems, slow decision-making and technology that gets in the way rather than helps? Do you have the experience and judgement to assess complex risks, make sound underwriting decisions and build a profitable book of business, but feel held back by the environment you’re working in?

At Ledgebrook, you can do things differently. You won’t just be underwriting risk — you’ll help redefine how specialty insurance works. We’re an AI-native platform empowering underwriters to make faster, smarter decisions on complex risks, with technology built from the ground up and AI at its core. Our technology helps price risk; your expertise and judgment drive the final decision. Two hands on the wheel.

We eat our own cooking: Ledgebrook writes the policy and shares the risk through its own carrier, Ledgebrook Specialty, rated A- (Excellent) by AM Best. We work exclusively through wholesale brokers.

Our vision is to make the wheels of insurance spin faster. You’ll be part of a team that’s not just adapting to the future of insurance but actively building it.

At Ledgebrook, everything we do is driven by our culture: Care, Strive, Thrive Together. Talent density is our north star—fewer, better people working together as one.

We’ve replaced individual incentives with generous equity packages because we believe in winning together. When Ledgebrook succeeds, everyone shares in that success.

About the Role

We’re looking for experienced Casualty Underwriters, for both General Liability and Unsupported Excess lines to join our growing team.

Ledgebrook’s vision is to deliver market relevant solutions to our key wholesale trading partners in a more frictionless environment that places an emphasis on efficiencies and quality to meet or exceed our broker’s overall needs in a risk differentiated manner.

If you’re entrepreneurial, passionate about underwriting excellence and ready to break out of the traditional insurance company mould, we’d love to hear from you. Working closely with our wholesale trading partners, you’ll build relationships, generate in-appetite submission flow and convert the best opportunities quoted.

We’re particularly interested in disciplined underwriting professionals with a strong E&S casualty background and experience across a range of industry segments, including manufacturing, distribution, construction, real estate, retail, mercantile, habitational and hospitality.

We’re flexible about experience level and physical work location. Your title (Underwriter, Senior Underwriter, Executive Underwriter, etc.) and the scope of your role (Individual Contributor, Team Lead, etc.) will reflect your experience and qualifications.

We currently operate in a fully remote working environment. We’re more interested in your expertise and cultural fit than where you are based.

Bring your experience. Bring your ambition. Help us build the future of specialty insurance.

About you

Here at Ledgebrook we’re passionate about creating a team that thrives on continuous learning and shares our excitement about building a company from the ground up. We’re looking for people to join us with:

  • A passion for delivering world-class customer service to our internal and external customers
  • Intellectual curiosity and a strong desire for innovation, rather than following the status quo
  • A hunger for continuous learning and opportunities to grow
  • Agile prioritization skills coupled with a keen sense of urgency - we balance getting it right with getting it done right now
  • A strong drive and desire to win together as a high-performing team
  • A moral compass to "do the right thing, period." We have zero tolerance for toxic behaviors
  • An eagerness to actively participate and connect with the whole team, across remote locations
  • An honest, transparent communication style
  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset. We don’t look for blame, we look for the solution

Requirements

As a future Ledgebrook Underwriter, your experience and qualifications must include:

  • 5+ years experience as an underwriter
  • Experience underwriting construction-related risks
  • Experience underwriting OCIP, CCIP, and Project Specific programs - Primary and Excess
  • Strong knowledge of Commercial General Liability coverage forms and endorsements
  • Understanding of construction contracts, indemnification agreements, and additional insured requirements
  • Knowledge of construction defect exposures and completed operations liability
  • Experience evaluating large and complex construction projects
  • Ability to work as a team player or independently in a fast-paced work environment
  • Established broker relationships within the construction insurance marketplace
  • Effective communication skills to articulate the Ledgebrook appetite and value proposition to develop and advance wholesale broker relationships
  • Understanding of pricing and risk selection criteria to achieve profitable loss ratios
  • Advanced understanding of data analysis and execution of portfolio management objectives
  • Innovative problem solving and solutioning skills
  • Responsive, customer service focused mindset and behaviors
  • Intellectual curiosity and comfort in dealing with the concept of a blank sheet of paper
  • Ability to make timely decisions with appropriate information and consultation
  • A strong entrepreneurial drive and desire to build and win together as a high performing team
  • Ability to travel independently to meet with assigned brokers or with the broader Ledgebrook team to participate in industry conference or events

Benefits

  • Full remote flexibility and asynchronous work culture.
  • Unlimited PTO and fully paid sick leave.
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA and FSA options.
  • Additional financial protection and retirement benefits, including a 401(k), company-paid life insurance, and disability coverage.

Compensation

  • Base Salary Range 90,000-150,000- This is a good-faith compensation range based on what Ledgebrook reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of this posting. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of relevant factors including experience, qualifications, geographic location and other relevant factors.

Please note: This position is open only to candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. We are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.

raw.title: Senior Staff Partnerships Lead, Gaming
raw.excerpt: Why Mozilla?  Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

What is a Senior Staff Partnerships Lead at Mozilla?

Senior Staff is a senior individual contributor level at Mozilla. People at this level are recognized leaders in their field. They take on complex, ambiguous work that spans several disciplines and organizations with little supervision, lead strategic external relationships, and are comfortable working with executives inside and outside Mozilla.

About this team and role:

Mozilla’s New Products organization is an internal incubator for high-potential ventures. We’re building a new Firefox product for PC gamers, and partnerships across the games industry are central to how it reaches players and grows.

As the partnerships lead, you’ll be responsible for identifying, initiating, and closing the gaming partnerships that bring the product to more players. You will report to the Director of Product and build new gaming partnerships that advance the product roadmap.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the product’s partnerships strategy and pipeline across cloud gaming services, storefronts and launchers, publishers and studios, community platforms, and hardware makers.
  • Originate, structure and close deals that bring players, product capabilities and new revenue, such as distribution, co-marketing, in-game rewards and revenue-share agreements.
  • Plan and deliver partner launch moments with Firefox marketing that reach players where they already play.
  • Identify and propose new product features in support of partnerships, and evangelize new product features with partners.
  • Lead each deal across Mozilla: shape terms with Legal and Finance, scope partner integrations with product and engineering, and hold every partnership to Mozilla’s standards for privacy, trust and responsible design.
  • Represent Mozilla with senior leaders across the games industry, and bring what you learn from partners and the market back into product strategy.

What you’ll bring:

  • 10+ years in business development, product marketing, or strategic partnerships, including 5+ years in the games industry.
  • A track record of originating and closing multi-party commercial partnerships from first conversation to signed agreement, including revenue-share and co-marketing deals.
  • Established relationships with decision-makers across the PC gaming ecosystem, and the standing to get meetings with senior leaders at platform holders and publishers.
  • Strong commercial judgment: you can model deal economics, structure terms that work for both sides, and negotiate with senior counterparts.
  • Experience taking deals through legal, finance, product and marketing teams to launch, without an established playbook.
  • Clear, persuasive communication with executives inside and outside the company, and willingness to travel for partner meetings and industry events.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences
    • Being relationship-minded
    • Practicing responsible participation
    • Having grit

Bonus points for: partnerships experience at a browser, operating system or consumer software company; distribution deals such as device pre-installs or app store placements; and a passion for PC gaming and its communities.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Title: Sr. Web Developer – React & Integrations

Location: Remote in USA

We are seeking a skilled, hands-on Web Developer / Frontend Developer with strong expertise in React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, and modern web development technologies to build, enhance, and maintain responsive, scalable, and high-performing web applications.

In this role, you will translate business requirements and UI/UX designs into seamless digital experiences while integrating frontend applications with backend services and third-party platforms. You will work closely with the Lead Web Developer, backend developers, product teams, and stakeholders to deliver reliable, accessible, and engaging web applications within restaurant technology ecosystems.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance responsive web applications and user interfaces using React.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
  • Build reusable, modular, and maintainable UI components aligned to established frontend architecture and coding standards.
  • Develop multiple pages, application features, and user experiences based on business requirements, functional specifications, and UI/UX designs.
  • Implement modern React development practices, including component-based architecture, hooks, state management, routing, and reusable design patterns.
  • Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs, backend services, and third-party platforms.
  • Support integrations across restaurant technology ecosystems, including online ordering platforms, POS systems, payment providers, loyalty and rewards platforms, customer identity and authentication solutions, location services, push notifications, promotions and offers, analytics, and customer engagement platforms.
  • Implement asynchronous requests, API integrations, data handling, error handling, loading states, and validation states.
  • Translate UI/UX designs and wireframes into responsive, accessible, and consistent web interfaces.
  • Ensure cross-browser and cross-device compatibility across desktop, tablet, and mobile environments.
  • Optimize application performance, page load speed, rendering efficiency, and overall user experience.
  • Follow SEO best practices, accessibility standards, and modern web development guidelines.
  • Write clean, efficient, reusable, and well-documented code to support consistency and long-term maintainability.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve frontend defects, integration issues, and application performance challenges.
  • Participate in code reviews, incorporate feedback, and follow development standards and technical guidelines established by the Lead Web Developer.
  • Develop and maintain unit tests and participate in frontend testing and quality assurance activities.
  • Collaborate with backend developers to understand API contracts, data structures, business logic, and integration requirements.
  • Support application deployments, CI/CD processes, release activities, and post-deployment validation.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot application performance, errors, crashes, and availability using tools such as DataDog, Splunk, App Insights, New Relic, or similar platforms.
  • Maintain technical documentation related to developed features, integrations, configurations, and application functionality.
  • Work closely with the Lead Web Developer to understand technical requirements, discuss implementation approaches, identify dependencies, and resolve development challenges.
  • Take ownership of assigned features and development modules, provide regular progress updates, and deliver work within agreed timelines.
  • Actively contribute to team discussions, technical problem-solving, and continuous improvement of development practices.
  • Stay current with modern frontend technologies, frameworks, tools, and industry best practices.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of overall IT professional experience in software development.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience developing production-grade applications using React.js.
  • 4+ years of strong hands-on experience with JavaScript ES6+ and TypeScript.
  • Experience developing and maintaining multi-page applications using React.js.
  • Strong understanding of React fundamentals, including components, hooks, state management, lifecycle concepts, and routing.
  • Experience with HTML5, CSS3, responsive web design, and CSS preprocessors such as LESS and SASS.
  • Experience with frontend frameworks and component libraries such as Bootstrap, Material UI, Tailwind CSS, or similar.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and working with JSON data, asynchronous requests, and backend services.
  • Understanding of frontend architecture, reusable component design, and application state management.
  • Experience with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Working knowledge of command-line development tools, npm, package management, and frontend build utilities such as Vite and Webpack.
  • Experience with browser developer tools, debugging, troubleshooting, and frontend performance optimization.
  • Good understanding of web accessibility standards and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Familiarity with SEO optimization, server-side rendering, and modern frontend rendering approaches.
  • Experience writing unit tests using frameworks and tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, or similar.
  • Basic understanding of Node.js and Express, with the ability to partner with backend developers on API and integration requirements.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD processes and application deployment practices.
  • Understanding of application security fundamentals, authentication, authorization, and secure API communication.
  • Familiarity with Azure Cloud services and deployment environments is an advantage.
  • Experience working in Agile development teams and collaborative software delivery environments.
  • Ability to understand business requirements, translate them into technical implementations, and deliver assigned development tasks independently.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, documentation discipline, and commitment to code quality.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Node.js, Express, and Azure Cloud Functions.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Azure application hosting and cloud services.
  • Experience integrating third-party APIs and external business platforms.
  • Experience with restaurant POS platforms, online ordering, payment systems, or loyalty platforms.
  • Experience in restaurant technology, retail, hospitality, or e-commerce environments.

The base salary for this position is $92,250 to $120,000 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.

The deadline to apply for this position is: 11/30/2026. This position is for an existing, immediate vacancy. We are currently seeking to fill this role with an individual who can start as soon as possible.

raw.description:
Source is an ecosystem of independent technology companies behind responsible access to web data. Source works behind the scenes, providing shared standards and dedicated support that help each company grow.
The culture follows the same idea: colleagues work across the ecosystem, share what they know, and hold a high bar, so a good idea in one place can create an advantage everywhere.

The team waiting for you:

The security team is responsible for safeguarding our infrastructure and applications against an ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats. As a Cybersecurity Analyst, you will be on the front lines of our operations, actively managing our SIEM environments and leading incident response efforts. With our data ecosystem rapidly expanding, scaling our security monitoring and automated detection capabilities is more timely and critical than ever. Your work here directly ensures the integrity of our complex data operations, keeping our products secure and our global customers protected.

In this role, you will:

  • Monitor, triage, and investigate alerts from the SIEM (Wazuh/Elasticsearch) and other security tools, separating true positives from noise.
  • Run incident response steps: containment, evidence collection, root cause analysis, and remediation follow-up.
  • Build, tune, and maintain detection rules and decoders for various attack scenarios in Wazuh and Elasticsearch.
  • Onboard and normalize new log sources to expand our visibility.
  • Continuously improve SOC operations by identifying gaps in detection logic, playbooks, and triage workflows.
  • Help assess and validate external pentest and bug bounty reports.

Your skills & experiences:

  • 2-4 years of experience working in security operations, incident response, or application security.
  • Experience with SIEM platforms (Wazuh, Elastic/ELK, Splunk, or similar), including writing queries and detection rules.
  • Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) for automation, log parsing, and building testing tools.
  • Strong understanding of web technologies and how they are attacked, including HTTP/S, session management, authentication protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT), REST and GraphQL APIs, and browser security controls (SOP, CORS, CSP).
  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, BSCP (Burp Suite Certified Practitioner), eWPT/eWPTX, GWAPT, GCIH, or CySA+.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge and practical experience of OWASP Top 10 exploitation.
  • Experience with WAFs, bot management, or anti-abuse systems (Cloudflare, Akamai, AWS WAF, or similar).
  • Experience with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerized apps (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Elastic Fleet/Agent and Wazuh rule and decoder development.
  • "Don't meet everything above? Apply anyway. We're looking for what's next, not what's already been done."

Tech stack:

  • Wazuh & Elasticsearch (ELK)
  • Python & Bash
  • Web Security (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, REST, GraphQL, SOP, CORS, CSP)
  • Cloud & Containers (AWS, GCP, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes)
  • WAFs (Cloudflare, Akamai)

Salary & Benefits

  • Gross salary: 17 200 - 23 000 PLN/month. Keep in mind that we are open to discuss a different salary based on your skills and competencies.
  • Growth & Learning: 40+ internal learning options, external conferences, mentorship, and year-round knowledge-sharing.
  • Celebration & Community: Team events, an overseas workation and plenty of ways to mark milestones together.
  • Plus bonus vacation days, paid life-moment days off, and all the tools you need. See the full list of benefits here:

Up for the challenge? Let’s talk!

raw.description:
The Specialist, Study Start Up and Regulatory Affairs leads and coordinates all activities related
to achieving site initiation readiness. The role provides subject matter expertise, ensures regulatory
compliance, and serves as a key liaison between internal teams, clients, and external stakeholders

  • Accountable for delivery of assigned study start-up and regulatory milestones within defined scope.
  • Make independent decisions within assigned scope regarding regulatory processes and documentation approaches.
  • Handles medium-complexity regulatory environments, including multi-country requirements where applicable.
  • Leads study start-up and regulatory activities for assigned countries or projects of medium complexity, ensuring delivery in line with timelines, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Leads preparation, review, and quality control of regulatory and study start-up documentation (including submissions, essential documents, and translations) to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with ICH-GCP and country-specific requirements.
  • Responsible for drafting, negotiating, finalizing, and executing clinical site agreements, ancillary agreements as well as amendments at country or regional level, in accordance with project requirements and country regulations and within the projected delivery timelines
  • Review all relevant documentation e.g. labels, patient information sheets, diary cards, insurance etc, to ensure compliance with ICH GCP & country specific requirements.
  • Contribute towards the preparation and/or review of complex technical/scientific/legal documentation.
  • Arrange for and/or review translation of essential documents as required
  • Provide regulatory/SSU strategic input to internal and external customers. Develop the regulatory strategy and the SSU Plan, joint operating procedures and core documents
  • Promptly identify and escalate risk/potential risk to the project team which may jeopardise deliverables; support corrective/preventive actions
  • Performs other work-related duties as assigned.
  • Graduate degree in Chemistry or Life Sciences, Nursing or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Previous experience within pharmaceutical or CRO industry or Regulatory body
  • Good knowledge of ICH GCP and national regulations for territories of competency
  • Good understanding of specific country requirements pertaining to SSU/Regulatory delivery in multiple countries within Europe and/or the Americas

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

Title: Channel Sales Director

Location: Remote (Northeast, Texas or West Coast)

Timeframe: Immediate

Reports To: VP of Sales

About the role:

Forte Technologies is seeking a high-performing Channel Sales Director to build and scale our indirect sales engine. This role owns Forte’s presence across the Technology Solutions Distributor (TSD) ecosystem and the agents, trusted advisors, and referral partners who sell through it, turning those relationships into a consistent source of partner-sourced pipeline and new recurring revenue.

As Channel Sales Director, you will recruit, enable, and activate channel partners, establish Forte as a go-to managed services provider within the TSD supplier portfolio, and work alongside agents to close complex IT service deals with their end customers across managed services, cybersecurity, cloud, professional services, and advisory. This role is ideal for a relationship-driven seller who can treat the channel as a territory, build partner mindshare from the ground up, and convert referrals into long-term managed services clients.

What You’ll Own:

You will be accountable for generating pipeline and closed revenue through the TSD ecosystem and partner community, including:

  • Channel-Sourced Pipeline: Build a healthy, predictable pipeline of qualified opportunities referred by TSDs, agents, and partners.
  • Partner-Sourced Revenue: Close new managed services and recurring agreements that grow MRR through the channel.
  • Partner Activation: Grow the number of productive agents and partners actively selling Forte, and move new partners from signed to producing.
  • Operational Rigor: Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasts, partner attribution, and partner plans in CRM; ensure clean opportunity and deal registration hygiene.

Key Responsibilities:

TSD & Partner Ecosystem Development

  • Build and manage strategic relationships with TSD channel managers, supplier management teams, and leadership.
  • Identify, recruit, and onboard high-potential agents, trusted advisors, and referral partners aligned with Forte’s target customers.
  • Segment and prioritize the partner base by productivity, vertical focus, geography, and growth potential.
  • Represent Forte at TSD events, partner summits, roadshows, and industry conferences to build mindshare.

Partner Enablement & Activation

  • Develop and deliver partner enablement, including training sessions, sales playbooks, battle cards, and co-branded collateral.
  • Position Forte’s full portfolio so partners can confidently identify managed services, cybersecurity, cloud, and professional services opportunities.
  • Host partner webinars, lunch-and-learns, and TSD-sponsored programs to keep Forte top of mind with agents.
  • Partner with Marketing on through-channel campaigns, SPIFFs, and incentives that drive referral activity.

Opportunity Management & Deal Execution

  • Engage quickly on partner-referred opportunities and run discovery and needs analysis jointly with the agent and end customer.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Solutions teams to design right-fit offerings and build compelling proposals.
  • Manage quoting, deal registration, and contracting requirements specific to each TSD and partner.
  • Negotiate terms and close new recurring revenue contracts while protecting the partner relationship.

Channel Strategy & Execution

  • Build and execute a channel plan with targets, priority TSDs and partners, and activity KPIs.
  • Track partner performance, attribution, and commission and residual accuracy in collaboration with Finance.
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management with accurate close dates, probabilities, and revenue estimates.
  • Monitor competing suppliers within the TSD portfolio to differentiate Forte and grow partner share of wallet.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Finance, Operations, and Leadership to optimize the channel sales motion.
  • Ensure smooth handoff of closed channel accounts to Onboarding and Client Partners while keeping the referring partner informed.
  • Share partner feedback, market insights, and buying trends with leadership to inform offerings, pricing, and go-to-market strategy.

What Skills & Experience You’ll Need:

  • B2B technology sales experience (MSP or SaaS preferred), including channel, partner, or indirect sales.
  • Established relationships within the TSD ecosystem and agent community strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record of generating channel-sourced pipeline and closing new recurring revenue.
  • Working knowledge of TSD business models, including supplier agreements, deal registration, commissions, and residuals.
  • Ability to articulate IT/MSP services: Microsoft 365, Azure, cybersecurity, cloud, and networking.
  • Experience selling into SMB and mid-market organizations through partners.
  • Executive presence and strong communication and presentation skills; comfortable training partner audiences and engaging C-level stakeholders.
  • CRM and partner portal proficiency (HubSpot, Salesforce, TSD portals, etc.).
  • Strong organizational skills—able to manage multiple partners, opportunities, and deadlines with minimal oversight.
  • Willingness to travel for TSD events, partner meetings, and industry conferences (as required).
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent experience welcomed.

What we can offer

Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Safety Triage & Insights team builds data-driven safety experiences that surface actionable insights, engage drivers directly, and help fleets focus resources where they matter most. We develop the systems, APIs, and customer-facing products that power safety event review, supervisor workflows, driver analytics, and AI-driven experiences across Samsara’s Safety organization. The team is deeply invested in AI, LLMs, and emerging agentic technologies, both in the products we build and in how we engineer them, enabling rapid iteration and highly personalized, insight-driven user experiences.

As a Sr. Software Engineer I on the team, you will lead the design and evolution of systems that sit at the intersection of real-time data processing, AI-powered insights, and customer-facing product experiences. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, ML, and platform teams to build scalable services, intelligent workflows, and next-generation AI capabilities that help organizations move beyond reactive incident review toward proactive, data-informed safety management.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Canada.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building and scaling customer-facing AI/LLM-powered products in production environments.

Join a team that's rebuilding healthcare from the patient up. At Mochi Medical, you'll work alongside people who value bold thinking, inclusive collaboration, and getting meaningful work into the world. If you want to do the most impactful work of your career, this is where to do it.

This position is a contract role with Mochi Medical, a physician-owned professional corporation affiliated with Mochi Health Corp. Mochi Health is a management service organization that supports Mochi Medical by providing administrative and operational services, but the role and clinical practice are with Mochi Medical.

This position is a contract role with Mochi Medical, a physician-owned professional corporation affiliated with Mochi Health, Corp. Mochi Health supports Mochi Medical by providing administrative and operational services, but the role and clinical practice are with Mochi Medical.

Contract / Remote (US-Only)

About Mochi
Mochi began as a virtual obesity medicine practice. Today, patients come to us for much more: hair loss, skin concerns, menopause and hormone care, mood, and healthy aging. Our goal is simple: one trusted provider who can help with all of it, at a price people can actually afford, from wherever they are.
We are growing quickly, and we are looking for nurse practitioners who want to practice broadly, keep learning, and help shape what whole-person virtual care looks like.

The Basics
  • Contract role, fully remote (US only)
  • You set your own schedule, with availability any time of day or week
  • Video visits plus asynchronous care for an ongoing patient panel

What your work looks like

  • Care across every Mochi care area: weight and metabolic health, dermatology and skin, hair loss, hormone replacement therapy and menopause, depression and anxiety, and longevity.
  • Visits built around what the patient asked for: before each visit, see which care areas your patient selected, then assess each one, treat it when clinically appropriate, or note why not.
  • Asynchronous care: review intake forms, photos, labs and history, and build or adjust treatment plans between visits.
  • Ongoing management: new prescriptions, refills, dose changes and side-effect follow-up across all care areas.
  • Clear communication: answer patient messages and explain lab results and next steps in plain language.
  • Good judgment about limits: spot when someone needs in-person, urgent or specialty care, and help them get it.
  • Teamwork: work alongside other providers, collaborating physicians, pharmacy partners and our care team.
Your clinical judgment always comes first. Mochi provides prescribing protocols for each care area, training in the provider portal, and weekly office hours with clinical leadership so you’re never figuring out a new area alone.
Who thrives here
  • You enjoy variety and like treating the whole person, not just one condition.
  • You’re curious and comfortable learning new care areas.
  • You communicate warmly and clearly with patients
  • You’re at home with technology: video visits, async charting and an EHR.
  • You make sound decisions in focused, efficient visits.
  • You welcome feedback and use it to get better.
  • You stay steady when a case isn’t straightforward.

Requirements

  • Graduate of an accredited nurse practitioner program, with current national board certification
  • At least 2 years of NP experience in adult primary care, urgent care, women’s health, dermatology or telehealth
  • Active DEA registration
  • Licenses and record in good standing, with no disciplinary actions or exclusions from federal or state healthcare programs
  • Telehealth experience strongly preferred
  • Open to adding state licenses as Mochi grows
  • Active, unrestricted NP license in at least one US state, notably in WV, IN and AR.

What Mochi provides

  • Patients come to you: we handle marketing, booking and scheduling, so you don’t build a practice from scratch
  • Full malpractice coverage
  • Complete control over your schedule
  • A custom-built EMR that shows each patient’s selected care areas and lets you order treatments for any of them from the visit note
  • Care-area protocols, training resources and weekly office hours
  • More time for medicine: a support team takes care of lab testing, prior authorizations and customer service
  • An optional academic lecture series for ongoing learning
Compensation
Nurse practitioners are paid on a visit-based, fee-for-service model:
  • Synchronous visits: up to $90 per hour
  • Asynchronous care: $5–12 per patient per month
Full terms are in your Professional Services Agreement and Compensation Model, which we’ll walk through during onboarding.

Our hiring process includes identity and credential verification. Mochi will only contact you from an @joinmochi.com email address and won’t request payment from you at any point in hiring or onboarding.

raw.description:
About the Role

We operate in an AI-first engineering environment, where AI-powered development is at the core of how we design, build, and deliver software. As our engineers ship faster with AI coding agents, our infrastructure and delivery pipelines have to keep pace, and security has to be built in from the start.

We're looking for a hands-on DevSecOps Engineer to own our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and platform reliability, with security embedded into every layer. You'll spend most of your time building: infrastructure as code, deployment pipelines, observability, and the automated guardrails that let engineers ship quickly and safely. You'll work closely with Engineering, QA, Product, and Compliance and help our engineers own security and reliability end-to-end.

Our stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, on AWS.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own our cloud infrastructure: Design, build, and operate our AWS environment using infrastructure as code, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

  • Build secure delivery pipelines: Own CI/CD end-to-end, embedding automated security checks (SAST, dependency and container scanning, secrets detection) so every change is validated before it reaches production.

  • Engineer security into the platform: IAM, network segmentation, encryption, and secrets management as defaults, so the secure path is the easy path.

  • Drive reliability and observability: Monitoring, logging, and alerting that give us fast detection and clear signal, and lead incident response and post-incident improvements.

  • Build with AI agents: Use tools like Claude Code to accelerate infrastructure work, automation, and troubleshooting while owning the correctness and security of the output.

  • Support compliance through automation: Partner on SOC 2 and other regulatory requirements by automating evidence, controls, and audit readiness.

  • Enable engineering teams: Help engineers understand and own the infrastructure and security of the services they ship, through tooling, documentation, and hands-on support.

  • Support compliance through automation: Partner with our Compliance Lead to implement and automate the technical controls and evidence collection behind SOC 2 and other regulatory requirements, so audit readiness is continuous and built into our infrastructure rather than a manual effort.

Key Requirements

  • 4+ years in DevOps, platform, or infrastructure engineering, with security as a core part of how you work.

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CDK, or similar).

  • Deep experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar), including integrating automated security tooling.

  • Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, ECS, or Kubernetes), and with observability tools (Datadog, CloudWatch, or similar).

  • Solid understanding of cloud security fundamentals: IAM, networking, encryption, secrets management, and vulnerability management.

  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to build and maintain infrastructure and automation, with the judgment to validate their output.

  • Strong ownership mentality and the ability to influence engineering practices across teams.

  • Experience implementing technical controls and automating audit evidence, including with compliance automation platforms (Vanta, Drata, or similar) or policy as code.

  • Nice to Have

    • Experience in FinTech, banking, payments, or environments subject to SOC 2, PCI DSS, or similar regulatory requirements.

    • Experience with policy as code, compliance automation, or cloud security posture management tools.

    • Experience with incident response, threat modeling, or penetration testing coordination.

This is a remote first role. While we expect you to come to the office for monthly team building events, the work is remote first.

Description

MWDN is a global IT outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience that connects exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe. We offer opportunities to work on international products in a stable and professional environment.

Why does MWDN rock?

Here’s what you can expect when you join MWDN:

  • Security: We carefully vet our clients to minimize risks and ensure reliability and timely payments - no fraud or unpleasant surprises.
  • Career support: If a project isn’t the right fit, we support you and actively help find new opportunities that match your skills and career goals.
  • Legal assistance: We provide guidance on legal matters, including opening and managing your independent contractor or sole proprietorship status, taxes, and related processes.
  • Professional development: We offer English courses and professional growth opportunities, as well as team-building events.

Why choose us? MWDN is ranked among the top 5 IT employers in our region according to DOU. We take pride in our transparency and strong commitment to our team. Curious to learn more? See what our employees say about working with us on DOU.

What is your new project?

Domain: Venture Capital and Private Equity Principals

Client Location: Israel

Company size: 10-50

Founded in: 2016

What makes this project exciting?

We’re looking for a senior engineer who can build AI native products on top of reliable, secure, high quality data systems. Someone who has experience shipping production level software for high trust workflows, understands data pipelines and data quality deeply, can deploy safe agentic systems, and knows how to design robust architecture that scales.

This role is for someone who has shipped production software at scale, understands data pipelines and data quality deeply, and knows how to deploy AI systems that are useful, observable, and safe.

You’ll work across the full stack: data ingestion, transformation, storage, APIs, product surfaces, AI workflows, agentic systems, and observability.

What makes you a great fit

You have strong production engineering judgment and can move quickly without compromising reliability, data integrity, and security:

● 8+ years building production software

● Strong experience with TypeScript, React, SQL

● Deep backend architecture, API, data modeling, and production debugging skills

● Significant experience with data pipelines, integrations, or data-heavy systems

● Experience building systems that handle sensitive, regulated, and high trust data

● Production experience shipping robust AI/LLM-powered features

● Strong understanding of evals, hallucinations, malformed outputs, retrieval quality, latency, cost, model drift, and provider risk

● Good judgment about when to use an LLM, when to use retrieval, when to improve the data foundation, and when deterministic code is the better answer

● Excellent written and verbal communication in English

● High ownership

AI safety and security:

● You know how to build AI systems that are useful without being reckless.

● You understand prompt injection, permission boundaries, data exfiltration risk, secrets handling, audit logs, and human in the loop review. You treat model context as untrusted input and design agent systems with scoped tools, explicit permissions, logging, evals, and graceful failure modes.

● Security is non-negotiable. You should be comfortable with access control, Postgres RLS, PII handling, secrets management, audit trails, least privilege, secure integrations, and safe use of third-party APIs.

You’ll be especially strong if:

● You have built sturdy data pipelines customer facing products rely on

● You care about data correctness before AI or dashboards depend on it

● You can trace a bad number across ingestion, transformation, database, API, UI, and AI context

● You think naturally in failure modes: stale data, duplicate events, schema drift, partial writes, bad joins, expired tokens, provider outages, and malformed model outputs

● You have worked in high trust data environments such as finance, investment, legal, healthcare, or enterprise saas

● You have experience with Supabase, Postgres RLS, Deno, Modal, embeddings, vector search, transcription, GPU workloads, or similar infrastructure

● You have worked with data validation, reconciliation, lineage, observability, or audit systems

● You have experience with AI evals, AI observability, agent testing, or red-teaming AI systems

Your day-to-day in this position

You will design and ship production-grade systems that combine software engineering, data infrastructure, and AI, including:

● Building secure, scalable full-stack product features

● Designing data models, APIs, integrations, and backend architecture

● Creating reliable data pipelines with strong validation and observability

● Shipping high value high trust AI/LLM-powered features

● Building safe agentic workflows with scoped tools, permissions, logging, evals, and failure handling

● Debugging issues across ingestion, transformation, database, API, UI, and AI context

● Designing systems with security, privacy, auditability, and observability

Questline Digital, a division of Harris; is seeking a Director of Sales, West Region who is high-performing and will drive revenue growth and expand strategic utility relationships throughout western North America.

This role requires a consultative sales leader who understands software and services sales, marketing technology solutions, concept selling, utility customer engagement strategies, and executive-level relationship development. The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, developing, and closing new business opportunities while expanding relationships with existing customers and strategic partners.

Questline Digital offers a unique set of strategic communication solutions that increase customer engagement for our utility clients. An understanding of digital marketing and the ability to work multi-step, complex sales cycles are essential for this position.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 40%-60%%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. Preference will be given to candidates who can work in PST timezone.

The base salary ranges from $70,000 to $90,000, plus commission. $20,000 is toward the upper end of typical annual commission earnings, but it’s not a cap. You can earn more based on your performance.

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What your impact will be:

  • Own revenue generation and territory expansion throughout the western United States and western Canada.
  • Develop and execute annual territory, account, and growth strategies aligned with company objectives.
  • Generate new business opportunities, expand existing customer relationships, and consistently achieve revenue targets.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts and provide regular business updates to executive leadership.
  • Build and execute strategic account plans and account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns.
  • Develop executive-level relationships with utility leaders, operations teams, customer experience leaders, and procurement stakeholders.
  • Utilize Salesforce, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and related sales technologies to build pipeline and manage opportunities.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of electric, gas, water, IOU, cooperative, and public power utilities.
  • Lead and support RFP, RFQ, and RFI response efforts.
  • Proactively identify and pursue opportunities using procurement intelligence platforms such as GovSpend, BidPrime, TEC, DemandStar, and similar tools.

  • Build strategic relationships with utility associations, technology partners, consultants, and industry influencers.
  • Represent Questline Digital at industry conferences, trade shows, customer meetings, and networking events.
  • Leverage AI tools, workflows, and agents to enhance prospecting, account research, workflow automation, and sales productivity.

What we are looking for:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in regional sales, business development, or enterprise sales.
  • Proven success selling software, SaaS, technology-enabled services, or consultative solutions.
  • Experience within the utility industry and familiarity with utility customer engagement initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success leading RFP, RFI, and proposal response efforts.
  • Experience identifying and tracking opportunities through GovSpend, BidPrime, TEC, or similar procurement intelligence platforms.
  • Experience building account-based marketing strategies and targeted prospecting campaigns.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to travel extensively throughout the assigned territory.
  • Experience selling customer engagement, communications, marketing technology, or digital experience solutions strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of Generative AI applications and workflow automation strongly preferred.

What we can offer:

Questline Digital is a marketing and technology agency that builds engaging experiences throughout the customer journey, boosting program participation and overall satisfaction for utility companies nationwide. Through their proven process, they deliver measurable results with integrated communications strategies that engage, educate, and inspire action.

Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise.
