raw.title: Sr. Manager, K12 Existing Business, Enterprise
raw.excerpt: About Niche Niche is the leader in school search.
raw.description:
About Niche

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.

About The Role

We are looking for a Sr. Manager, Account Management to own gross revenue retention (NRR) across our K12 existing business. You will lead the K12 Account Management team as it takes on larger accounts over time, with the expectation that every account is known intimately.

This role is built for someone who generates and executes ideas to grow customer accounts and retain them at scale. You will also be very proficient with AI tools and use them in core parts of how you work.

What You Will Do

You will own the K12 existing-business number and the ideas that move it.

Own gross revenue retention

  • Own NRR for the K12 existing book: retention plus expansion, blended across all accounts
  • Forecast renewals and expansion accurately, and surface risk early and clearly
  • Partner with Revenue Operations, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to remove obstacles that put retention at risk

Know the accounts intimately

  • Set the expectation that K12 account managers know their accounts deeply, including goals, stakeholders, usage, and risk, as books grow in size and complexity
  • Build and run the cadence of account reviews, renewal planning, and expansion planning across the book
  • Stay close to the largest and most at-risk partners yourself

Generate ideas and execute them

  • Execute very well on the retention and growth ideas the business brings you
  • Come up with your own ideas to retain and grow K12 business, execute them very well, and report back on what you tried and what happened
  • Turn what works into repeatable plays the whole K12 team can run

Lead the K12 Account Management team

  • Set clear expectations and coach account managers to hit their NRR goals, including under the 2027 NRR-only compensation model
  • Develop the team's skills, including their own use of AI tools in daily account work

Work AI-first

  • Use AI tools in core parts of your work, such as account analysis, renewal and expansion planning, customer communication, and reporting
  • Show the team what good looks like and help them build the same habits

Be the voice of the K12 customer

  • Bring customer feedback to Product, Marketing, and leadership to improve the product, packaging, pricing, and the partner experience

During the First Month:

  • Attend onboarding to learn Niche's products, the K12 partner base, and our tools, including Salesforce and Gong
  • Learn the K12 book: the largest accounts, the renewal calendar, and where retention risk sits
  • Meet your team and your partners in Revenue Operations, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success
  • Start using AI tools in your own account work and note where they can help the team

Within 3 Months:

  • Know the largest K12 accounts intimately and hold the conversations with the highest-risk partners yourself
  • Build a NRR forecast across the K12 book with a plan for each at-risk account
  • Bring your first ideas to retain and grow business, execute one end to end, and report what happened

Within 6 Months:

  • Have the team running on clear expectations and a steady account-review cadence, ready for 2027 NRR-only compensation
  • Turn what is working into repeatable plays for the whole K12 team
  • Consistently hit your retention and expansion targets

Within 12 Months:

  • Deliver the K12 existing-business NRR goal
  • Have account managers who know their accounts intimately and use AI tools in daily work
  • Point to ideas of your own that measurably moved retention and expansion, and to customer feedback that shaped product, packaging, or pricing

What We Are Looking For

  • Very inquisitive: you dig into the "why" behind an account's behavior and keep asking until you understand it
  • Very high agency: you spot what needs to happen and make it happen without waiting to be told
  • Highly entrepreneurial and self-starting, with a record of coming up with your own ideas, executing them very well, and sharing what you learned
  • Very high proficiency with AI tools, used in core parts of how you work
  • Experience owning retention and expansion results for a book of business, in SaaS or another subscription business
  • Comfort running a book of larger accounts and knowing each one intimately
  • Comfort in a CRM such as Salesforce and in using data to forecast and prioritize
  • Excellent communication skills, written and verbal
  • Interest in leading and growing a team. Prior people-management experience is a plus, not a requirement

Compensation

Our national target base salary is $119,000, plus uncapped commission and participation in our Stock Option Program. The OTE (On Target Earnings) for this role will be $184,000.

At Niche, our Total Rewards Philosophy is centered around creating a workplace environment that attracts, motivates, and retains top talent by providing a comprehensive and competitive rewards package. This philosophy is built on the principles of performance-based compensation, best-in-class benefits and work-life balance, and employee well-being.

WhyNiche?

  • We are a fully flexible workforce empowering our employees to choose to work remotely, in our Pittsburgh office or whatever combination suits you
  • Full time, salaried position with competitive compensation in a fast-growing company
  • Best-in-class 100% paid employee health plan, including vision and dental and supplemental coverage
  • Flexible Paid Time Off Policy
  • Stipend that allows you to build your work from home office in a style and function that suits your personal preferences
  • Parental leave for all employees (12 weeks fully paid) in addition to short term disability for birthing parents
  • Meaningful 401(k) with employer match
  • Your ideas and work will make an immediate impact on our company and millions of users
  • You will join a team that cares about you, our mission, our work - and celebrates our wins together!

Niche will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future for this opening.

We are currently hiring in states where we currently have employees: AZ, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, LA, ME, MD, MA, MI, MO, NE, NV, NH, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA, DC, WV.

Candidates only. No recruiters or agencies, please. Sorry, we do not offer relocation assistance.

Niche is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. Therefore, we provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.

All interviews are being held remotely. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

raw.description:
The Senior Data Engineer, Data Mgmt and BI will design, build, and support scalable data solutions that enable trusted analytics, operational reporting, and data-driven decision making across the organization. This role will partner closely with product, analytics, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate ambiguous business needs into reliable technical solutions, while helping establish strong engineering standards across data pipelines, cloud platforms, data models, APIs, automation, and observability. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who can work independently, mentor others, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners, and continuously improve how data is delivered, governed, tested, and supported in a fast-moving environment.

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable data pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and publish structured and semi-structured data from internal and external sources.
  • Translate business and product requirements into technical designs, data models, integration patterns, and execution plans that support reliable analytics and operational workflows.
  • Develop reusable, maintainable code using modern data engineering practices, with an emphasis on performance, testability, observability, and long-term supportability.
  • Build and optimize batch, event-driven, and serverless data processing patterns using cloud-native services and distributed processing frameworks.
  • Contribute to architecture decisions across data lake, warehouse, orchestration, metadata, API, and application integration patterns.
  • Implement data quality checks, monitoring, alerting, and operational runbooks to ensure pipelines are accurate, reliable, and supportable in production.
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment workflows, and infrastructure-as-code patterns that improve delivery speed and reduce operational risk.
  • Partner with analytics, BI, product, and business teams to enable timely, trusted, and well-documented data products and reporting solutions.
  • Evaluate source systems, APIs, files, data contracts, and transformation logic to identify risks, dependencies, data gaps, and opportunities for simplification.
  • Participate in Agile delivery practices including sprint planning, backlog refinement, code reviews, release planning, incident response, and retrospectives.
  • Mentor engineers, promote engineering best practices, and help raise the quality bar for code, documentation, testing, and production readiness.
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, data lineage notes, implementation guides, and support materials as systems evolve.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience designing, building, testing, deploying, and supporting production data pipelines.
  • Strong experience with data modeling, data architecture, ETL/ELT patterns, metadata, data quality, and data warehouse or data lake methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data engineering services such as AWS S3, Lambda, Athena, EMR or EMR Serverless, Glue, Step Functions, SNS, SQS, or comparable technologies.
  • Strong programming experience in Scala, Java, SQL, or similar languages used for data processing, automation, and integration.
  • Experience with distributed processing and modern data platforms such as Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Iceberg, Hive, Redshift, Postgres, SingleStore, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, source control workflows, automated testing, and deployment practices using GitHub Actions or similar tools.
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery, DevOps practices, incident response, production support, monitoring, and performance tuning.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex data, application, and platform issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineers, product owners, business stakeholders, and leadership.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience working in media, advertising, streaming, analytics, or other data-intensive business environments.
  • Experience building pipelines that integrate files, APIs, event streams, relational systems, data lakes, and warehouse platforms.
  • Experience with orchestration and workflow tools such as Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, Amazon MWAA, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code, cloud security, IAM, secrets management, and secure engineering practices.
  • Experience with BI and reporting tools such as Tableau, MicroStrategy, Looker, or similar tools.
  • Experience designing performant data models, curated datasets, APIs, or interfaces that support analytics, reporting, and operational decision making.
  • Familiarity with data governance, lineage, observability, data contracts, and production support practices.
  • Ability to operate independently in ambiguous situations, drive clarity, identify dependencies, and move work from concept through delivery.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to balance delivery speed, engineering quality, stakeholder communication, and operational readiness.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, analytics, operations, vendors, and business stakeholders.
  • Curiosity about emerging data engineering, automation, and AI-assisted development practices, with a practical focus on improving engineering productivity and solution quality.

Additional Requirements:

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is a premier company that is dedicated to enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. We are a team of 100,000+ colleagues who share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement. Together, we work to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation, and support patients in need.

Fully remote, full time perm role with full benefits.

What will you do in this role?

The Senior Research Associate drafts protocols, reports, and other project deliverables, interacts with clients, and contributes to strategic thinking under the direction of senior staff. Leads scientific coordination and project management, including project scope, tracking progress, and coordinating team tasks for multiple projects.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (other duties may be assigned):

The Senior Research Associate will bear scientific responsibility for the design and implementation of de novo data collection projects (retrospective, prospective, and/or cross-sectional) under oversight of more senior staff.

In particular, the Senior Research Associate will:

Provide scientific guidance/consultation on scientific methodological and operational considerations of project design and conduct.

Leads or coordinates the development of draft scientific project deliverables (e.g., protocols, analysis plans, case report forms (electronic or paper), survey questions, reports) for senior review.

Engage with project sponsors, physicians, clinical sites, and other relevant contacts.

Assist with monitoring project budget spend and managing timelines for scientific tasks/deliverables.

In some client engagements, serve as Principal Investigator, with final responsibilities for project budget, deliverables, and timelines.

Leads or coordinates the development of abstracts and manuscripts.

Contrbute to the growth of Evidera through business development activities, including support of proposal development, participation in the sales cycle, conference attendance, and presentations.

Support other organizational activities as needed (e.g., supervise and/or mentor junior staff; closely collaborate with other project partners such as clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, and data analysts; contribute to development of training materials and process improvements).

Travel (national and international travel) may be expected.

Consulting Expectations:

Participates in client calls and is expected to be able to address questions posed directly to them about their work.

Contributes to client and/or project strategy under the direction of senior staff.

Managerial Duties: May possibly mentor or manage more junior staff or practice area interns.

Education, Professional Skills & Experience:

PhD (epidemiology or closely related field) or MSc with 3-5 years of relevant experience is required.

Ideally, previous experience in consultancy and/or CRO environment highly desirable.

Experience with de novo data collection (field) projects (non-interventional designs in particular) is preferred.

Good understanding of epidemiologic methodology is required.

Working knowledge of MS Office software; working knowledge of data analysis software (e.g., SAS, Stata, R) a plus.

Fluent in spoken and written Mandarin Chinese

Experience with design of peri- or post-approval late phase interventional projects is not required but would be considered a plus.

Personal Skills & Competencies:

Demonstrated ability to communicate and document information effectively in written English, including the ability to produce scientific reports, presentations, emails and other written deliverables that are well-organized, free from errors, and are appropriately adjusted to the characteristics and needs of the audience.

Strong organizational, time-management, prioritization and decision-making skills necessary to evaluate, plan and accomplish multiple work goals in a timely fashion.

Able to quickly learn and apply new information, skills, and procedures.

Proactive and positive approach to tasks and projects, as well as resilience when encountering process, project, budget or client changes that are inherent in the consulting environment.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills including the ability to quickly develop and sustain positive rapport with internal and external contacts in person, over the phone and by email.

Experience presenting ideas to individuals and groups in a formal presentation setting.

Delivers a positive internal/external client experience; listens and understand the client's needs, and recommends solutions.

Demonstrates sound professional judgment in analyzing, responding to, and resolving enquiries, issues, and escalations.

raw.title: Customer Success & Business Operations Manager
raw.excerpt: Our Mission Buildings account for over a third of greenhouse gas emissions in the US and globally.
raw.description:
Our Mission

Buildings account for over a third of greenhouse gas emissions in the US and globally. The most viable pathway for decarbonizing the built environment is to replace fossil fuel appliances with efficient, electric alternatives (e.g. replacing a gas furnace with a heat pump), and then powering those electric appliances with carbon-free electricity. Billions in incentives are available each year to make upgrades more affordable, yet finding and claiming funds is time-consuming, costly, and risky for potential participants. Furthermore, these programs are expensive to administer for incentive providers. Rock Rabbit delivers an AI-powered API and app to make it fast, easy and reliable for participants to find and claim rebates, tax credits and financing for electrification projects. Rock Rabbit also partners directly with incentive providers to make these programs more equitable and cost-effective to administer. Rock Rabbit integrates the highly fragmented landscape of actors, processes & data to drastically reduce friction across the value chain - ultimately accelerating the rate of building decarbonization.

About The Business

We are building an AI-powered data and workflow SaaS platform to accelerate building decarbonization. Our platform allows for streamlined discovery, application, and ultimately end-to-end management of incentives and financing. With a small team and in only one year, we have built out our core product suite, closed dozens of contracts, been accepted into multiple accelerators, won multiple awards, processed millions of dollars in incentive funds, and attracted top tier venture capital investors. We are now rapidly expanding across the nation.

The Role

  • You’ll strengthen the relationships and own the systems that keep Rock Rabbit growing: every renewal and expansion accelerates building decarbonization.

  • You’ll be a primary partner to our customers from kickoff through renewal: utilities, community choice aggregators, public agencies, equipment manufacturers and distributors.

  • You’ll run core business operations, including planning, budgets, operating rhythms and compliance, as a close partner to our CEO and the leadership team.

  • You’ll work closely with domain experts who have decades of experience in building decarbonization and incentive administration, across our Growth, Analysis & Operations and Product teams, on a high-performing, diverse and mission-aligned team.

  • You’ll report to our VP of Growth and have real autonomy to shape how we manage, grow and support our accounts.

  • You’ll help us achieve scale: building systems, AI automation and processes. As we grow, the role can specialize toward customer success, revenue operations or business operations leadership.

Responsibilities

Account Management & Customer Success

  • Be the day-to-day partner: serve as the main point of contact for our incentive provider and OEM/distributor customers, building trusted relationships at every level

  • Partner on implementations: work alongside our analyst team, who lead program setup and configuration, to keep customer launches on schedule; as the function grows, take on increasing ownership of implementation planning and coordination

  • Partner with Growth on renewals and expansion: convert pilots into long-term contracts, manage renewals, and surface expansion opportunities to the Growth team

  • Drive contractor and distributor activation: design and run programs that get contractors and distributors onboarded, submitting claims, and getting paid through Rock Rabbit

  • Keep revenue data accurate and automated: maintain HubSpot as the source of truth for accounts, contracts and renewals, and build the automated dashboards and reporting on pipeline, renewals and ARR that leadership relies on

Business Operations

  • Run operating rhythms: organize OKRs, leadership meetings, all-hands and team retreats so decisions happen on time with the right information

  • Support planning: maintain headcount and budget plans, cash flow forecasts and burn tracking with our CEO

  • Keep the business running: lead compliance, coordinate contracts, vendor and legal workflows

  • Drive special projects and KPIs: lead cross-company initiatives, such as new tools and process improvements, and track company performance for leadership

About You

  • 6+ years across customer success, account management, revenue operations or business operations at a B2B SaaS or venture-backed company, ideally serving utilities, energy efficiency programs, or the HVAC and building electrification industry

  • AI-native: you use AI tools every day as a core part of how you work, and can show workflows you’ve built yourself, such as automating reporting, account research, meeting follow-ups or CRM updates

  • A track record of retaining and growing accounts: renewals, expansions, and turning pilots into contracts

  • A systems builder: you’ve administered a CRM (HubSpot preferred) and automated the reporting, dashboards and workflows around it, rather than maintaining them by hand

  • Experience coordinating complex, multi-stakeholder implementations, including with public-sector or regulated customers

  • Strong analytical and spreadsheet skills: comfortable building budget trackers, KPI dashboards and simple financial models

  • Process-minded: you set clear expectations, measure against them, and fix the gaps

  • Excellent judgement, trusted with sensitive information, and comfortable switching between customer work and internal operations in the same day

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and calm under pressure with demanding customers

Preferred Qualifications (Not Required)

  • Contracts and vendors: experience managing contract, vendor and legal workflows

  • Channel programs: experience running contractor, dealer or distributor programs or relationships, such as trade ally or midstream incentive programs

Compensation

The U.S. base salary range for this position is $113,000 - $175,000 plus benefits, equity and variable compensation for Sales-related roles. This range represents Rock Rabbit’s good faith estimate of competitively-priced salary for the role based on national, real-time industry data from companies of a similar growth stage. This range reflects minimum and maximum new hire salaries for the role across US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by location and individual factors including relevant skills, experience and education or training. This range correlates to the relative level of the candidate we believe we need for the role and may require an adjustment for candidates of a different level. We can share more about the specific salary range for the location this role is based during the hiring process.

Equal Opportunity Employment

Rock Rabbit is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, or any other legally protected status. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

Salary: 113K - 175K USD a year

raw.excerpt: Description MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.
raw.description:
Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.

We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more.

MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving operational efficiency and clinical quality.

About the AI Receptionist Team:

At MEDvidi, the AI Receptionist Team builds and improves Voice AI Agents that interact directly with patients and automate critical parts of the patient journey.

Our AI systems handle real-world patient conversations across voice and text channels, support operational workflows, and help patients navigate care more efficiently.

The team works on complex patient support scenarios, including prescription-related inquiries, pharmacy communications, patient verification, and operational processes involving healthcare providers.

As these agents become more autonomous and handle increasingly complex interactions, understanding how they behave in production becomes a critical product and business challenge.

We're looking for an AI Product Analyst who can help us evaluate, monitor, and continuously improve these systems.

You'll work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Operations, and AI, helping the team understand how AI behaves in the real world, where it creates value, where it fails, and what should be improved next.

We're building an AI-first team where experimenting with emerging technologies, challenging traditional workflows, and using AI to accelerate everyday work are part of our culture.

Why This Role:

  • Real-world AI impact: Work on one of the most visible AI products inside MEDvidi, directly influencing patient interactions.
  • Shape the future of Voice AI: Help build and improve AI Agents that handle increasingly complex healthcare workflows.
  • AI-first environment: Join a team that actively explores new AI technologies and integrates them into daily workflows.
  • High ownership: Take responsibility for analytical initiatives, from identifying problems to measuring product impact.
  • Fast-moving product culture: Work closely with Product Managers and Engineers, where insights turn into product decisions and improvements.
  • Meaningful challenges: Investigate complex AI behavior, uncover hidden failure patterns, and improve the reliability of systems operating in production.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze production behavior of Voice AI Agents, identifying hallucinations, silent failures, quality issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Investigate call transcripts, logs, and operational data to uncover patterns and actionable insights.
  • Design AI evaluation frameworks and monitor agent quality, reliability, and performance.
  • Build dashboards and monitoring systems to track key product metrics, AI performance, and business impact.
  • Conduct product discovery, hypothesis validation, experiments, and post-release analysis.
  • Leverage modern AI tools to accelerate analytical workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and improve productivity.
  • Deliver timely, actionable recommendations by balancing analytical depth with speed and business priorities.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Operations to drive AI product improvements.

This role is not for you if

  • You prefer working only with structured datasets and predefined metrics.
  • You are uncomfortable analyzing raw conversations, transcripts, and AI-generated outputs.
  • You expect clearly defined answers rather than investigating ambiguous problems.
  • You are not interested in understanding how AI systems fail in production.
  • You rarely use AI tools in your daily work and are not interested in experimenting with new AI-driven workflows.
  • You prefer exhaustive research over delivering timely, actionable insights when speed is critical.
  • You find it challenging to turn complex analytical findings into clear recommendations for product teams.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analytics, or Operational Analytics within complex product environments.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills for data analysis, investigations, and automation.
  • Experience working with ML pipelines or AI-powered products.
  • Understanding of LLM limitations, hallucinations, prompt sensitivity, evaluation challenges, and AI failure modes.
  • Experience building analytical frameworks, monitoring systems, and product dashboards.
  • AI-first mindset: Active use of modern AI tools in daily workflows, with a proactive approach to experimenting with new technologies and improving productivity.
  • Strong product thinking: Ability to independently investigate problems, validate hypotheses, and translate data into actionable product decisions.
  • Speed and pragmatism: Ability to prioritize high-impact opportunities, deliver insights quickly, and balance analytical depth with execution speed.
  • Clear and structured communication: Ability to communicate findings concisely and collaborate effectively with Product Managers and Engineers.
  • Comfortable working independently in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.
  • Fluent Russian and English at B2 level or higher.
  • Ability to work CET-overlapping hours.

Would be a plus

  • Experience with conversational AI, Voice AI, or AI agents.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation, AI quality metrics, and prompt experimentation.
  • Experience analyzing conversation transcripts, unstructured text, or agent execution logs.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered development and analytics tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar.
  • Experience in AI-first startups, healthcare technology, or regulated industries.

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to influence how AI is used in real patient interactions.
  • Growth & compensation: Competitive compensation and clear growth opportunities.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote, long-term B2B collaboration.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Career growth, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 working days of vacation per year, 4 additional wellness days, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for important life events.

If you're a product-minded analyst who enjoys solving complex problems, actively experiments with AI technologies, and wants to improve how AI systems perform in real-world healthcare environments, we'd love to hear from you.

Send us your profile and let's build something meaningful together.

MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Acting as a senior point of resolution for issues beyond frontline Helpdesk scope, you'll respond to technical requests in person (where applicable), by phone, or electronically taking ownership of escalated incidents through to resolution while supporting and developing junior team members.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the primary escalation point for end user issues, client IT staff, and first line Helpdesk personnel requiring advanced technical assistance.

• Respond to escalated incidents and service requests through phone, email, ticketing systems, and direct support interactions.

• Troubleshoot and resolve intermediate to advanced hardware, software, connectivity, account access, and application-related issues in a timely and effective manner.

• Maintain end-to-end ownership of escalated support requests, ensuring timely follow-up, clear communication, and appropriate resolution.

• Document incidents, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and client interactions accurately within the designated support systems.

• Escalate unresolved, high-impact, or specialized issues to the appropriate teams in accordance with established procedures.

• Provide users and stakeholders with clear, professional updates throughout the lifecycle of each support request.

• Assist in root cause analysis for recurring issues and share recommendations that improve service quality and operational efficiency.

• Participate in and adhere to all standard operating procedures, service standards, and departmental policies.

• Support and mentor junior Helpdesk staff by sharing knowledge, reinforcing best practices, and assisting with more challenging issues as needed.

Day-to-Day Expectations On a typical day, this role involves monitoring escalated support requests, troubleshooting advanced technical issues, and coordinating with internal teams or client contacts to move incidents toward resolution. You will gather relevant details, analyze problems methodically, document actions taken, communicate status updates clearly, and ensure each issue is followed through to completion or properly escalated further when necessary. Success in this role requires balancing urgency with accuracy, maintaining professionalism in every interaction, and contributing to a dependable support experience that reflects the standards of the Client Services team.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• Strong customer service, interpersonal, and communication skills. • Ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues efficiently and accurately.

• Working knowledge of desktop and server operating systems, business applications, printers, mobile devices, server hardware, SAAS applications and networking.

• Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users and stakeholders. • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in documenting incidents, escalations, and resolutions.

• Ability to prioritize multiple issues and work effectively in a fast-paced support environment.

• Commitment to following procedures, maintaining professionalism, and delivering a high quality client support experience.

Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate will bring 5+ years of experience in helpdesk, desktop support, escalation support, or technical support environments, with a demonstrated ability to troubleshoot hardware and software effectively. This individual should be comfortable working directly with end users, client IT contacts, and internal support teams while managing multiple priorities and maintaining a service-oriented approach in a fast-paced setting. Relevant industry certifications are a plus.

At Mercury, we’re building banking* for ambitious companies. More than 450,000 businesses use Mercury to manage their finances. In May 2026, we raised $200 million at a $5.2 billion valuation. By then, we’d reached $650 million in annualized revenue and had been profitable for four years.

Sales Development has helped Mercury reach startup founders from their earliest days. As we grow, we’re taking on a new challenge alongside that work. How we earn a conversation with a founder who just raised funding looks different from how we earn one with the owner of an established agency. We’re looking for a Manager, Sales Development who’s excited to help us figure that out and coach a team to do it well.

You’ll hire and develop SDRs, own your team’s pipeline goals, and partner with Account Executives to understand which conversations turn into customers and why. One week, you might coach a rep through a cold call that keeps stalling at the same objection. The next, you might take a message that’s opening doors for one SDR and test whether it works across an entire segment. As the team grows, the people you develop and the playbooks you build will shape how Mercury reaches its next customers.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Here are some things you’ll do on the job:

  • Lead & Coach: Provide high-impact 1:1 coaching to a group of SDRs focused on driving pipeline generation in new verticals. Guide them through LinkedIn, email, and cold call strategies that drive high quality meetings for our AE teams.
  • Pipeline Management: Oversee pipeline health and lead distribution across the team to ensure consistent, qualified opportunity generation.
  • Messaging Ownership: Help build and refine outbound messaging that resonates with our ICP.
  • Conversion Optimization: Identify patterns in high-performing outreach and scale winning tactics to drive better conversion rates across the team.
  • Training & Enablement: Build and lead training sessions on prospecting best practices, objection handling, and effective channel usage.
  • Motivate & Inspire: Be a source of energy and accountability. Create a culture of excellence and continuous improvement on your pod.
  • Cross-functional Partnership: Work closely with Sales, Marketing, and GTM Strategy to align on ICPs, lead prioritization, and campaign execution.

You Should have:

  • 2–3+ years of experience in a Sales Development role within a B2B SaaS environment, with at least 18+ months in a leadership role managing teams of 7+ sales reps – you’re comfortable with a high velocity sales motion and managing all aspects of several SDRs at once.
  • Proven track record of coaching SDRs 1:1 and leading training across cold calls, email, and LinkedIn outreach.
  • Experience managing a large pipeline across multiple reps, able to analyze metrics, prioritize high-value opportunities, and course-correct quickly.
  • Deep understanding of outbound sales strategies and how to drive consistent conversion from prospecting to qualified opportunity.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, can articulate value propositions and give actionable feedback to SDRs.
  • A motivating presence: you uplift those around you, create accountability, and lead by example.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where experimentation and adaptability are key.
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Salesloft, Apollo, Gong, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator plus awareness of new tools/ integrations/ AI use cases to improve SDR efficiency.
  • Having a curious mindset and the ability to quickly ramp up on a new vertical is essential.

Join beqom — where tech meets impact

beqom is a high-growth B2B SaaS company that provides industry-leading tools for pay equity and transparency, compensation, and performance management.

Trusted by some of the world's most respected companies, beqom enables HR and business leaders to navigate global compliance and make smarter pay decisions that attract, retain, and motivate top talent.

Founded in Switzerland and serving clients worldwide, our powerful, enterprise-ready products are fuelled by beqom pay intelligence.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Application Security Engineer to strengthen the security of our SaaS platform within a fast-growing organisation of approximately 250 employees. This role is responsible for embedding security throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring our applications and APIs robustly protect customer data, and enabling engineering teams to ship secure software at pace.

You will act as the go-to application security expert, combining hands-on technical work with developer enablement, and working closely with Engineering, DevOps, Product, QA, and Compliance teams.

What you'll be doing

Secure Development Lifecycle

  • Own and drive the application security programme across the beqom SaaS platform
  • Embed security into the SDLC through threat modelling, secure design reviews, and security requirements
  • Perform secure code reviews and guide engineers on remediating findings
  • Integrate and tune SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets and container scanning in CI/CD pipelines
  • Manage software supply chain security, including open-source dependency risk and SBOMs

Testing & Vulnerability Management

  • Coordinate external penetration tests and responsible disclosure submissions
  • Own application vulnerability management: triage, risk-rate, and drive fixes within agreed SLAs
  • Define secure coding standards aligned with the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP ASVS

Platform & Cloud Security

  • Review and secure APIs, authentication, authorisation, and multi-tenant data isolation
  • Partner with DevOps on cloud-native application security (containers, Kubernetes, IaC) in Azure and AWS

Enablement, Incident Response & Compliance

  • Build and run a Security Champions programme across engineering teams
  • Deliver secure development training for developers and QA
  • Support incident response for application-layer security events, including root-cause analysis
  • Provide application security evidence for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audits

Governance & Customer Engagement

  • Contribute to security policies, standards, and procedures relating to software development
  • Track and report application security metrics and risk posture to leadership
  • Assess the security of new features, third-party integrations, and AI/LLM capabilities
  • Act as the application security subject-matter expert in customer and prospect engagements
  • Participate in customer security reviews, audits, and due diligence calls
  • Respond to the application security sections of customer security questionnaires

Skills & Experience

What you'll bring

  • Excellent, client-facing communication skills and written skills
  • 6+ years of experience in application security, secure software development, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA and secrets-scanning tools (e.g. Checkmarx, Veracode, Snyk, SonarQube, GitHub Advanced Security).
  • Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, OWASP ASVS and common web and API vulnerability classes.
  • Practical experience with threat modelling and secure architecture reviews for cloud-native applications.
  • Ability to read and review code in at least one modern language, ideally C#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript or Python.
  • Experience embedding security into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices.
  • Strong understanding of cloud application security (ideally in Azure and AWS).
  • Experience in the SaaS (Software as a Service) industry.

Bonus points if you have

  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CSSLP, or CISSP.
  • Background as a software developer before moving into security.
  • Experience with container and Kubernetes security and IaC scanning (e.g. Terraform, Bicep).
  • Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2, and GDPR requirements as they apply to software development.
  • Experience running a bug bounty or Security Champions programme.
  • Knowledge of AI/LLM application security risks (e.g. OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications).

About Figure

We’reFigure (Nasdaq: FIGR), and we’re building the future of capital markets with blockchain and AI. We make lending faster and cheaper for everyone by automating the origination process and using blockchain as the source of truth for loan ownership and connection to our capital marketplace.

It’s all one ecosystem that spans three lines of business:

  • Lending: HELOCs, cash-out refinance, DSCR loans, and crypto-backed loans for homeowners, investors, and small businesses. Through Kiavi, a Figure company, we also finance real estate investors with bridge, fix-and-flip, rental, and new construction loans.
  • Markets: On Figure Markets, people can lend and earn with Prime and $YLDS, an SEC-registered, interest-bearing security that settles like cash. OPEN is our blockchain infrastructure for issuing, distributing, and trading equities.
  • Partnerships: Banks, credit unions, fintechs, home improvement companies, and other lenders and brokers originate loans on our platform. DART records loan ownership on blockchain, and Figure Connect connects originators with institutional loan buyers.

See all of our products on figure.com.

Here’s where we are today:

  • $35B+ in equity unlocked for homeowners on Figure’s platform
  • 382K+ households served
  • 800+ B2B partners, including banks, credit unions, and fintechs
  • AAA-rated HELOC securitizations from S&P, KBRA, and Moody’s
  • $23B+ funded for real estate investors through Kiavi since 2013
  • Recognized by CNBC (World’s Top Fintech Companies 2026), Fortune (Crypto 100, 2026), and Inc. (2026 Inc. 5000)

If you want to help build the next era of lending, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We're looking for an Underwriting Manager, Construction to join our growing team! As Underwriting Manager, Construction, you'll serve as the operational bridge across cross-functional teams, driving alignment and execution throughout the loan lifecycle. You'll manage a specialized team of Construction Underwriters and own the construction vertical across policy, process, and product success. You'll be the primary escalation point for complex, stalled transactions, making decisive structural calls to unblock workflows. You'll also structure deals upfront, oversee the pipeline, and drive efficiency and production strategy across alternative product lines, including Multifamily. With a deep understanding of secondary-market expectations, new-construction legal and insurance requirements, and multifamily cash flow analysis, you'll make sure each project is sound at origination, monitored through completion, and ready for a successful loan sale. If you want to own construction lending end to end and are ready to unblock hard deals, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary escalation and resolution point for new construction and multifamily transactions, and as the cross-functional liaison who drives loan progression by resolving complex underwriting and operational requirements
  • Run early deal reviews and structuring consultations with sales to evaluate complex or borderline transactions, structure complex loan scenarios in clear, executable terms beyond standard guidelines, and minimize downstream credit exception requests
  • Oversee pipeline progression, drive workflow efficiencies, and manage production strategies for alternative product lines, including Multifamily and other specialized transaction types
  • Apply rigorous cash flow analysis to multifamily projects, evaluating income, expenses, and stabilization assumptions to confirm each transaction is structured to perform as underwritten
  • Monitor construction projects from origination through final draw, verify milestone requirements are met, and spot projects falling behind schedule or budget early, working with the borrower, sales, and servicing partners to address risks before they become losses
  • Collaborate with Capital Markets on loan sale and diligence requests so construction files are complete, well documented, and aligned with investor and secondary-market expectations
  • Partner with operations and technology teams to close automation gaps and drive the system support needed to optimize cross-functional workflows
  • Contribute to credit policy for the construction vertical, partner with credit risk teams on policy rollouts, align credit guidelines and standard operating procedures, build a continuous feedback loop to resolve operational inconsistencies, and enforce intake guardrails so loan files hold all required documentation before credit review
  • Keep current on jurisdiction-specific legal requirements for new construction and on insurance requirements such as builder's risk coverage, and make sure credit policy and loan documentation reflect them in every market we serve
  • Manage, coach, and mentor a team of specialized Underwriters, with regular feedback, performance evaluations, and strategic workload balancing, and protect our culture by keeping the environment open, communicative, and collaborative, with knowledge sharing and professional development

What We Look For

  • 7+ years of experience in a similar or closely related field
  • 1+ years of experience in people management
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative business or finance discipline (such as Finance, Economics, Accounting, Statistics, or Business Analytics)
  • Demonstrated experience applying quantitative analysis to support business decisions
  • Solid understanding of secondary-market dynamics, including the loan sale process and the diligence standards investors apply to construction loans
  • Familiarity with the geography-specific legal requirements that govern new construction
  • Working knowledge of the nuances of insurance requirements for new construction projects
  • Demonstrated ability to track projects from origination through draws and hold them to milestone requirements
  • Proficiency in cash flow analysis for multifamily property projects
  • Strong working knowledge of property valuation methods and appraisal types, with the ability to guide the valuation process and answer questions from underwriters, sales, risk, and external partners about valuation types, methodology, and how they apply to construction and multifamily transactions
  • Proven ability to quickly master and work expertly in the tools the construction team uses
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude or Copilot, with an automation-first mindset
  • Ability to troubleshoot workflow issues independently and translate between operational needs and technical solutions
  • Experience with Tableau, JIRA, Trust Point, and Appraisal Works (preferred)
  • Experience with Salesforce (preferred)
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
  • Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

Salary

  • Base Compensation Range: $101,600 - $152,400/year
  • 25% annual bonus, paid quarterly
  • Company equity in the form of RSUs

This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans
  • Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits

Role Title: Optomechanical Design Engineer — Precision CNC Parts (Remote)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Fully remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay: $90 -$155/hour

Duration: Initial phase of 20 part packages; production phase to follow

Location: Fully remote, no geographic restrictions

You'll need: 5+ years designing CNC-machined production parts, technical decision authority, and access to parametric CAD software

Your tasks: Author original CAD part packages, and peer review packages from other engineers

micro1 is engaging senior optomechanical and mechanical design engineers to create original CAD part packages for a client project in precision optics and optomechanics. Your engineering judgment is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

Each package is a new part you design from scratch: a difficult, high-value CNC part with a specific machining challenge, backed by a drawing with full GD&T, a design rationale, and a production scenario you justify from experience. Every part is independently reviewed by three other engineers, and you'll review others' work as well.

What you'll do

  1. Design original parts in parametric CAD, delivered as native files plus STEP.
  2. Produce the technical drawing: dimensions, tolerances, GD&T and datums, material and condition, finish, revision, drawing standard.
  3. Write the design context: intended function, interfaces, operating conditions, the machining challenge, and your material and process rationale.
  4. Build the production scenario: estimated unit cost and drivers, CNC cycle and setup hours, assumed volume, sourcing difficulty and lead time — with the engineering basis for each estimate.
  5. Peer review other engineers' packages against technical quality, production realism, and engineering value, with part-specific evidence for every score.
  6. Revise your own packages against review findings.

What we're looking for

  1. 5+ years of production engineering experience with comparable CNC parts, materials and processes in precision optics or optomechanics.
  2. Technical decision authority: you owned or approved critical design choices — drawing, tolerance or material approval, production release, or enforcing engineering quality standards. Design leads, principal and staff engineers, and technical authorities are the profile.
  3. Experience at OEMs or specialist suppliers whose engineering standards you can reproduce.
  4. Strong GD&T and tolerancing judgment, including cost and inspection implications.
  5. Access to parametric CAD software (SolidWorks, NX, CATIA, Creo or similar) and the ability to deliver native files plus STEP.

Role Title: Mechanical Design Engineer — Semiconductor & Vacuum Hardware

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Fully remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay: $90 -$155/hour

Duration: Initial phase of 20 part packages; production phase to follow

Location: Fully remote, no geographic restrictions

You'll need: 5+ years designing CNC-machined production parts, technical decision authority, and access to parametric CAD software

Your tasks: Author original CAD part packages, and peer review packages from other engineers

micro1 is engaging senior mechanical design engineers to create original CAD part packages for a client project in semiconductor and vacuum hardware. Your engineering judgment is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

Each package is a new part you design from scratch: a difficult, high-value CNC part with a specific machining challenge, backed by a drawing with full GD&T, a design rationale, and a production scenario you justify from experience. Every part is independently reviewed by three other engineers, and you'll review others' work as well.

What you'll do

  1. Design original parts in parametric CAD, delivered as native files plus STEP.
  2. Produce the technical drawing: dimensions, tolerances, GD&T and datums, material and condition, finish, revision, drawing standard.
  3. Write the design context: intended function, interfaces, operating conditions, the machining challenge, and your material and process rationale.
  4. Build the production scenario: estimated unit cost and drivers, CNC cycle and setup hours, assumed volume, sourcing difficulty and lead time — with the engineering basis for each estimate.
  5. Peer review other engineers' packages against technical quality, production realism, and engineering value, with part-specific evidence for every score.
  6. Revise your own packages against review findings.

What we're looking for

  1. 5+ years of production engineering experience with comparable CNC parts, materials and processes in semiconductor or vacuum hardware.
  2. Technical decision authority: you owned or approved critical design choices — drawing, tolerance or material approval, production release, or enforcing engineering quality standards. Design leads, principal and staff engineers, and technical authorities are the profile.
  3. Experience at OEMs or specialist suppliers whose engineering standards you can reproduce.
  4. Strong GD&T and tolerancing judgment, including cost and inspection implications.
  5. Access to parametric CAD software (SolidWorks, NX, CATIA, Creo or similar) and the ability to deliver native files plus STEP.
  6. Industry experience, not academic.

Important: originality and IP

Every design must be your own original work. You cannot use designs owned by a current or former employer or customer, and you cannot substitute public or purchased CAD. All deliverables become the client's property. If you're currently employed, check your employment agreement regarding outside work and invention assignment before applying.

About the Role

Turner & Townsend is seeking an experienced Process Improvement Consultant to support operational excellence and business transformation initiatives for a financial services client’s facility construction programs and projects. The successful candidate will work with stakeholders to identify improvement opportunities, optimize processes, enhance performance, and drive sustainable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with experience evaluating processes, implementing improvements, and supporting organizational change. Experience in construction project management within financial services is strongly recommended. This role requires collaboration across multidisciplinary teams to deliver efficient, scalable, and data-driven solutions that align with client and business objectives.

What you'll do

Analyze current business processes and identify opportunities for operational improvement and efficiency.

Facilitate process mapping, workflow analysis and improvement workshops.

Develop and implement process improvement initiatives aligned with business objectives.

Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements, evaluate solutions, and drive adoption of new processes.

Monitor performance metrics and KPIs to measure improvement effectiveness and benefits realization.

Support business transformation, continuous improvement, and organizational change initiatives.

Prepare process documentation, recommendations, reports, and executive presentations.

Identify risks, inefficiencies, and optimization opportunities across business operations.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to standardize processes and promote best practices.

Contribute to knowledge sharing, lessons learned, and continuous improvement programs.

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, Project Management, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in process improvement, business analysis, operational excellence, or consulting.
  • Experience with construction project management programs. Experience with financial services client facility construction desired.
  • Experience with process mapping, workflow optimization, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Thorough knowledge of the project management lifecycle for commercial real estate.
  • Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, or other process improvement frameworks preferred.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Experience supporting business transformation and change initiatives.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Visio are required.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, PMP, or equivalent certification preferred.

*SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs*

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this, we promote a healthy, productive, and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

raw.title: Senior Product Designer, Growth
raw.excerpt: About Upstart At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans.
raw.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart's Lending Experience design team crafts the borrower experience from the moment someone selects "Check My Rate" through application and verification to a funded loan. Our team's goal is to build a frictionless user experience that adds clarity, builds trust, and makes borrowing faster and more effortless. Working closely with cross-functional partners, we design and ship experiments that drive product-led growth.

As a Senior Product Designer at Upstart, you will deliver new features and improve existing experiences across the borrower journey with a focus on growth, defining how borrowers apply, verify, and compare their loan options. You will define the funding experience, drive experimentation, and work hand in hand with product, data, and engineering to turn model outputs into choices people understand and can act on, helping each borrower reach their financial goals.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Design product features end to end across the borrower journey, on mobile and responsive web
  • Define product-led growth experiments with product and engineering, defining hypotheses, designing A/B tests, and iterating on qualitative and quantitative data to drive measurable outcomes
  • Design how rates, amounts, terms, and loan products are presented so the best option for each borrower's context is clear
  • Ensure our solutions are user-centered by drawing on research and borrower insights, running usability studies, and partnering with the UXR team
  • Use AI tools across your workflow to explore directions, prototype, and test sooner, applying judgment to raise quality, not only speed
  • Share work early and often, present design rationale to product and business leaders, and keep experiences accessible, compliant, and consistent with the shared design system

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, shipping customer-facing digital products
  • Experience using data to identify design opportunities, measure performance, shape experiments, and iterate on designs based on results
  • Expertise in modern design tools, including Figma, user research platforms, and AI-powered prototyping tools
  • A portfolio showing end-to-end work on mobile and responsive web, from initial concept to measurable outcome

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience on financial products, especially lending or other regulated consumer products
  • Experience in consumer engagement, growth, and funnel optimization, including onboarding and conversion flows
  • Experience designing AI or ML-driven experiences such as personalization, recommendations, or explainable model outputs
  • Experience on multi-phase, long-term initiatives, or on multi-product and marketplace experiences
  • Ability to translate research, borrower needs, and product data into design decisions, and to present rationale to leaders while advocating for borrowers within business and technology constraints
  • Experience in a collaborative, fast-paced agile environment, and knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG)

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Time zone requirements The team operates on the East/West coast time zones.

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range
$162,100—$224,500 USD

What you'll love

At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly
  • Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)
  • Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.
  • Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)
  • Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security
  • Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements
  • Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)
  • Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources
  • Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)
  • Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you
  • Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from
  • Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)
  • Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City

For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec.

Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices.

Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As an Executive Assistant, you are responsible for providing high-level administrative and operational support to assigned executive leaders. You serve as a trusted partner who helps optimize executive effectiveness through proactive calendar management, meeting coordination, travel planning, communications support, and cross-functional collaboration. This role requires strong judgment, professionalism, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Responsibilities

  • Manage complex executive calendars across multiple time zones, including prioritization of meetings, scheduling conflicts, and shifting business priorities
  • Coordinate internal and external meetings, leadership reviews, team events, and other business activities
  • Arrange domestic and international travel, including itineraries, accommodations, transportation, and expense coordination
  • Prepare and organize meeting agendas, presentations, materials, and follow-up actions
  • Support day-to-day operational needs of assigned executive leaders to ensure efficient workflow and execution
  • Track action items, deadlines, and key deliverables to help maintain alignment and accountability across stakeholders
  • Maintain organized records, documentation, and filing systems as needed
  • Handle confidential and sensitive information with a high degree of discretion and professionalism
  • Serve as a point of contact between executive leaders and internal or external stakeholders
  • Draft, proofread, and edit correspondence, presentations, reports, and other business communications
  • Build strong working relationships across teams and functions to support collaboration and execution
  • Exercise sound judgment in prioritizing requests, resolving scheduling challenges, and escalating issues when appropriate
  • Support planning and coordination of executive meetings, offsites, and cross-functional events
  • Leverage productivity and AI-enabled tools to improve organization, efficiency, communication, and administrative workflows

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience supporting executives within a SaaS, technology, or high-growth organization
  • Located in the Dallas Fort Worth metropolitan area; available for onsite meetings as needed
  • Ability to travel up to 25% in support of company meetings
  • 4+ years of experience with a corporate travel booking and reimbursement tool, Navan preferred
  • 4+ years of experience coordinating executive-level meetings, offsites, or cross-functional initiatives
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to work independently, adapt quickly, and manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Experience coordinating complex calendars, travel arrangements, meetings, and executive communications
  • Proficiency with collaboration and productivity tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Office Suite, Slack, and related business applications
  • Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, etc.) to accelerate and elevate your outcomes; including but not limited to communication drafting, data analysis, prompt engineering, and/or documentation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience

Travel Required

Up to 25%

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

  • Partner with the leading brands and retailers.
  • Connect with passionate professionals who will help support your goals.
  • Participate in an inclusive, welcoming work atmosphere.
  • Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days.
  • Receive industry-competitive compensation and total rewards benefits.

We believe in transparency and fairness in our compensation practices.

For this position, the expected base pay range is: $85,000 - $130,000 per year.

This range represents the base pay for the role across all U.S. locations and is determined based on market data, internal equity, and experience. Final compensation may vary depending on geographic location, skills, and relevant experience.In addition to base pay, we offer a discretionary bonus for non-sales roles, a comprehensive benefits package, and, where applicable, sales incentives.

For this position, the expected discretionary bonus is 10% of the annual base salary.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision benefits: Affordable health care plans and company HSA contributions, starting on Day 1
  • A 6% 401(k) match
  • Competitive time off package with 20 days of Paid Time Off, 10 Company-Paid holidays, 2 paid floating holidays, 7 paid sick days, 2 Wellness days, and 1 Paid Volunteer Day; at 3 years of service PTO increases to 22 days, and at 5 years it increases to 25 days
  • 12 weeks primary caregiver leave & 4 weeks secondary caregiver leave
  • Accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance
  • Pet insurance
  • Legal assistance and identity theft insurance plans
  • Company paid Life and AD&D insurance, 2x salary each
  • Access to the Calm app and the Employee Assistance Program
  • $65/month Remote work stipend
  • Peer-to-peer recognition tool; earn points to redeem for gift cards, swag, and more
  • Culture and team-building activities
  • Tuition assistance
  • Career development opportunities
  • Charitable contribution match, up to $250 per year

Rithum is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other protected characteristic. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations in accordance with the law for qualified applicants. If you require assistance during the interview process due to a medical condition or need support accessing our website or completing the application process, please reach out to us by completing the Accommodations Request Form. Your comfort and accessibility are important to us, and we're here to ensure a seamless experience as you explore opportunities with our team.
