raw.description:
Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

About us

Founded in 1996, Argos Multilingual is a global provider of technology-enabled language, AI and data solutions. We combine human expertise, technology and AI to help organisations communicate, operate and grow across markets.

We work with some of the world’s most recognised companies, from global technology leaders and e-commerce innovators to major organisations in life sciences and manufacturing. Our clients operate at significant scale, giving our people the opportunity to work on complex, high-impact projects.

With 400+ people across 42 countries, cultures and time zones, we are a truly international organisation. We are continuing to expand our capabilities in AI and data alongside our established language and localisation expertise, building on a strong foundation while embracing the opportunities created by new technology.

About the role

Few L&D roles give you the chance to reimagine an entire training library with AI and modern tools. This one does. As our L&D Specialist, you’ll turn fresh ideas into courses people actually want to take, creating learning faster and, above all, building real capability across our workforce. You’ll be one of a two-person L&D team reporting directly to our SVP HR (Head of HR), with real independence and the backing to try new approaches. What you build will shape how hundreds of colleagues learn and grow.

What you'll do

  • Rebuild and modernise our training library with innovative content, recommending what to update, redesign or retire, and drive continuous improvement by tracking industry trends and internal metrics and testing new formats and tools.
  • Plan, organise and deliver training of all kinds, including technical training: build e-learning courses, live sessions, workshops, manuals and knowledge resources in line with the annual L&D plan, and keep them up to date as our tools and processes change.
  • Manage the day-to-day administration of our LMS (currently TalentLMS) and maintain the compliance training matrix, tracking completion and keeping evidence ready for internal and external ISO audits.
  • Coordinate and deliver onboarding training for new hires, and keep improving how we bring people up to speed.
  • Measure impact using models such as Kirkpatrick, run training needs and satisfaction surveys, track L&D KPIs and report clearly to the SVP HR and stakeholders.
  • Manage several training projects at once, building strong working relationships with product owners, managers and subject-matter experts, and coaching internal experts to deliver training well (train-the-trainer).
  • Work closely with the HR team on wider initiatives, such as system implementations and documentation, and take on other related duties as assigned to support HR, L&D and organisational goals.

Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on L&D experience in a global organisation, in any industry (technology preferred).
  • Strong experience administering an LMS, LXP or similar platform.
  • Proven experience building e-learning and delivering live training, grounded in learning design principles.
  • Hands-on experience using AI and modern authoring tools to build learning content (for example Articulate 360, Synthesia, Vyond or Camtasia).
  • Comfortable turning learning data into clear reports and insights.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Nice to have: TalentLMS, ISO compliance training, train-the-trainer programmes or evaluation models such as Kirkpatrick.
  • No localisation experience needed.

Who You Are

  • Dynamic and solutions-driven: you spot what isn’t working, fix it and get things moving.
  • A strong critical thinker who questions how things are done today, learns fast and takes initiative.
  • An owner who takes accountability for your work from start to finish.
  • Great at prioritising: you focus on what matters most and stay organised and detail-minded when plans change.
  • A clear, confident communicator who can influence managers and stakeholders at all levels.
  • Genuinely curious about how AI and new tools can make learning more effective and personalised.
  • Passionate about helping people reach their full potential.

Location

Argos is a remote-first, globally distributed organisation, with offices in seven countries, and we currently hire in 42 countries globally. This is a remote-based role, and you must have the legal right to work in your country. We do not provide sponsorship.

Why Join Us

You’ll be joining Argos at an important point in our growth and transformation. We have almost 30 years of experience and an established global client base, but we’re not interested in simply maintaining what we’ve built.

Our industry is changing rapidly. AI, data and technology are reshaping language and localisation, and we’re embracing that change by investing in new capabilities, exploring new ways of working and continuing to evolve our offering.

As part of a global, remote-first organisation, you’ll work with colleagues across countries, cultures and time zones, with the opportunity to learn from different perspectives and contribute to work with an international reach.

We offer the scale and stability of an established global business, combined with the opportunity to influence how we operate and where we go next. If you want to use your experience, challenge thinking and make a visible contribution rather than simply maintain the status quo, Argos offers the opportunity to do exactly that.

Please check our Privacy Policy to find out more about who is administrator of your personal data after application, purposes and your rights.

The Senior Counsel, Global Compliance Investigations - APAC is responsible for leading and conducting complex internal investigations across the Asia-Pacific region and supporting significant matters elsewhere in Danaher's global portfolio as business needs require.


Based in Singapore, the role will provide experienced regional legal judgment, hands-on investigative leadership, and practical advice on matters involving multiple jurisdictions, languages, legal systems, and cultural contexts.


This position reports to the Associate General Counsel, Global Compliance Investigations and is part of the Corporate Ethics & Compliance organization located in Singapore. The Senior Counsel will serve as the senior investigations lawyer for the APAC region and will work closely with Corporate, Platform and operating company Legal and Compliance teams and with Finance, Human Resources, Internal Audit, Quality/Regulatory, and business leaders.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Lead and conduct complex internal investigations across APAC, including special and highly sensitive matters that may develop into government, regulatory, litigation, or other external-facing matters, involving significant misconduct, financial integrity, accounting and controls, executive allegations, retaliation, anti-corruption, conflicts of interest, channel partner conduct, and other legal or compliance risks.
  • Develop and execute investigation strategies, including scoping, privilege and data-privacy considerations, document and data review, witness interviews, factual and legal analysis, findings, reporting, and resolution; escalate significant risks promptly and provide practical, risk-based advice that accounts for local law and practice while supporting consistent enterprise standards across jurisdictions.
  • Drive root-cause analysis and partner on corrective actions, disciplinary recommendations, remediation, control enhancements, and lessons learned; support follow-through and effectiveness review for significant matters.
  • Select, retain, direct, and manage local outside counsel, forensic specialists, translators, and other service providers for internal investigations within the Global Compliance Investigations remit, ensuring quality, efficiency, and accountability. When an internal investigation develops into, overlaps with, or informs a government, regulatory, litigation, or other external-facing matter, partner with the litigation and disputes team and other responsible counsel to coordinate responsibilities, preserve investigative continuity, and support the matter in alignment with the counsel overseeing the external response.
  • Strengthen APAC investigations capability, standard work, case quality, data and trend analysis, and effective deployment of resources based on risk, complexity, legal requirements, and language needs; contribute to the broader global portfolio by sharing regional insights and relevant legal and compliance developments to promote learning and continuous improvement across Danaher.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Qualified lawyer or solicitor in good standing in Singapore or another relevant common-law jurisdiction, with eligibility to work as legal counsel in Singapore.
  • Long-standing relevant legal experience leading complex internal, government, regulatory, white collar, or compliance investigations, including substantial cross-border experience in the Asia-Pacific region.
  • Demonstrated experience navigating multi-jurisdictional legal, data-privacy, employment, regulatory, and cultural considerations in sensitive investigations and advising senior leaders on risk.
  • Experience in a leading law firm, government enforcement or regulatory agency, prosecutor's office, and/or in-house legal department.
  • Professional fluency in English

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to travel approximately 30-40% within APAC and internationally, including overnight travel, based on business needs.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Prior in-house experience at a global public company and/or experience in life sciences, diagnostics, biotechnology, healthcare, medical technology, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Professional proficiency in an additional APAC language and experience with financial integrity, accounting and controls, anti-corruption, channel management, quality/regulatory, or auditor-facing investigations.

We are seeking an experienced software developer who is passionate about artificial intelligence, machine learning, and large language models. As a software developer, you will be responsible for designing and implementing innovative solutions that address complex problems using cutting-edge technologies. You will work with a team of experts in AI, machine learning, and natural language processing to develop and implement solutions that meet the needs of our ICF client.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Python, with experience in developing and deploying scalable applications. You will be expected to have a deep understanding of these programming languages and be able to use them effectively to develop, optimize, and deploy AI and machine learning models and processes. Additionally, you should have experience with cloud-based platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and be familiar with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

At our organization, we value continuous learning and encourage our team members to stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning. As such, we are looking for someone who is passionate about learning new technologies and exploring new ways to solve complex problems. ICF has deep relationships with commercial businesses that will get you up to speed with the most cutting edge technologies re: AI/ML and LLMs. If you are a self-starter with a strong work ethic and a desire to make a meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years hands-on experience with neural networks, machine learning algorithms, or related.
  • 3+ years hands-on experience with structured/unstructured databases.

Working at ICF

raw.description:
The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

The Granicus Experience Group (GXG) is Granicus’ in-house digital agency, a cross-functional team of strategists, analysts, communicators and Granicus technology experts focused on customer experience and digital communications. We leverage best-in-class human-centered practices and a design-thinking approach to help our federal, state and local government customers better connect with the people they serve. We discover better insights, build better experiences, and achieve better outcomes. 

GXG is a fast-growing agency at a high-growth tech company, seeking a Communications Coordinator for our Communications Practice Area to contribute to the design, development, and delivery of omnichannel campaigns and content to fit the unique needs of our customers. Our Communications Practice Area collaborates closely with our practitioners in experience design and data analysts to assess and improve the effectiveness of our programs over time

Candidates will have experience developing content for multichannel campaigns and/or websites, analyzing data to inform decisions, and working on large-scale or program-level projects for customers, preferably for government.

Communications Coordinators support the key message development, evaluation of current customer content and identification of optimization opportunities. They support efforts to develop, deliver and manage customers’ account configuration solutions to support outreach requirements for segmentation and personalization, aligned to reporting needs. Coordinators support the development of campaign plans, A/B testing, campaign building, segmentation, and outreach tracking strategies.

Candidates must have a desire to be part of a data-driven, customer-focused, fast-paced team that loves the mission of improving the citizen experience and providing world-class service to government customers.

Who We Are:

  • Digital content creators and strategists, applying best practices to key message development, evaluation of current client content, and identifying optimization opportunities.

  • Data-driven thinkers, grounding our insights and recommendations for growth in measurable data and context.

  • Human-centered design practitioners, understanding best practices, regardless of technology or use case, and always putting people at the center of our solutions.

  • Innovators, leveraging design-thinking and other frameworks to keep our work fresh and help our customers adopt a mindset for change. We drive toward success with a spirit of experimentation and agility.

How We Show Up to Work:

  • Demonstrate a polished, professional relationship with colleagues & customers.

  • Assume positive intent.

  • Be collaborative. Create space for and be open to different expertise and experiences.

  • Be dependable and reliable for our customers and our colleagues.

  • Be organized and manage your own workload.

  • Be proactive. Be willing to jump in, not wait to be told.

  • Be willing to try something new, not dependent on documented examples.

  • Be empathetic. Consider the human experience, needs and motivations of our customers and our colleagues.

  • Be open to feedback. Listen with the same passion with which you want to be heard.

  • Be curious. Gather information and knowledge. Consider new ideas and approaches. Consider what you might not know.

Security Requirements:

  • Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.

  • Must be able to obtain a federal government public trust clearance.

Responsibilities:

  • Support digital campaign execution for public sector clients. Execute across Granicus’ evolving suite of digital products, with a heavy focus on delivery across email, social media, SMS, and websites.

  • Draft and send content for clients’ various email, SMS, social media, and web-based campaigns aligned to best practices for each communication channel

  • Participate in developing, delivering and managing technical solutions to support outreach requirements, aligned with reporting needs

  • Maintain proactive approaches to executing customer projects, demonstrating initiative, and following best practices.

  • Become an expert on Granicus products and future product development by keeping abreast of new and upcoming enhancements to our platform.

Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of digital campaign support, preferably in a digital/social media company serving government or at a government agency.

  • Solid written, verbal and presentation skills, with a passion for creative campaigns and content, preferably with customer-facing experience

  • Ability to create content across email, SMS, social and web, guided by best practices for A/B testing, using data to inspire content, and engagement-driving efforts

  • Understand and use digital tools, technologies, and trends, then leverage those for customer success

  • Consistently perform against simultaneous projects in a fast-paced environment

  • Ability to be flexible in a changing work environment and to work well under pressure 

  • Enthusiasm for working with government. Passionate about public service, citizen engagement and all things digital 

  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment while demonstrating strong personal initiative and on-time delivery of project tasks and deliverables. 

  • Maintain awareness and understanding of government news, as well as digital communications and industry developments that apply to the position and responsibilities.

  • Be hungry and passionate, have a collaborative spirit and be committed to making a difference with communications and collaboration.

  • Due to security requirements, this position is currently open only to U.S. citizens. Additionally, you must have been a resident of the U.S. during at least three (3) of the last five (5) years. Exceptions are possible for applications who worked for the U. S. Government as an employee overseas in a Federal or military capacity; and/or been a dependent of a U.S. Federal or military employee serving overseas. Such applicants must be able to provide state-side reference coverage. State-side coverage information is required to make a suitability or security determination.

  • Prior to the shutdown for the Covid-19 pandemic, GXG staff were expected to be available for on-site customer meetings with our federal, state and local customers. This included travel in some instances. As our customers' expectations and responses to the pandemic continue to evolve, GXG team members may once again be expected to be available for in-person customer and internal meetings.

Pay Range

USD $48,000.00 - USD $55,000.00 /Yr.

About Us

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

Security and Privacy Requirements

  • Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
  • Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.

The Team

  • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Culture

  • At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to bea part of our journey.
  • A few culture highlights include – Employee Resource Groups to encourage diverse voices
  • Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important andsometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work-life balance and current affairs.
  • Microsoft Teams communities focused on wellness, art, furbabies, family, parenting, and more.
  • We bring in special guests from time to time to discuss issues that impact our employeepopulation

The Impact

  • We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here.

The Benefits

At Granicus, we offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance—starting from day one. Here’s what you can expect as a U.S.-based team member:

Flexibility & Balance

  • Flexible Time Off – Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and live your life.
  • Company-Wide Wellbeing Days – Paid days off to unplug and focus on your mental health.
  • Work From Home Reimbursement – Support a productive home office environment.
Health & Wellness
  • Multiple Health Plan Options – Including a 100% employer-paid plan.
  • Employer HSA Contributions – When enrolled in a High-Deductible Health Plan.
  • Fitness Reimbursement Program – Stay active, your way.
  • On-Demand Mental Health Support – Access to Headspace and other wellness tools.
Family & Future
  • Paid Parental Leave – For both birthing and non-birthing parents.
  • Traditional & Roth 401(k) – With a generous company match.
  • Life & AD&D Insurance – 100% employer-paid coverage for peace of mind.
Growth & Recognition
  • Online Learning Platforms – Fuel your professional development.
  • Competitive Salary & Bonuses – Your contributions are valued and rewarded.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Granicus is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants and employees will be considered for employment and advancement without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, age, genetic information, sexual or affectional orientation, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, familial status, military or veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law.

raw.description:
Role Title: English Language Expert (Nigeria)

Role Type: Contract

Location: Nigeria, Remote

Scope of Work

  • Listen to multi-speaker conversational audio recordings, identifying and tagging key speaker and audio metadata such as dialect, accent, audio quality, background noise, age, and speaking style.

  • Annotate and correct first-pass ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) transcripts, ensuring precise application of Nigerian English spelling, usage, and conventions.

  • Utilize your knowledge of Nigerian accents, shaped by the mother tongues and regional varieties across the country, including Yoruba-influenced English, Igbo-influenced English, Hausa-influenced English, Edo English, Ijaw English, Efik English, Tiv English, and Nigerian Pidgin-influenced English, to accurately identify and categorize dialectal features.

  • Apply your knowledge of Nigerian English vocabulary, idioms, slang, code-switching (such as English-Pidgin or English-Yoruba mixing), and spelling to enhance the linguistic accuracy of project data.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Fluent proficiency in Nigerian English, with demonstrated familiarity across multiple dialects and regional accents.

  • Background in language teaching, linguistics, transcription, editing, translation, journalism, or a related discipline.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a meticulous approach to language variation and usage.

  • Ability to distinguish subtle differences in Nigerian English pronunciation and vocabulary across regions and ethnic groups.

  • Experience working with audio data, metadata tagging, or transcription practices is beneficial.

  • Adaptable, detail-oriented, and able to manage complex annotation guidelines independently.

  • Interest in linguistic technology, AI training, or language data projects is a plus.

raw.title: Medical Director, Clinical Communications
raw.excerpt: About Lantern Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most.
raw.description:
About Lantern

Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. By curating a Network of Excellence comprised of the nation's top specialists for surgery, cancer care, infusions and more, Lantern delivers excellent care with significant cost savings to employers and their workforces. Lantern also pairs members with a dedicated care team, including Care Advocates and nurses, for the entirety of their care journey, helping them get back to good health, back to their families and back to work. With convenient access to specialists nationwide, Lantern means quality care is within driving distance for most. Lantern is trusted by the nation's largest employers to deliver care to more than 6 million members across the country. Learn more about us at lanterncare.com.

Medical Director, Clinical Communications

Lantern is looking for a Medical Director, Clinical Communications to join our Clinical team as the external voice of specialist qualification. Lantern operates a specialty care network built on a simple promise to clients and members: every specialist in our Network of Excellence has been evaluated, by procedure, against evidence-based clinical standards. The Clinical team sets those standards, runs the Qualification Committee, and is investing in the tooling and process that make qualification faster and more consistent for practices.

As that investment matures, the part of the process that will always require a human is the conversation with practices: explaining what we evaluate and why before a group applies, delivering approvals and procedure-level decisions clearly and respectfully, and giving groups that receive an adverse finding a credible explanation and a fair path to respond.

In this role you will own how qualification is explained, how decisions are delivered, and how practices experience the process. You will also bring the Clinical perspective into provider conversations and select client meetings and collaborate with the Provider Network team to educate and set our partner practices up for success. This is a Director-level individual contributor role, accountable for the entire qualification engagement function, with the potential to lead qualification operations staff as the function scales. This role suits two kinds of candidate: a seasoned credentialing, medical staff, or provider network leader, or a physician or surgeon ready to move from direct patient care into a high-impact role shaping network quality. What the role requires is credibility with surgeons and the judgment to deliver difficult clinical decisions well.

Location: Remote

Responsibilities:

Qualification decision communications:

  • Deliver every qualification, requalification, and standing-change decision to practices and specialists, including full approvals, procedure-level approvals, holds pending information, denials, and removals from the network.
  • Translate Qualification Committee reasoning into clear, accurate, clinically literate written and verbal communication that a practice administrator and a surgeon can both act on.
  • Own the adverse-finding workflow: request documentation or clarification from practices, track responses, bring complete information back to the Committee, and close the loop within defined service levels.
  • Handle pushback with composure and consistency, explaining the rationale and the published guideline review process, and escalate to the Associate CMO only when a case warrants clinical judgment beyond the guidelines.
  • Maintain the correspondence record so that any decision and its communication history can be reconstructed and audited.

Practice and specialist education:

  • Build and maintain the practice-facing explanation of qualification at Lantern: the seven quality domains we evaluate, the data sources we use, what the thresholds mean, and what a practice should expect at each stage.
  • Lead qualification overview conversations with prospective and newly contracted practices so that groups understand requirements before they invest effort and unqualified candidates are identified before contracting rather than after.
  • Set the qualification standard for Provider Success Managers, d so that they can answer first-line questions accurately and own the practice relationship without routing routine questions to Clinical.
  • Communicate guideline changes to affected practices and specialists, including re-evaluation pathways when standards evolve.

Qualification process operations:

  • Own the workflow from Committee decision to delivered communication, including letter generation from Prism, tracking, and turnaround reporting against the five-business day target from submission to decision.
  • Coordinate the Qualification Committee agenda and decision record in partnership with the Clinical Quality Manager and ensure the handoff to Network for placeability is clean and timely.
  • Capture and triage practice feedback.
  • Define and report the metrics that show whether the process is working.

Clinical representation on provider and client conversations:

  • Serve as the Clinical representative on provider calls that require clinical context, including qualification questions, clinical escalation feedback to practices, and specialist-facing quality discussions, with defined criteria for when a physician leader should join.
  • Represent the Clinical team on select commercial pitches and client conversations.

Function leadership:

  • Set the strategy, operating model, and service levels for qualification engagement, build the staffing case as volume grows, and represent the function in leadership forums alongside the Clinical team
  • Expected mix once ramped: roughly 70 to 80 percent qualification and practice-facing work, 20 to 30 percent provider and client representation. Commercial representation begins after the first 90 days.

Requirements:

  • You are a physician or surgeon (MD or DO), looking to apply your clinical judgment beyond direct patient care.
  • Credibility with surgeons. You command the respect of surgeons and practice leaders and can deliver difficult, clinically grounded decisions in a way that lands and keeps the relationship intact. We expect this to come from one of two backgrounds:
  • Exceptional communication. You write clearly and precisely, you explain complex criteria without jargon or condescension, and you can hold a hard conversation with a surgeon or practice executive and leave the relationship intact.
  • High emotional intelligence and judgment. You understand what a qualification decision means to a surgeon's identity, income, and reputation. You can be empathetic and firm at the same time, and you know when to listen, when to explain, and when to escalate.
  • Clinical literacy. Working knowledge of surgical specialties and procedures, how surgical practices operate, how surgeons are trained and credentialed, and how practice administrators, schedulers, and billing teams interact with payers and networks.
  • Independent problem solving and project management. You run multi-step processes with many stakeholders, track details without being asked, and improve the process rather than only operating it.
  • Comfort with data and tools. You can read a data-driven profile, understand what a volume threshold or an outcome metric means, spot an error before it reaches a practice, and work fluently in Microsoft 365 and modern software tools, including AI-assisted drafting with appropriate review.
  • Integrity under pressure. You hold the standard when a practice, a colleague, or a commercial deadline pushes for an exception, and you route that pressure into the proper review process.
  • Leadership and influence. You have set strategy for a function or program, influenced senior leaders and physicians without formal authority, and are ready to build and lead a team, or to grow into that as the function scales.

Strong Candidates will:

  • Have a clinical background: experience beyond direct patient care, such as medical directorship, utilization or peer review, committee or quality work, or clinical research.
  • Have built enablement or training materials for field or account teams.
  • Have presented to employer benefits leaders, consultants, or health plan audiences.
  • Be energized by building a function from the ground up with new tooling, and act with urgency and precision when a practice or a member is waiting on an answer.

Benefits

  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Short & Long Term Disability
  • Life Insurance
  • 401k with company match
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave

Compensation: Base salary range: $260,000 to $280,000 plus bonus potential depending on relevant experience, location, and qualifications.

About You:

  • You use LOGIC in your decision making and understand that progress is critical to making change. You focus on the execution of your content while balancing a fast-paced environment and you take the time to celebrate both the small & big wins.
  • INCLUSION is a core tenant of your personal beliefs. A diverse and inclusive environment is incredibly important to you. You understand and desire to be a part of a diverse team with different experiences and perspectives & you cherish the differences in each individual that you interact with.
  • You have the GRIT, drive and ambition to tackle big problems. Big problems require big ideas and a team that supports new ideas.
  • You care deeply for your customers are driven to keep HUMANITY in all decisions. Your customers aren’t just the individuals using your product. They are the driving factor in your motivation to make a change.
  • Integrity guides you in life. Focusing on the TRUTH vs. giving people the answers they want to hear.
  • You thrive in a Team Environment. Collaboration is key in innovation and creating change.

These pillars of LIGHT are a reminder to our team that we are making a difference by providing guidance and support in navigating the often complex and confusing landscape of healthcare. We hope that through this LIGHT, individuals can find their way to the best care, resources, and support they need to get back to life.

If this sounds like you, we would love to connect to speak further about career opportunities at Lantern.

Please apply to our role & someone from our Talent Acquisition Team will reach out to help you navigate our interview process.

Lantern does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits.

About Pacvue

Pacvue is the leading Commerce Media OS, powering over $12B in advertising spend across 100+ global retail media networks including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Instacart, Criteo, and CitrusAd. Powered by industry-leading AI and real-time data, Pacvue enables over 70,000 brands and agencies to maximize advertising performance, drive incrementality, and expand reach across the commerce universe from a single mission control. As of 2025, Pacvue powers 12% of total retail media ad spend worldwide delivering the industry’s most comprehensive platform for businesses of all sizes.

At Pacvue, great careers don’t just happen — they’re built. Here, you’ll rise as an industry leader, push the boundaries of innovation, own your journey, and thrive as part of an inclusive global community that’s redefining the future of commerce.

About the Role

The Business Development team is the outbound engine of Pacvue's GTM business. You'll generate and qualify sales opportunities through outbound and inbound prospecting, book meetings, nurture leads, run first-call discovery, and partner with Account Executives and Account Managers to build pipeline with senior retail media, ecommerce, marketing, and agency leaders. This is a builder role: you'll help shape the playbook as well as run it.

This role suits a driven, ambitious, curious self-starter who is hungry to make an impact. Prior sales experience is helpful but not required. What matters most is persistence, sharp research, and a genuine interest in how businesses make decisions. Training and support are provided, and there is ample opportunity to learn, grow, and make a real impact on the [Region] business.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and prioritize your own territory across multiple account tiers and segments, adapting outreach approach based on account type
  • Follow up on all inbound, campaign, and event-sourced leads within defined SLAs so no qualified demand goes unworked
  • Independently judge which leads meet qualification criteria and hand off accepted opportunities directly to AEs, adjusting your pitch based on fit and timing without pre-handoff review
  • Build and execute multi-touch sequences across email, phone, and LinkedIn, tailored to stakeholder roles such as Head of eCommerce, Retail Media Manager, VP Marketing, and agency leaders
  • Research target accounts, retail media footprints, and stakeholders to personalize outreach aligned to Pacvue's ideal customer profiles
  • Test messaging, sequences, and prospecting approaches, and document what works
  • Use AI tools and workflows, such as Claude or Clay, for account research, personalization, and sequencing
  • Maintain clean, accurate records of activity, opportunities, and handoffs in Salesforce, and manage the AE handoff process end to end
  • Capture objections, competitive intelligence, and market signals to sharpen targeting, messaging, and positioning
  • Proactively share findings and recommendations with Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, and AEs/AMs to shape targeting and messaging
  • Hit and report against core measures: market coverage, lead quality, accepted pipeline, and speed-to-follow-up

Skills & Qualifications:

  • Typically 2+ years of related experience, or a Bachelor's degree with relevant internship/coursework experience
  • Working knowledge of software sales concepts or digital advertising, with the ability to apply Pacvue's ICP and qualification criteria to new accounts with minimal guidance
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, with outreach that feels researched and personal
  • Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills, and curiosity about how businesses make decisions
  • Manage your own account territory and outreach cadence independently, with limited day-to-day direction from your manager
  • Comfort with ambiguity, a high bar for ownership, and a willingness to test and iterate quickly
  • Proficiency with CRM and sales tools. Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, or databases is a plus
  • A record of meeting or exceeding targets, where applicable

Benefits:

  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Paid Holidays and Floating Holidays
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, HSA with employer contribution, Life Insurance and Pet Insurance
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • Take up to 2 Days of Paid Time Off to Volunteer with a 501c Organization
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Company-subsidized membership to Wellhub and Peloton
  • Fertility and family-building information platform through Carrot

The annual base salary range for this position is $55,000-$70,000. The actual base salary will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and market data. This position is eligible to participate in Pacvue’s variable sales compensation plan. For 2027, the annualized target commission opportunity for this role is $36,000-$46,000. Actual commission opportunity may be prorated based on your start date. Variable compensation plans and associated targets are reviewed annually and may be adjusted based on company goals and business objectives. Additional details regarding compensation structure and eligibility will be shared during the recruitment process.

  • Celebrations! We hit our goals and reward ourselves.

The Actuarial Services Director is an important role responsible for actuarial and analytical modeling and forecasting within Privia’s Healthcare Economics department. In partnership with the SVP, Health Care Economics, this leader uses industry standard actuarial and analytics methods and principles to develop and maintain projection models and analyses to guide and inform Privia Health’s VBC strategy. This role requires both a knowledge of healthcare and VBC business models and an aptitude in the analytic tools appropriate for modeling and analyzing business scenarios, including forecasting and sensitivity testing.

Primary Job Duties

  • Use actuarial and analytical methods to analyze business problems and opportunities to inform solutions and strategic direction

  • Develop detailed understanding of value based care and pay for performance programs, including researching of an evolving VBC landscape of program design and regulation

  • Serve as a subject-matter expert on Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) and other government and payer programs. Work to understand the underpinnings of alternate methodologies such as LEAD or MA to inform direction and analysis.

  • Develop and maintain models used to manage the financial considerations of Privia’s VBC portfolio of programs. Use analytic techniques to do complex analysis and sensitivity testing on program financial performance

  • Maintain models and tracking tools for forecasting and projecting current and future year forecasts and performance models. Perform scenario testing and variability analysis of program components

  • Assist with quarterly reporting and auditing of program performance, maintaining accurate and timely completion of regular reporting. Use deep program knowledge to model and forecast performance

  • Develop an understanding of Privia’s partner benchmarking tools and recommend changes or updates as business needs evolve. Use partner tools to assist with new business development opportunities

  • Provide analytical support for VBC-related operations as needed, including cost and utilization, referral network management, and quality improvement initiatives. Advance tool sets and dashboards used.

  • Construction of actuarial and analytic deliverables, including presentations and exhibits, for communicating performance to technical and non-technical audiences

  • Work cross functionally with key stakeholders, within Health Care Economics teams and Privia at large, to influence strategic direction and management

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Advanced degree (FSA/ASA, or PhD/Masters) in a quantitative field such as Actuarial Science, Economics, Statistics, or Finance, with a foundation in healthcare economics. Actuarial credentials preferred but not required.

  • Knowledge and expertise of healthcare claims and related data sources. Understanding of payment methodologies and payer landscape.

  • Expertise and understanding of managed care principles, including VBC program design and performance.

  • 8+ years of experience in financial planning, forecast modeling, and healthcare program evaluation required

  • Expertise in leveraging payer claims and/or EMR data to drive actionable insights and business problem solving

  • Expert understanding of spreadsheet modeling and actuarial model architecture (Microsoft Excel)

  • Proficiency in using coding to manage and summarize large datasets of healthcare claims and encounter data (SQL, Snowflake preferred)

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build analytic deliverables to convey complex findings to diverse audiences

  • Strong strategic thinking, problem solving, and leadership capabilities.

The salary range for this role is $180,000.00-$220,000.00 in base pay and exclusive of any bonuses or benefits (medical, dental, vision, life, and pet insurance, 401K, paid time off, and other wellness programs). Privia Health is committed to creating and fostering a work environment that allows and encourages you to bring your whole self to work. We understand that healthcare is local and we are better when our people are a reflection of the communities that we serve. Our goal is to encourage people to pursue all opportunities regardless of their age, color, national origin, physical or mental (dis)ability, race, religion, gender, sex, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

This work spans cloud and client infrastructure, security, identity, policy and networking, with a strong emphasis on reliability, scalability, interoperability, regulatory compliance and sovereignty.

Your Impact

  • Act as a cross-domain technology leader, translating emerging technology trends into strategic advantage for Cisco.

  • Represent Cisco externally through industry forums, standards bodies, patents, publications, and strategic partnerships.
  • Define and drive the technical strategy for sovereign and disconnected offerings across Cisco’s security portfolio.
  • Architect platforms that deliver consistent security outcomes across cloud, sovereign and on-premises deployments.
  • Embed compliance and sovereignty into platform architecture, enabling Cisco to meet evolving global regulatory requirements at scale.
  • Partner with legal, government affairs and certification teams to anticipate regulatory trends and translate them into strategic advantage.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree with 15+ years of related experience, Master’s degree with 12+ years of related experience, or PhD with 10+ years of related experience, or related expreience, designing and developing large-scale software, platform, or distributed systems.
  • Experience defining and influencing architecture and technical strategy across multiple teams, organizations, or product lines.

  • 8+ years of experience building and scaling highly available, secure, and distributed systems in cloud or hybrid environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven track record of driving company-wide or industry-level technical impact across large, sophisticated organizations.
  • Recognized industry leadership through patents, publications, conference speaking, or contributions to standards bodies.
  • Experience integrating across platform services such as observability, data platforms, AI/ML systems, and security infrastructure.

  • Experience influencing senior leadership, including executives, on technical direction and business strategy.
  • Strong ability to align diverse stakeholders and drive consensus across large, matrixed organizations.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

raw.description:
The Role:

The Senior Managing Accident Reconstructionist leads a team of expert staff in reconstructing vehicular accidents and requires excessive experience in forensic engineering and/or accident reconstruction investigations. This role requires traveling to the site of vehicular accidents, assessing conditions leading to the accident, utilizing specialized software to reconstruct the accidents, working with forensic animators to develop 3D models and other graphics for trial exhibits, accurately analyzing crash patterns, and providing written conclusions to determine factors contributing to the accidents. The ideal candidate has an established network of clientele and is experienced with building, establishing, and maintaining rapport with this network. This is a fully remote role open to candidates located anywhere in the United States. Candidates located in the listed states are encouraged to apply.

In This Role, You Will:

Lead a team of experts in conducting accident investigations by traveling to and documenting accident scenes, downloading vehicle data recorders, performing analysis of accidents using crash simulation software, writing reports as needed and providing litigation support services to clients. Handle large, complex projects and manage all aspects of the project from start to finish. Support business development efforts by building and maintaining rapport with current clients and generating new work for themselves and a team of experts supporting them. Partner with business development representatives, attend conferences and events to promote the company and skills of expert staff. Communicate with clients and team regarding scope of work, investigation tasks, budget, and ensures all project completion timelines, deadlines and deliverables are met. Ensure workload is evenly distributed amongst experts. Mentor, lead and guide a team of experts in all aspects of project work. Provide expert testimony in depositions or trials as expert witness if/when requested. Perform vehicular investigations, including documenting crash scenes, using 3D laser scanners, photography, drones, CDR/EDR download, and measuring devices. Analyze vehicle crush patterns and conducts research (vehicle specifications, crash test data, maintenance history, etc.) Process 3D laser scan point cloud data using engineering workstation computers. Work with forensic animators to develop scaled 3D drawings of crash scenes and vehicles. Utilize PC Crash (or other similar collision reconstruction software) to perform simulations of automobile collisions. Utilize engineering principles and momentum equations to calculate factors such as impact and departure speeds, collision forces, trajectories of the vehicles, and other types of analysis. Compare calculations with crash test reports of similar collisions to correlate damages based on speed and velocity. Create reports as requested by clients detailing the accident reconstruction process and including findings and conclusions. Provide reports to clients to assist with determining the contributory factors of an accident. Act as a team lead and review other staff's work to ensure project deliverables are accurate and timely. Research papers and journals related to vehicular accident reconstruction to advance the scientific techniques used in the reconstruction work.

What You Bring:

Degree in Mechanical Engineering required. 10+ years of experience in biomechanics, accident reconstruction, premises liability, or related work PE license, ACTAR certification, and/or SAE certification Advanced expertise in collision dynamics, including impact and departure speeds, forces, and trajectories  Strong background in automotive engineering and control systems Extensive experience working with insurance carriers, attorneys, and/or adjusters Experience performing computer simulations Highly proficient in CAD Prior deposition and courtroom testimony experience a plus Based in (or planning to relocate to) the job location Enjoys working in a team environment and has a passion for learning Willingness to travel to remote site locations as needed

Who We Are:

YA Group is an international professional services organization providing forensic consulting, engineering, risk mitigation, and related services. Founded over 25 years ago as a property damage consulting firm, YA has expanded through organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Today, YA has over 700 professionals dedicated to excellence, partnership, and driving innovation. YA Group’s Accident Reconstruction & Biomechanics team applies scientific investigation, engineering principles, and advanced technology to determine how collisions occur and why. Our experts bring extensive training and experience using sophisticated tools—including 3D modeling, vehicle and site inspections, Event Data Recorder downloads, and forensic animations—to analyze physical evidence and reconstruct events with clarity and accuracy. Capable of handling the full spectrum of motor vehicle accidents—from low‑speed impacts to complex rollover events, heavy‑truck collisions, autonomous vehicle incidents, and ADAS evaluations—our multidisciplinary specialists deliver analytically grounded findings that support clients across insurance, legal, corporate, and transportation sectors. In addition, our professionals are experienced in litigation support and are courtroom‑qualified experts, providing clear, confident testimony to effectively communicate reconstruction results and technical conclusions.

We Offer:

Employee-focused culture Strong commitment to work-life balance Remote work Flexible vacation & Paid holidays Paid family care/sick leave Parental leave Medical, Dental, Vision + more 401k w/match Career growth Competitive salaries + Bonus

Fraudulent Recruitment Alert:

Please be vigilant against fraudulent recruitment attempts. YA will never ask for personal financial information (such as bank account numbers or identification numbers) via social media or chat-based apps. We also will not request money for the purchase of business equipment, post job opportunities on Craigslist or conduct interviews solely via text message. All official email communications regarding your application will come from or directly from a member of our talent team using an @yagroup.com domain name. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please contact us directly at .

Disclosures:

As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI-assisted tools to support candidate screening and evaluation. These tools are designed to assist—rather than replace—human decision-making, and all employment decisions are made by our recruiting team in accordance with applicable laws and our commitment to equal employment opportunity. Job Title: Solution Consultant - Site Solutions

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. Join our Site Solutions team as a Solution Consultant and use your clinical operations expertise to transform how clinical trials are executed across the industry.
We are looking for a driven self-starter who understands clinical research operations —someone who understands the day-to-day realities of running trials at a site, sponsor, or CRO and is ready to help the industry operate more effectively. This role goes well beyond delivering standard software demonstrations. You will partner closely with Sales, Product, and Strategy to uncover real operational pain points, challenge the status quo, and shape both how we engage customers and how our cloud applications evolve.
In this fast-paced environment, you will engage with diverse stakeholders—from clinical research coordinators and site directors to IT leaders and C-suite executives. Success requires strong situational judgment, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to quickly identify, articulate, and demonstrate the specific business value that resonates with each audience.

What You’ll Do

    • Partner with prospective and existing customers to translate complex operational requirements into viable Veeva Site Solutions
    • Deliver compelling, value-based presentations and product demonstrations tailored to the specific audience, workflow, and business objectives
    • Act as a strategic bridge between the field and our Product and Strategy teams, surfacing real-world site challenges to influence product direction
    • Support existing customers with new initiatives that expand Veeva’s footprint and drive long-term adoption
    • Lead discovery sessions to understand value opportunities and determine solution fit
    • Author clear, solution-oriented responses to RFPs and RFIs
    • Collaborate with Marketing on industry events, webinars, customer videos, and thought leadership initiatives

Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience in clinical research operations (at a site, sponsor, or CRO) or the technical implementation of clinical research systems, paired with deep working knowledge of site workflows, regulatory compliance, and trial execution bottlenecks
    • Proven track record of driving measurable results and proactively improving operational processes rather than maintaining the status quo
    • Strong situational awareness and interpersonal judgment, with the ability to adapt your pace, tone, and messaging to different stakeholders in real time
    • Ability to uncover core business value for an organization and communicate it in clear, credible, and relevant terms
    • Fast, self-directed learner comfortable picking up new software concepts quickly and performing light configuration for demos without a deep technical background
    • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment with shifting priorities and dynamic customer conversations
    • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to engage and influence senior stakeholders
    • Bachelor’s degree
    • Willingness to travel ~20%, primarily within the US

Nice to Have

    • Pre-sales, solutions consulting, or consultative selling experience
    • Experience in clinical site operations within an academic medical center (AMC), health system, cancer center, or site network
    • Hands-on experience with Veeva applications (such as SiteVault or Vault Clinical) or other clinical trial management/SaaS platforms
    • Foundational understanding of SaaS and cloud architecture concepts

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $80,000 - $160,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at .

raw.title: Manager, CCR Analytics
raw.excerpt: About Tala Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority.
raw.description:
About Tala

Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on.

The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.
Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.
Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

The Role

Tala is looking for a Manager, CCR Analytics to lead our analytics team supporting Customer Care and Recoveries (CCR) operations across our Asia-Pacific markets.

In this role, you will lead a team of analysts responsible for turning data into meaningful insights that help our operations teams make better business decisions. You will oversee reporting, identify trends and performance opportunities, and ensure our data is accurate, reliable, and consistent across markets.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you will combine people management, technical expertise, and strong business partnership. You will develop your team, improve how we use data, and build scalable analytics solutions that help Tala operate more efficiently as we grow.

What You'll Do

    Lead and Develop the Analytics Team

  • Manage, mentor, and develop a team of analysts across multiple markets and time zones.

  • Set clear expectations and ensure the team delivers accurate, high-quality analysis.

  • Help analysts grow into independent owners of their respective business areas.

  • Build a collaborative team culture focused on accountability, learning, and continuous improvement.

    • Drive Analytics and Business Insights

  • Partner with Customer Care and Recoveries leaders to understand business challenges and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Analyze operational performance, identify trends, and provide actionable recommendations.

  • Support business planning, forecasting, performance targets, and operational decision-making.

  • Develop measurement strategies and experiments to understand what is working and where improvements are needed.

    • Improve Reporting and Data Quality

  • Own key business metrics and ensure they are clearly defined and consistently measured across markets.

  • Ensure dashboards and reports are accurate, reliable, and easy to understand.

  • Identify and resolve data quality issues before they impact business decisions.

  • Maintain clear documentation so teams can understand and confidently use the data.

    • Build Scalable Analytics Solutions

  • Develop reusable data models and reporting solutions that can support multiple markets.

  • Automate manual reporting processes and reduce reliance on spreadsheets.

  • Build dashboards and self-service tools that allow business teams to access insights independently.

  • Partner with Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering to improve data infrastructure and reporting capabilities.

    • Collaborate Across Teams

  • Work closely with Operations, Product, Data Science, Finance, Engineering, and Analytics teams.

  • Communicate analytical findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Help prioritize analytics projects based on business needs and team capacity.

What You'll Do

  • 6+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.

  • At least 2 years of experience managing or leading an analytics team.

  • Experience using data to influence business decisions and improve operational performance.

  • Experience working with teams across different markets, cultures, and time zones.

  • Background in fintech, lending, collections, credit risk, customer operations, or contact center analytics is a plus.

    • Technical Skills

  • Advanced SQL skills and experience working with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse.

  • Experience with data modeling and transformation tools such as dbt.

  • Experience with BI and reporting tools such as Omni, Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.

  • Working knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation.

  • Understanding of statistics, experimentation, and A/B testing.

  • Familiarity with data documentation, testing, and quality monitoring.

    • Leadership and Communication

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear business recommendations.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present insights to senior stakeholders.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities and lead projects from beginning to end.

  • A hands-on leadership style with a passion for mentoring and developing others.

  • Experience using AI tools to improve analytics workflows is a plus.

    • What Success Looks Like

  • Operations leaders have accurate, reliable data to make informed business decisions.

  • Reporting and metrics are consistent across all markets.

  • Manual reporting is reduced through automation and scalable analytics solutions.

  • Business teams can access the insights they need through self-service dashboards and tools.

  • The analytics team operates efficiently, takes ownership of its work, and continues to grow and develop.

  • Analytics becomes a trusted business partner that helps improve Customer Care and Recoveries performance.

Our vision is to build a new financial ecosystem where everyone can participate on equal footing and access the tools they need to be financially healthy. We strongly believe that inclusion fosters innovation and we’re proud to have a diverse global team that represents a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and experience. We hire talented people regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

raw.description:
At KEM Business Solutions we build relationships focused on understanding our clients' finances and feeling confident about their business's success.

We are a fast-growing bookkeeping firm based in Orlando, Florida, and we are seeking a US Senior Bookkeeper who is ready to join our fun and friendly team. This role suits someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates proactively and wants to grow with us.

Visit our website: ﻿KEM Business Solutions | Your Success is Our Priority﻿

What's on offer:

  • Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 4:30 pm US Eastern Time.
  • Flexible Fridays after the probationary period: 4 of your hours overlap with our team's hours, and the rest can be worked earlier so you finish sooner.
  • Direct hire (not through a BPO).
  • Permanent work-from-home set-up.
  • 10 days of paid leave per year, plus paid Christmas and US public holidays.
  • A structured onboarding and training plan: we train you hand-in-hand and review your work before you take it on independently.
  • Clear expectations from day one, with your progress reviewed on a 30/60/90-day scorecard that recognizes your wins as well as areas to improve.
  • A great team to work with, plus training and career growth, with the opportunity to grow into an expanded role.

Job Summary:

As the Senior Bookkeeper, you will own the bookkeeping for an assigned book of clients, including bank and credit card reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable and payroll. You will be responsible for the completeness and accuracy of your assigned work, while KEM leadership handles review, client advisory and higher-level accounting decisions. Our ideal candidate has solid US bookkeeping knowledge, is highly trainable, works independently and speaks up early when they need help.

What You'll Own:

  • Your book of clients: the bookkeeping processes and workflows for the clients assigned to you, delivered completely, accurately and on time.
  • Accurate records: recording activity to the general ledger consistently and accurately.
  • Client communication: emailing clients directly to clarify what they've sent, what we've received and what is still outstanding.
  • Deadlines: meeting firm deadlines, and flagging to your lead as early as possible if a deadline is at risk.
  • Raising blockers: letting the team know straight away when you're stuck, rather than waiting it out.
  • Teamwork and improvement: communicating effectively with the team and helping improve our processes over time.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Set up bank accounts, online access, and chart of accounts.
  • Reconcile bank and credit card accounts efficiently.
  • Handle transactions like checks and deposits.
  • Correct errors in profit and loss statements.
  • Generate and upload basic financial statements.
  • Manage bills, invoices, payments, and sales receipts accurately.
  • Organize the chart of accounts neatly.
  • Post journal entries for interest and depreciation.
  • Categorize expenses correctly for tax purposes.
  • Process transactions with sales tax and pay taxes.
  • Manage 1099 processing for vendors.
  • Address complex payroll issues.
  • Reconcile gross payroll and taxes.
  • Adjust balance sheets to match tax returns.
  • Process property tax returns accurately.
  • Maintain job costing for project analysis.

How You'll Be Evaluated:

Your performance will be reviewed against a 30/60/90-day scorecard, and the scorecard continues after that. It covers:

  • Accuracy and consistency of your general ledger work.
  • Clear, timely email communication with clients.
  • Effective communication with the team, including raising issues early.
  • Delivery of the clients and workflows you are responsible for.

Skills required:

  • 4+ years of US Public Practice experience in a US bookkeeping or accounting firm (must have).
  • QuickBooks Online experience is a must. Xero experience is a bonus.
  • Experience with, or willingness to learn, our tools: Karbon and ClickUp (practice/project management), Slack and Zoom.
  • Comfortable using a Mac, or willing to learn quickly.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with both peers and clients.
  • Capable of working independently and collaboratively, and confident asking for help when needed.
  • Highly dependable and trustworthy.
  • Exceptionally organized and accountable, with a strong respect for deadlines.
  • Enjoys tackling challenges and is curious to learn beyond the bookkeeping level.
