raw.excerpt: Taking applications from CT, FL, GA, IL, IN, IA, MD, MA, MI, NH, NY, NC, OH, RI, SC, TN, TX, VA We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst to lead testing across the websites, platforms, and campaigns we build for clients.
raw.description:
Taking applications from CT, FL, GA, IL, IN, IA, MD, MA, MI, NH, NY, NC, OH, RI, SC, TN, TX, VA
We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst to lead testing across the websites, platforms, and campaigns we build for clients. You bring 3+ years of QA experience, expertise in WCAG 2.2 accessibility, and a modern automation toolkit.
You will own test strategy for complex Sitecore and Drupal builds, keep our clients ahead of ADA Title II, Section 508, and European Accessibility Act requirements, and use AI tools to make our QA practice faster and more thorough. You will also help us test the AI features our clients are now launching, from chatbots to AI powered search and personalization.

RESPONSIBLITIES:
  • Test strategy and leadership
    • Develop and manage test strategies, plans, and cases for websites, landing pages, emails, banners, and other digital products.
    • Lead QA across multiple concurrent client projects and own release readiness calls.
    • Partner with business analysts, developers, designers, and strategists early in each project to define acceptance criteria and shift testing left.
  • Functional and automated testing
    • Perform manual and automated testing, including functional, regression, integration, cross browser, and device testing.
    • Build and maintain automated test suites (Playwright preferred) and run them in CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
    • Lead regression testing for platform upgrades and migrations, including Drupal 10 to 11 upgrades and Sitecore XP to SitecoreAI (formerly XM Cloud) moves.
    • Run visual regression testing to catch layout and component issues across releases.
    • Validate integrations, forms, and APIs, including CRM connections such as Slate and Salesforce.
    • Verify analytics, tag management, and consent behavior (GA4, Google Tag Manager, cookie consent tools).
    • Monitor performance and Core Web Vitals and flag regressions before launch.
  • Accessibility
    • Conduct accessibility audits against WCAG 2.2 AA using automated tools, manual review, and screen reader testing.
    • Test documents and PDFs for accessibility, along with web pages and mobile experiences.
    • Author VPATs and Accessibility Conformance Reports (ACRs) for clients.
    • Advise teams on remediation and help clients meet ADA Title II, Section 508, and European Accessibility Act obligations.
    • Build automated accessibility checks into CI pipelines so issues are caught on every build.
  • AI in QA
    • Use AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar) to speed up test case design, script writing, and audit documentation, while validating all output.
    • Test client AI features such as chatbots, AI search, and personalization for accuracy, accessibility, and responsible behavior.
  • Reporting
    • Identify, document, and track defects, and work with development teams to resolve them.
    • Deliver clear test reports to internal and client stakeholders covering results, defect status, accessibility conformance, and release readiness.
QUALIFICATIONS:
  1. 1-3+ years in QA, with strong manual and automated testing experience.
  2. Knowledge of WCAG 2.2 and hands on experience finding and remediating accessibility issues.
  3. Working knowledge of ADA Title II, Section 508, and the European Accessibility Act.
  4. Experience testing Sitecore (XP, XM, or SitecoreAI) and Drupal (10 or 11) sites, including headless front ends.
  5. Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript for test automation. Python or Java is a plus.
  6. Experience with modern automation frameworks such as Playwright or Cypress, and running tests in CI/CD.
  7. Experience with accessibility tools: axe DevTools, WAVE, Lighthouse, ANDI, plus screen readers including NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, and TalkBack.
  8. Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira and TestRail.
  9. Practical, responsible use of AI tools in daily QA work.
  10. Understanding of the web development lifecycle, including CMS deployments.
  11. Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain findings to technical and non technical stakeholders.
  12. Ability to influence product, design, and engineering teams on QA and accessibility best practices.
  13. Preferred qualifications:
    1. Accessibility certification: IAAP CPACC or WAS, or DHS Trusted Tester.
    2. QA certification such as ISTQB.
    3. Agency experience supporting multiple clients at once.
    4. Higher education, healthcare, or public sector client experience.
    5. Experience with visual regression tools (Percy, BackstopJS) and device clouds (BrowserStack, LambdaTest).
    6. Experience with API testing tools such as Postman.
    7. Experience testing AI powered features or conversational interfaces.
    8. Experience with PDF and document accessibility remediation.


Compensation Range: We offer a competitive salary based on experience and qualifications. The compensation range for this position is $60,000-$75,000 annually, with potential for bonuses and additional benefits.

raw.description:
Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

Leidos is a Fortune 500® company with nearly $18B in sales and 50,000 employees that brings over 70 years of experience in support of both investor-owned and municipal utility growth goals. Leidos Energy helps utilities address complex challenges through comprehensive, performance-based solutions delivered across the full project lifecycle. Our capabilities include engineering, planning, project management, construction management, and commissioning services for electric power substations, transmission and distribution systems, protection and controls design, and electrification programs. Utilities nationwide rely on Leidos for trusted power industry expertise, demonstrated by our work with more than 75 investor-owned utilities and over 100 municipal and cooperative utilities, as well as a growing portfolio of private developer clients.

Your greatest work is ahead!

Leidos Energy is seeking a Wind Energy Technical Advisor to support Owner's Advisory and Lender's Technical Advisory engagements across onshore and offshore wind projects. You will assess wind turbine technology with a focus on blades and project risk on behalf of developers, owners, investors, and financial institutions. This role pairs deep composites and blade expertise with a strong command of wind turbine systems, and requires clear, defensible technical reporting that supports investment and financing decisions.

Location: Ideal candidate may be remote in the United States or Canada. Main offices are in Framingham/Boston MA, Denver CO, and Greenville, SC for those seeking an office/hybrid environment.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead or support technical due diligence for wind projects on behalf of lenders, equity investors, and owners, covering technology, design, construction, and operations.
  • Evaluate wind turbine technology and OEM track record, with a primary focus on wind turbine blades but also including drivetrain, generator, converter, pitch and yaw systems, controls, towers, and foundations.
  • Assess blade design, manufacturing quality, and field performance, including structural design, layup and bonding, leading-edge erosion, lightning protection, and fatigue life.
  • Review blade damage, repair methodologies, and composite repair procedures (e.g., laminate, adhesive, and coating repairs), and judge long-term effectiveness and cost implications.
  • Analyze failure modes, serial defects, warranty claims, and root-cause findings, and translate them into risk ratings and financial sensitivities.
  • Review wind turbine supply, installation, and service agreements, including warranty terms, availability guarantees, and long-term service agreement (LTSA) provisions, from a technical perspective.
  • Performing independent engineering reviews and preparing reports for financing, root cause analysis, expert witness, etc.
  • Support owner's engineering activities such as OEM selection, factory and site inspections, commissioning oversight, acceptance testing, and end-of-warranty inspections.
  • Evaluate operating and maintenance strategies, spare parts planning, major component replacement forecasts, and lifetime extension or repowering options.
  • Prepare clear, well-supported technical reports and present findings to clients, lenders, and project stakeholders.
  • Contribute to proposals, scopes of work, budgets, and business development.

What does Leidos need from me?

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or related field with five plus years of experience in wind energy.
  • Previous work experience with an independent engineer, developer, wind turbine manufacturer, engineering firm, EPC firm, and/or a wind consultancy.
  • Flexibility to work across wind turbine subsystems and other energy generating technologies.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership in topics related to wind technology and wind systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to summarize complex analyses and topics both in written reports and verbally.
  • Understanding of industry trends in wind turbine and composite technology, analysis methods, and project optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform under pressure both verbally and in writing with a diverse set of clients to include private equity, infrastructure, hedge funds, investment, commercial banks, private developers, legal and financial advisors, original equipment manufacturers, and energy service companies.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform independently and as a team, and to collaborate on complex, multi-disciplinary tasks.
  • Effectively and independently prioritize multiple tasks and schedules.
  • Demonstrated ability to “think outside the box” to develop analysis methods and opinions which meet the unique needs of the client (internal and external).

Favorable if you have:

  • Experience performing independent engineering/consulting services in the wind industry.
  • Understanding of advanced and emerging composite technologies, wind turbine systems, and component loading.
  • Understanding wind turbine suitability, including design/certification and site-specific considerations
  • Understanding of the IEC 61400 standards in the wind industry.
  • Experience with wind turbine blade manufacturing processes including quality systems and audits.
  • Experience climbing wind turbines and holding relevant certification(s).
  • Experience performing independent reviews of wind resource and energy production assessments and associated written reports produced by third parties;
  • Experience developing scopes of work and budgets with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Experience managing projects and clients.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

What You Will Do:


A career within Guidehouse Health will provide you with the opportunity to help our clients transform care delivery and health care operations. We focus on the operations and performance of mission-oriented agencies, academic medical centers and commercial health care enterprises, to plan and drive change that enables best-in-class outcomes.


Guidehouse is seeking an experienced Instructional Designer to support federal healthcare clients to support large-scale, mission-critical programs. As part of our growing Training and Learning Development team, you will help design, develop, and implement innovative learning solutions that support large-scale transformation efforts, operational excellence, and improved outcomes for Veterans and the federal workforce.


As a Senior Consultant, you will work collaboratively with clients, program leadership, subject matter experts, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality training solutions that enable organizational readiness, workforce performance, and successful adoption of new processes, systems, and services. You will contribute across the full training lifecycle—from needs assessment and curriculum development to implementation, evaluation, and continuous improvement.


Successful candidates will bring a passion for adult learning, experience designing engaging learning experiences, and the ability to translate complex information into effective, learner-centered training programs. This role supports a variety of learning modalities, including instructor-led training, virtual instructor-led training, eLearning, webinars, job aids, performance support tools, and blended learning solutions.


Job Description / Responsibilities:


Training Strategy and Analysis


· Support the design, development, deployment, and evaluation of adult professional training solutions using blended learning approaches including web-based, distance-learning, instructor-led, and webinar-based delivery formats, aligned with federal healthcare programs and transformation initiatives.

· Collaborate with clients, subject matter experts, and program stakeholders to assess training needs, analyze target audiences, and identify content gaps.

· Conduct current-state assessments of training materials and recommend improvements to support program goals, learner engagement, and operational readiness.

· Contribute to the development and sustainment of an end-to-end training pipeline, ensuring timely delivery, reduced backlog, and consistent quality across training programs.


Instructional Design and Content Development


· Develop high-quality training products using blended learning approaches, including web-based training, distance learning, instructor-led training, webinar-based training, job aids, performance support resources, reference guides, and other instructional materials that reinforce knowledge retention and on-the-job performance.

· Design curriculum frameworks, structured learning pathways, facilitator guides, participant materials, and reference resources that support learner readiness and performance.

· Apply adult learning theory, instructional systems design methodologies (e.g., ADDIE), and best practices for learner engagement and knowledge retention.

· Collaborate with SMEs and stakeholders to develop, update, and maintain training content aligned with evolving policies, procedures, systems, contracts, and operational requirements.

· Coordinate with eLearning administrators, webinar producers, technical specialists and other cross-functional teams to support training delivery, learner tracking, reporting, and program execution.

· Support the publishing, deployment, and maintenance of training products through the client’s learning platform and webinar technologies.

· Contribute multiple concurrent training initiatives while maintaining quality, consistency, and program timelines.


Evaluation and Continuous Improvement


· Develop and implement evaluation measures to assess learner engagement, training effectiveness, workforce and user readiness, and program outcomes.

· Monitor learner feedback, analytics, and performance data to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and content enhancement.

· Support testing, validation, and quality assurance activities to ensure training materials meet established design standards and federal requirements, including Section 508 accessibility and privacy compliance.

· Maintain and update training materials to ensure ongoing accuracy, compliance, and alignment with current business and operational needs.


What You Will Need:


· Bachelor's in education, instructional design, or related field; or equivalent combination of experience with Instructional Design certification.

· Minimum of (FIVE) 5+ years of experience developing and delivering high-quality training solutions using blended learning approaches, including web-based, instructor-led, distance learning, and webinar formats.

· Demonstrated experience supporting the full instructional design lifecycle, including needs analysis, curriculum design, content development, deployment, evaluation, and maintenance of training programs.

· Strong knowledge of adult learning theory, instructional systems design methodologies (e.g., ADDIE), and evidence-based practices for improving knowledge retention and learner engagement.

· Experience managing multiple concurrent training development efforts and meeting program timelines.

· Direct and substantial experience with Articulate Storyline, RISE 360, Adobe Captivate, or similar eLearning tools.

· Familiarity with federal compliance requirements, including Section 508 accessibility and privacy standards, and experience incorporating these requirements into training development processes.

· Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

· Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams, including SMEs, communications teams, program leadership, and technical specialists.

· Ability to assess training effectiveness through evaluation metrics, analytics, and continuous improvement methodologies.

· Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Department of Defense (DoD), Military Health System, or other federal civilian agencies.

· Familiarity developing training programs for health care providers, care coordination teams, or operational staff.

· Experience supporting webinar production, virtual facilitation, or multimedia training delivery.

· Experience conducting Section 508 testing and supporting accessibility compliance reviews.

· Experience contributing to curriculum design, developing role-based curricula, and performance support tools.

Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


Job Title: Senior Manager, Learning & Enablement

Location: U.S. (remote) - This role may be based in any U.S. time zone. Because the team is globally distributed, regular availability between 6:00-8:00am Pacific Time is required to support EMEA and APAC collaboration.

Department: HR - Talent Development

Reports To: Director of Learning & Enablement


Overview

The Senior Manager, Learning & Enablement leads a small, global team that designs, builds, and delivers learning and capability-building solutions across the business. The role covers enterprise-wide, function-agnostic learning, with occasional support for smaller functions that don’t have dedicated enablement of their own. To be clear on scope, this isn’t a go-to-market or sales enablement role: Genesys has dedicated enablement teams supporting major functions like Product, Sales, and Customer Success.


It’s a hands-on, player-coach role for someone who wants to work alongside a small team rather than set top-down strategy for how learning works across the company. A central part of the role is exploring how AI can actually change the learning experience, things like adaptive paths, simulation-based practice, or AI coaching, tested in small, practical ways. It also means helping instructional designers rethink their own roles as AI takes on more of the production work.


This person approaches the learning experience the way a product manager approaches a product: starting with what the learner needs and how it feels to use, not just whether it follows established learning design theory.


Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership & Capability Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a small global team of instructional designers and learning specialists, setting clear priorities and building a culture of experimentation and accountability.
  • Help the team build new skills as roles and tools evolve, with a focus on judgment, curation, and experience design as AI takes on more of the production work.

Designing the Learning Experience Like a Product

  • Start from what a genuinely good experience looks like for the learner, then figure out how AI and our existing tools can get there.
  • Make the most of the AI and learning tools we already have, looking for new features or approaches that move us toward more personalized or adaptive learning.
  • When new tools emerge for consideration, bring a grounded point of view on whether it adds real value beyond what we already have, partnering with our technical lead and IT as needed.
  • Think through the governance questions that come with AI-generated content, like who can create, who can publish, and how quality gets checked.

Evolving How the Team Works

  • Look at the team's process, from intake through delivery, and figure out with the team where AI or simpler changes can help, without over-engineering a small function.

Enterprise Partnership in a Federated Model

  • Proactively build relationships with practitioners and leaders across the learning and enablement ecosystem to align on design approaches, asset reuse, and ways to reduce duplicated effort, even without formal authority to do so.
  • Build leverage without growing the team by creating things like a facilitator network or self-service tools, especially within HR, to extend the team's reach beyond what it can deliver directly.

Transformation & Functional Enablement Support (Secondary)

  • Provide selective enablement support for broader transformation or functional initiatives, in partnership with Transformation, Change Management, HR, and functional leaders.

Experience

  • 8+ years in Learning and Development, Talent Development, Organizational Development, or similar, with experience changing how learning works, not just producing it.
  • 2+ years managing people, ideally a small, distributed team of learning or talent professionals.
  • Experience using AI to meaningfully change how a team’s work gets done, whether that’s your own team or one you influenced, not just personal productivity habits.
  • Experience evaluating or piloting new AI learning technology, including thinking through value, quality risk, and fit with existing tools.
  • Basic grounding in learning design and adult learning principles, with your real focus on how the learner experiences things.
  • Experience contributing to process improvement or workflow change, inside or outside L&D.

Who You Are and What You've Done

  • You think about the learning experience the way a good product manager thinks about a product: you start with the user and adjust based on real feedback.
  • You're genuinely curious about how AI can change what a learning experience is, and you want to try things, not just discuss them. You can spot what's useful versus what just sounds impressive.
  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and “in the gray.” You don't need a fully defined playbook or delivery model to move forward. As AI and agentic experiences change how learning is designed and delivered, you can form a point of view, test it, learn quickly, and adjust the approach as the business need evolves.
  • You care about L&D enough to do it well, but it's not your identity. You're here to help a small team figure out an open problem, not to be an L&D expert or Instructional Design purist.
  • You're comfortable with and genuinely enjoy a role and team that frequently change shape.
  • You've helped people change how they work, balancing accountability with room to experiment.
  • You’re as comfortable being the face of the work as you are doing the work itself. People across levels trust you, and you show up with presence, not just expertise.


Additional Qualifications That Set You Apart

  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or AI-driven technology company.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-native learning platforms, adaptive learning, or AI coaching.
  • Experience in a lean, resource-constrained team making practical trade-offs.
  • An instructional design or L&D background combined with genuine interest in product thinking.
  • Experience in an actual product role, especially in the HR technology space.

Compensation:

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation range listed below. Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role might also be eligible for a commission or performance-based bonus opportunities.

$133,500.00 - $234,900.00

  • Flexible work schedules and work from home opportunities

  • Development and career growth opportunities

  • Open Time Off in addition to 10 paid holidays

  • 401(k) matching program

Working at Genesys

  • AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year.
  • A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.
  • Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support.
  • Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families.
  • Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work®certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys.

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.


What Happens After You Apply

raw.description:
NVIDIA has helped redefine what computers can do. Now, generative AI is opening new possibilities for how people learn, create, and tackle problems. Realizing that potential means answering some of the hardest questions in AI: Where do models fall short? Which risks are we missing? How do we know our safeguards are working? As an expert in machine learning for Evaluations, you’ll help establish the evidence that guides the next generation of safer AI. Your curiosity and scientific judgment can shape what we test, what we learn, and what we build next.


We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer / AI Researcher / Data Scientist to join our AI Safety and Responsibility efforts within Enterprise Risk Management. Engaging directly in engineering tasks, you will apply your data science and statistics skills. You will turn open research questions into rigorous benchmarks, inventive experiments, and tools that reveal how multimodal large language models behave under pressure. Working with researchers and platform engineers, you’ll connect those discoveries to better training methods and safeguards, with reproducible results that inform technical reviews and executive decisions. If you love asking the question no one has thought to test, and building a convincing way to answer it, come help us define what progress in AI safety looks like.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Safety Benchmarking: Design and maintain safety benchmarks for large language and multimodal models, translating risk scenarios into test cases, datasets, and scoring rubrics.
  • Evaluation Methodology: Define metrics and protocols that assess safety alongside model usefulness, using baselines, uncertainty estimates, and failure analysis to distinguish meaningful improvements from noise.
  • Reproducible Evaluation: Build reusable Python pipelines with versioned datasets, model configurations, and experiment tracking to reproduce results and compare performance across model releases.
  • Automated Red-Teaming: Develop tools to discover failure modes and expand evaluation coverage, incorporating human review to validate automated scoring and provide additional judgment.
  • Failure Analysis: Investigate model failures with researchers, document actionable findings, and develop regression tests to assess whether model changes resolve identified issues.
  • Results and Communication: Partner with platform engineers to store and aggregate evaluation results, and clearly communicate findings, limitations, and emerging risks to researchers and decision-makers.

What We Need To See:

  • Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with 6+ years in the field of machine learning engineering or evaluation.
  • Evaluation Design: Experience developing benchmarks, metrics, and statistically sound comparisons for ML systems, including selecting baselines and interpreting uncertainty. Ability to translate ambiguous evaluation questions into testable experiments.
  • Engineering: Strong Python skills and experience building maintainable shared tools, data pipelines, and experiment-tracking workflows.
  • Analytical Rigor: Ability to assess dataset quality, identify limitations in metrics and scoring methods, and support conclusions with reproducible evidence.
  • Communication: Clearly explain findings and tradeoffs to researchers, engineering partners, and executives.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Evaluation: Experience evaluating LLMs, multimodal models, or agentic systems through adversarial testing or automated red-teaming.
  • Community Contributions: Contributions to public benchmarks or evaluation frameworks.
  • Research Publications: A publication track record and interest in continuing to publish at top tier venues.
  • Human-Aligned Evaluation: Experience validating model-based evaluators against human judgments or designing human-in-the-loop evaluation workflows.
  • Statistical Rigor: Strong model evaluation skills and a commitment to sound statistical practices, including confidence intervals.
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Job Description:

Location: Remote (Midwest Preferred)

Employment Type: Contract

Afinitas is seeking a Contract Sourcing Specialist to help build candidate pipelines for frontline production and manufacturing positions across multiple locations.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys finding talent, engaging candidates, and helping organizations fill critical manufacturing positions. You'll partner closely with our Talent Acquisition team to identify and connect with production employees, skilled trades professionals, and other manufacturing talent needed to support our growing operations.

While this is a remote position, we are seeking candidates located in the Midwest who are familiar with regional labor markets and manufacturing talent pools.

  • Source candidates for production, assembly, machining, welding, maintenance, and other manufacturing roles.
  • Build active talent pipelines across multiple sites and regions.
  • Conduct candidate outreach through phone, email, text, social media, and recruiting platforms.
  • Screen candidates and assess qualifications, availability, and interest.
  • Schedule qualified candidates for interviews with recruiters and hiring managers.
  • Maintain candidate records and sourcing activity within our ATS.
  • Support hiring campaigns, workforce initiatives, and recruiting events as needed.
  • Develop talent pools for recurring and hard-to-fill manufacturing positions.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience sourcing or recruiting for manufacturing, production, warehouse, industrial, or skilled trades positions.
  • Strong candidate sourcing and outreach skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
  • Experience using recruiting technology, job boards, and sourcing platforms.
  • Familiarity with Midwest labor markets and manufacturing talent communities strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting multi-site manufacturing operations is a plus.

Why Join Us

•Flexible contract opportunity.

•Fully remote work environment.

  • Opportunity to partner with multiple manufacturing locations and make an immediate impact.
  • Collaborative team focused on solving hiring challenges and building strong workforce pipelines.
  • Competitive hourly compensation based on experience.

The approximate pay range for this position is $35 - $50/hour. Please note that the pay range is a good faith estimate at the time of posting and may vary based on factors such as experience, skills, and geographic location.

If you're passionate about finding talent and building pipelines that help manufacturing operations succeed, we'd love to hear from you.

raw.description:
Systems & Software, a division of Harris; is seeking a Senior Data and Business Intelligence Engineer who will join the S&S Data Platform & Analytics team.

We are a data-driven organization committed to leveraging information as a strategic asset to improve decision-making, operational efficiency, and business performance of our utility customers. Our Analytics team partners with stakeholders across the organization to develop scalable data solutions that deliver trusted insights and drive measurable customer value.

As we continue to invest in our modern data platform, we are seeking a Senior Data and Business Intelligence Engineer to play a key role in building and evolving our enterprise analytics ecosystem.

The successful candidate will report to the DBA and Analytics Manager.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 1-2 times per year to Vermont/Customer Site/Some other destinations. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. Preference will be given to candidates who can work in EST timezone.

Salary:

80K - 110K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What your impact will be:

  • Design, build, and support enterprise Data Lake solutions from the ground up.
  • Develop scalable ETL solutions and data pipelines.
  • Move and process terabytes of data efficiently.
  • Implement data quality, data governance, metadata, and lineage processes.
  • Develop anomaly detection, monitoring, and alerting capabilities.

What we are looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, professional experience, and demonstrated technical expertise.
  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Business Intelligence Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Proven experience designing and building enterprise Data Lakes, Lakehouses, or analytical data platforms.
  • Strong experience developing enterprise ETL/ELT solutions and scalable data pipelines.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and supporting modern Data Lakehouse and real-time analytics platforms using technologies such as Oracle Database, Debezium, Kafka, Kafka Connect, Apache Flink, Apache Iceberg, Nessie, StarRocks, Spark, Kyuubi, and Power BI. Experience building scalable, reliable data pipelines that support both batch and streaming data workloads is highly desirable.
  • Experience with Change Data Capture (CDC), event-driven architectures, real-time data processing, data cataloging, schema evolution, data versioning, and enterprise-scale ETL/ELT solutions.
  • Experience supporting large-scale data ingestion, transformation, reconciliation, backfill processes, and distributed analytics platforms, including troubleshooting and performance optimization of production data services.
  • Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices using technologies such as Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, and Grafana.
  • Strong experience supporting production Linux environments (Oracle Linux, RHEL, CentOS, or equivalent), including system administration, systemd-managed services, performance tuning, automation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational support of distributed data and analytics platforms.
  • Advanced SQL development, data modeling, and performance tuning skills.
  • Experience with dimensional modeling, semantic-layer design, and analytical data structures.
  • Experience processing and managing large-scale data environments.
  • Hands-on experience implementing data quality, reconciliation, monitoring, and observability frameworks.
  • Experience with metadata management, data lineage, governance, and data cataloging practices.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, alerting, anomaly detection, and operational support processes for production data platforms.
  • Experience supporting enterprise reporting, self-service analytics, and business intelligence solutions that leverage curated datasets, semantic models, and high-performance analytical query engines.
  • Ensure enterprise data platforms and analytics solutions adhere to organizational requirements for the handling of sensitive information, including PII, customer data, confidential business information, and other regulated data types.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership on complex data and analytics initiatives, mentor team members, conduct code and design reviews, and contribute to the development of engineering standards and best practices.

What would make you stand out:

  • Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience supporting modern Data Lakehouse architectures utilizing Oracle Database CDC, Debezium, Kafka, Flink, Apache Iceberg, Nessie, StarRocks, Spark, Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, and cloud-native data platforms.
  • Experience supporting real-time analytics, event-driven architectures, data observability, and large-scale distributed systems is highly desirable.

What we can offer:

  • 3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
  • Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
  • Lifestyle rewards
  • Remote work and more!

About Systems & Software:

Systems & Software, a subsidiary of Harris Computer and part of Constellation Software, has been serving utilities and municipalities since 1973. Headquartered in Vermont, the company provides the enQuesta CIS platform to manage billing and utility operations for electric, water, gas, wastewater, solid waste, and property taxes. Our solutions enable utilities to manage complex rate structures, streamline operations, and enhance customer service, all without the need for custom code or disconnected systems. With cloud-based deployment, SOC 2 Type II certification, and interoperability with meter data systems, GIS, and financial tools, Systems & Software delivers stability, security, and flexibility that utilities can trust. Our commitment to ongoing investment ensures continuous innovation and a strong partnership with our customers across North America.

About Harris:

Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.

raw.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

We're considering Candidates based anywhere in Slovakia.

Job Summary

The Regional Sales Manager partners with our customers to secure their entire digital experience. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. This role is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements.

Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. FLIGHT blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • As aRegional SalesManager, you will be responsible for selling Palo Alto Networks Products and Solutions through Channel Partners and interacting directly with customers in your region
  • Your consultative selling experience will identify business challenges and create solutions for prospects and our customers
  • Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the portfolio of Palo Alto Networks solutions
  • Create clear goals and complete accurate forecasting through developing a detailed territory plan
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meetings

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security industry

  • Demonstrated experience selling complex solutions, value selling, and/or consultative sales techniques, ideally to enterprise accounts in Slovakia

  • Technical aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems

  • Identifies problems, reviews data, determines the root causes, and provides scalable solutions

  • Cultivate relationships with our channel partners to bring a channel-centric go-to-market approach to our customers

  • Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of the full sales cycle and the ability to follow a structured sales process

  • Ability to take a holistic approach to problem-solving by understanding the bigger picture, and considering complex interrelationships and outcomes

  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction

  • English and Slovak language proficiency – strong communication and presentation skills, written and spoken

The Team

Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients in their journey to security.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Would you like to join a company that helps advance science, technology and health?

About our Team

Our Academic & Government team helps our communities accelerate knowledge for a better world by helping to establish, discover and advance knowledge. We do this by turning scientific discoveries into peer reviewed knowledge, hosting the world’s richest corpus of knowledge, allowing users to unlock insights from content and by measuring the quality and impact of research - turning insights into outcomes.

About the Role

As a Contract Manager, Sales, you will support Elsevier's sales contracting activity by preparing, reviewing and negotiating sales contracts, amendments, renewals, order forms, terms and conditions and related legal documents. Support to our Sales will be part of the support. You will be part of a One Team approach, working in close collaboration with Sales, Legal, Account Support and Finance to enable compliant commercial outcomes, strong customer experience and operational efficiency.

This role suits someone who is building and demonstrating a strong contracting profile: technically accurate, commercially aware, responsive and confident using Elsevier templates, policies, toolkits and approval routes. You will be expected to identify deviations from approved positions early, assess contractual risks thoughtfully, and bring practical recommendations rather than only escalating questions.

Responsibilities

  • Reviewing, drafting and negotiating sales contracts and related documents, including order forms, amendments, renewals and customer terms, in line with Elsevier templates, fallback positions, policies, and approval requirements.
  • Supporting Legal and Sales by identifying non-standard terms, missing protections, approval requirements and other contracting risks clearly and early.
  • Applying sound judgment to routine and moderately complex contracting issues, balancing risk with commercial needs and proposing practical ways forward.
  • Managing contract matters proactively from intake through execution, including tracking status, blockers, approvals and next steps.
  • Working closely with Sales, Legal, Account Support, Finance and other internal SMEs to develop, review and finalize contract requirements.
  • Communicating clearly and professionally with internal and external stakeholders, including providing realistic ETAs, concise advice and customer-friendly explanations.
  • Preparing clean, accurate and internally consistent contract documents that reflect agreed services, commercial terms and approved legal positions.
  • Using contract management systems, internal resources and approved AI or productivity tools responsibly to enhance efficiency, drafting quality and stakeholder experience.
  • Identifying recurring issues, process bottlenecks and opportunities to improve templates, toolkits, standardization and smarter ways of working.
  • undefined

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in law or equivalent with 3-5 years of Contract Management, commercial contracting or legal operations experience, preferably in sales contracting, SaaS, licensing, subscription or information services experience.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish; Fluency in Portuguese is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to review agreements systematically against templates, policies and fallback positions.
  • Sound legal and commercial judgment, with the ability to assess issues, make recommendations and escalate with context and proposed solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate contracting issues into clear, action-oriented advice for Sales and other stakeholders.
  • Strong ownership, prioritization and organizational skills in a fast-paced sales environment.
  • Experience with contract lifecycle management tools such as Conga, Luminance or similar platforms is a plus.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, flexible working arrangements, study assistance and access to learning and development resources, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

  • Private Medical, Dental and Vision Plan, coverage for employee and eligible dependents

  • Savings Fund with company matching contributions

  • Comprehensive life insurance policy

  • Grocery voucher

  • Vacation Bonus, salary supplement based on vacation days taken

  • Access to learning and development resources

  • Support for personal and work-related challenges through an Employee Assistance Programme

  • Awards to recognise key service milestones

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society.   • Communicate clearly and professionally via email and phone with a friendly, client-oriented approach.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable with computer systems and quick to learn new applications.

  • 401(k) plan options

  • The opportunity to grow with a dynamic, innovative team in a startup-like culture.
Salary: $26.00 - $31.00/per hour

Job Title

PMO, Program Manager

Job Description Summary

The Senior Program Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing complex programs composed of multiple, interrelated projects to ensure delivery aligns with strategic business objectives, service commitments, and contractual obligations. This role defines and implements program governance, integrates delivery across workstreams, and provides leadership with clear visibility into progress, risks, financial health, and outcomes. Operating independently with urgency and rigor, the Program Manager drives decision-making, resolves program-level issues to closure, and serves as a primary liaison between project teams and executive leadership while setting high standards for quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

  • Own delivery health and oversight for a portfolio of strategic programs, ensuring alignment with business objectives, executive priorities, customer commitments, and defined success criteria.
  • Translate executive priorities into executable roadmaps, delivery strategies, governance models, and resource plans that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Establish, maintain, and continuously improve project and program management methodologies, governance frameworks, operating rhythms, templates, reporting standards, and best practices across the PMO.
  • Provide strategic guidance and support to project managers by helping navigate complexity, mitigate risks, resolve stakeholder conflicts, and overcome delivery challenges.
  • Monitor and proactively manage portfolio-level risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and cross-functional impacts; develop mitigation plans and escalate issues requiring executive attention.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive sponsors and senior leadership by framing options, trade-offs, risks, recommendations, and investment decisions.
  • Lead resolution of the most complex cross-functional risks, issues, conflicts, and escalations to protect business outcomes and maintain delivery momentum.
  • Act as a rapid-response leader for urgent executive initiatives by establishing governance, defining delivery frameworks, facilitating stakeholder alignment, and accelerating execution until dedicated resources are assigned.
  • Champion enterprise-wide initiatives that need a programmatic solution
  • Represent the PMO in executive forums and planning discussions, providing recommendations on portfolio prioritization, resource investments, organizational readiness, and execution strategy.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree is required, MBA is preferred.
  • 5+ years of progressive project, program, portfolio management, or management consulting experience leading complex, enterprise-wide, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Knowledge of commercial real estate, professional services, or service-based delivery organizations preferred.
  • PMP, PgMP, Prosci, Agile/Scrum, or comparable certifications strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience leading PMO functions or enterprise program management.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior leaders, executive sponsors, and cross-functional stakeholders in complex environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly assess situations, establish structure, and provide solutions to drive execution.

We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Manager, Executive Communications to serve as a strategic communications partner to Cisco’s Chief Learning & Future Readiness Officer.

AI is transforming how we work, learn, and build careers. At Cisco, we’re helping people and organizations prepare for that future, from developing the skills of our own workforce to expanding access to education and career opportunities around the world.

As part of Cisco’s People, Policy & Purpose (3P) organization, you’ll help shape and amplify the voice of a senior leader at the center of this work.

You’ll develop executive communications strategies, craft compelling narratives, and support high-profile internal and external engagements. You’ll work closely with leaders across Cisco Learning, corporate communications, and the broader 3P organization to connect business priorities with stories that inform, engage, and inspire.

This role requires more than excellent writing. We’re looking for a strategic thinker, creative storyteller, and trusted advisor who brings sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and the confidence to work with senior executives.

What You’ll Do

Executive Communications Strategy and Counsel

  • Serve as a strategic communications partner to the Chief Learning & Future Readiness Officer, providing thoughtful counsel and recommendations on executive messaging, positioning, and engagement.
  • Develop and execute an integrated executive communications strategy aligned to Cisco Learning’s business priorities and Cisco’s broader corporate narrative.
  • Anticipate communications needs, identify opportunities, and help translate complex business priorities into clear, compelling messages.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior leaders and cross-functional partners to ensure executive communications are coordinated, consistent, and effective.

Storytelling and Content Development

  • Write and develop executive speeches, presentations, talking points, employee messages, articles, social media content, and other communications.
  • Capture and strengthen an authentic executive voice across different audiences, formats, and platforms.
  • Translate complex topics, including AI, learning innovation, digital skills, and workforce transformation, into accessible and engaging stories.
  • Bring creativity, editorial rigor, and strong attention to detail to every deliverable.

External Thought Leadership and Visibility

  • Help develop and execute a thought leadership strategy that positions Cisco Learning leaders as influential voices in conversations about AI, education, skilling, and the future of work.
  • Prepare executive content and briefing materials for industry conferences, speaking engagements, media opportunities, and strategic stakeholder meetings.
  • Collaborate with public relations, analyst relations, social media, and events teams to identify opportunities that advance Cisco’s business priorities.
  • Stay informed about industry developments and emerging issues to recommend timely, relevant communications opportunities.

Internal Communications

  • Lead communications planning and content development for executive town halls, leadership meetings, organizational announcements, and employee engagement.
  • Partner with Cisco Learning leaders to communicate strategy, business progress, organizational priorities, and transformation initiatives.
  • Help employees understand how their work connects to Cisco’s broader strategy and the future of learning.
  • Support communications during periods of organizational change, bringing clarity, transparency, and consistency to executive messaging.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Execution

  • Partner with communications colleagues across 3P and Cisco to align executive messaging, business priorities, and strategic narratives.
  • Independently manage multiple high-visibility communications projects, often with competing deadlines and evolving requirements.
  • Develop strong working relationships with executive stakeholders and their teams.
  • Use audience insights, engagement data, and feedback to evaluate and improve communications effectiveness.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in executive communications, corporate communications, public relations, journalism, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting senior executives and developing high-quality executive communications.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills across a variety of formats and audiences.
  • Experience developing and executing strategic communications plans.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and influence across functions and organizational levels.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in education, learning and development, higher education, digital skilling, workforce development, or related fields is strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting C-suite executives or senior leaders within a global technology company or similarly complex organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop executive thought leadership and support high-profile external speaking engagements.
  • Strong understanding of AI and emerging technologies, particularly their implications for learning, work, and business transformation.
  • Advanced proficiency with generative AI tools, including practical experience using AI to support research, content development, creative ideation, and communications workflows.
  • Experience developing executive social media strategies and content, particularly for LinkedIn.
  • Strong executive presence, sound business judgment, and the ability to provide candid, constructive counsel to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience working in a global, highly matrixed organization.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.

You work with the information security team as a competent and experienced information security and compliance specialist.

How you will contribute

You will assess information security risks in line with internal policy and external best practices, and support security of information and IT assets by testing security systems and applying security standards, policies, and procedures. Under the guidance of global information security lead, you will implement cyber security technology and provide day-to-day business support. If relevant to your role, you will manage third-party providers to ensure that any internal or third-party adhere to standards. You will also provide information security training to appropriate teams.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

  • Information security, compliance and risk management
  • Security solutions and their applicability to Mondelēz International
  • Security strategies, awareness campaigns, policies/standards and governance
  • Communicating effectively with technical specialists, leaders and peers
  • Analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Being a team player by supporting and leading to achieve common goals

Mondelēz International is looking for a Senior Analyst to join its Global Security Operations Center (SOC). You’ll lead incident triage and mitigation, give expert-level analysis on escalated security events and act as the senior technical voice on shift. You’ll also work with stakeholders across the business, mentor junior analysts and help keep the security posture strong as the threat landscape changes.

What you need to know about this position:

  • Triage security alerts and start mitigation efforts
  • Write clear analysis summaries and recommend next steps based on your findings
  • Lead or support containment and response during active security incidents
  • Carry out live response on MDLZ-managed endpoints within permitted access
  • Raise and manage incident tickets in MDLZ’s ticketing systems and escalate them to the relevant teams
  • Work closely with incident management teams across the full lifecycle of an event
  • Act as the escalation point for Level 2 SOC analysts
  • Own mitigation during shift coverage, especially when no manager is present
  • Assign and follow through on containment, eradication and recovery tasks where the SOC doesn’t have direct access
  • Recommend security tooling configurations in line with best practice and enterprise standards
  • Mentor and coach junior analysts, and run technical training sessions for MDLZ Global teams

What extra ingredients you will bring:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • A track record of coordinating across teams during high-pressure incidents
  • Confidence working on your own, including off-hours and with minimal supervision
  • A genuine interest in developing others through mentoring and coaching
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Knowledge of information security, compliance and risk management, plus security strategy, awareness campaigns, policies and governance
  • A team-player mindset, comfortable both supporting others and leading towards shared goals

Education / Certifications:

  • Relevant industry certifications preferred, e.g. GCIH, GCFA, CISSP or OSCP

Job specific requirements:

  • 5+ years’ experience in cybersecurity operations, ideally in a large enterprise SOC
  • Proven experience in incident response, live forensics and security alert triage
  • A strong understanding of EDR, SIEM technologies and common security tooling
  • Experience mentoring or coaching junior team members
No Relocation support available

Business Unit Summary

Mondelēz International in Southeast Asia is in five countries serving 19 markets with more than 18 nationalities and 7,500 employees. This group is emerging as one of the fastest growing regions in Asia, the Middle East and Africa, and we are proud of consistently producing high quality products in nine manufacturing sites. We are market leaders in key snacking categories, making and selling brands like Oreo and Tiger biscuits, Kinh Do mooncakes, Jacob’s crackers, Cadbury Dairy Milk chocolate, Tang powdered beverage, Halls candy and Eden cheese. We set the benchmark in being a responsible business and contributing to the communities in which we operate.

Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.excerpt: Who We Are: Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.
raw.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

We are seeking a Digital Assets Security Engineer to own security for Alpaca's crypto and tokenization products. The scope includes custody and key management, transaction authorization policies, secure engineering for wallets and tokenization, and monitoring of high-risk asset movements.

Several of the largest digital asset thefts in recent years started with a compromised signer, a manipulated signing screen, or social engineering of the people who approve transactions. This role focuses on those paths: who can move assets, under what policy, and what approvers see before they sign. You will work in both the engineering details and the governance around them.

This role reports to the CISO and works closely with the crypto and tokenization engineering teams, Crypto Operations, Compliance, GRC, and the wider Security team.

The Security Team is 100% distributed and remote.

Things You Get To Do:

The core responsibilities of the Digital Assets Security Engineer are focused on custody and key security, transaction authorization and governance, secure engineering for crypto and tokenization, and monitoring and response.

Custody and Key Security:

  • Custody Architecture: Own the security design of wallets, vaults, and signing infrastructure across hot, warm, and cold storage, including MPC and HSM configuration.
  • Key Lifecycle: Set requirements for key generation, backup, recovery, rotation, and destruction. Run or oversee key ceremonies and recovery tests with Crypto Operations.
  • Signing Integrity: Secure the path from a transaction request to a signature, including API credentials, co-signers, approval devices, and what approvers see before they sign.

Transaction Authorization and Governance:

  • Transaction Policies: Review transaction authorization policies, such as Fireblocks TAP, including approval quorums, amount thresholds, destination allowlists, and velocity limits. Recommend changes to Crypto Operations and Compliance, who own and approve them.
  • Change Control: Advise on how changes to policies, admins, signers, and allowlisted addresses are proposed, approved, and applied. Confirm every change leaves a reviewable record.
  • Access Reviews: Review admin, signer, approver, and API user access on custody platforms on a set schedule, and flag access that is no longer needed for removal.
  • Third-Party Risk: Assess custody providers, node and RPC providers, token issuers, and other digital asset vendors with Cyber GRC.
  • Standards and Evidence: In collaboration with the Cyber GRC team, write the security standards for digital asset operations, and provide technical evidence for audits and regulatory exams.

Secure Engineering for Crypto and Tokenization:

  • Design Reviews: Review architecture and code changes for wallet services, custody integrations, blockchain node infrastructure, and tokenization flows. Give engineers clear, practical requirements.
  • Threat Modeling: Threat model minting, redemption, transfers, settlement, and reconciliation between on-chain balances and internal books and records.
  • Smart Contract Review: Review token contracts and issuer controls, such as mint and burn authority, upgradeability, admin keys, and freeze functions, for tokens we support or integrate with.
  • Service Identity and Secrets: Set requirements for how services authenticate to custody platforms, including HSM-backed signing keys, scoped API credentials, and least-privilege service accounts.

Monitoring and Response:

  • Detection: Define alerts for high-risk activity, such as policy and admin changes, new destination addresses, unusual withdrawals, and signer changes. Work with Security Operations to build and tune them.
  • On-Chain Monitoring: Monitor the addresses and contracts Alpaca depends on for suspicious activity, with Security Operations and Compliance.
  • Incident Response: Lead the digital asset side of security incidents, including suspected key compromise, unauthorized transfers, and malicious approvals. Maintain playbooks to freeze, rotate, and recover.
  • On-Call: Participate in the Security on-call rotation after onboarding and cross-training.

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

  • Excited about Alpaca's mission and what we're building
  • 5+ years of experience in security engineering, including 2+ years securing digital asset, crypto, or blockchain systems
  • Hands-on experience with institutional custody, such as MPC or HSM-backed wallets, key backup and recovery, and policy-based transaction controls (Fireblocks,Turnkey, BitGo, Copper, or similar)
  • Experience designing or reviewing transaction authorization policies, including approval quorums, amount thresholds, address allowlists, and separation of initiators, approvers, and signers
  • Working knowledge of how transactions and signatures work on EVM chains and Solana, including token standards, token approvals, nonces, and finality
  • A clear understanding of how digital asset theft happens in practice: signer device compromise, blind signing, social engineering of operators, address poisoning, malicious token approvals, and key exfiltration
  • Able to read code and design documents well enough to challenge implementation choices, with programming experience in Python, Go, TypeScript, Rust, or similar
  • Experience with cloud security, service identity, secrets management, and KMS or HSM
  • Experience writing security standards and producing control evidence for auditors or regulators
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially when explaining risk to engineers, operators, and compliance partners
  • Willing to participate in an on-call rotation

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience securing broker-dealers, exchanges, custodians, money services businesses, or other regulated financial platforms
  • Smart contract security review experience (Solidity or Rust) with tools such as Foundry, Slither, or Echidna
  • Experience with tokenized securities, stablecoins, or on-chain settlement and reconciliation
  • Experience running key ceremonies or designing custody recovery and disaster recovery procedures
  • Experience with blockchain analytics and on-chain monitoring tools
  • Ability to balance security rigor with operational efficiency and business needs

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About The Role

In this role, you will bring Steer to full-service auto repair groups operating 4–10 locations. You’ll lead strategic, consultative sales cycles with multi-unit stakeholders, including owners, regional directors, and heads of operations.

This is a full-cycle hunter opportunity. While a dedicated BDR will bolster your funnel, you will take ownership of building your territory through targeted outbound and driving deals from discovery to signature.

You won't just demo features—you will build business cases rooted in the operator's own financials to prove how Steer drives car count, top-line growth, and shop-to-shop consistency. Your voice in the market will also serve as a critical feedback loop, directly influencing our product roadmap and go-to-market strategy as we scale our mid-market presence.

  • Lead With Business Impact: Tie Steer to the numbers operators care about: car count, average repair order, customer retention, and location-by-location performance.

Must Have

  • Experience closing multi-stakeholder deals and building business cases that win approval
  • Strong discovery skills: you diagnose before you prescribe
  • Proven ability to build your own pipeline
  • Forecasting discipline and strong deal control
  • A builder mentality: you create process where none exists and don’t wait to be told what to do next
  • Direct, plain-spoken communication that earns the trust of business owners

Nice to Have

  • Equity package
  • Flexible PTO with 15 days minimum
  • Generous Parental Leave
  • FSA and HSA options
  • 401(k)
  • Learning Stipend
  • WFH Equipment
  • Chance to work with the latest technology
  • A collaborative, high-ownership culture
  • Opportunities for development and career growth

Why Join Steer?At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.
