raw.title: Product Marketing Manager - Banking & Payments
raw.excerpt: In 1933, Harry Beck introduced a radically different map of the London Underground.
raw.description:
In 1933, Harry Beck introduced a radically different map of the London Underground. Rather than faithfully depicting the geography of London, he simplified the sprawling transit network into clean lines, clear connections, and a system that anyone could navigate. Distances were distorted, angles were standardized, and unnecessary details disappeared. The result was something far more useful than a geographically accurate map: a way for millions of people to understand a complex system and confidently find their way through it.

Beck understood something fundamental. The best way to explain something complicated isn't to show people everything. It's to understand what matters to them and make that unmistakably clear.

At Mercury, we believe great product marketing works the same way. Banking* and payments can be complex, but the value they create for customers shouldn't be. Our job is to understand what people need, find the essence of what we're building, and help customers see how it can make their lives better.

We're a financial technology company building products that help ambitious businesses do more with their money. From everyday banking and payments to international money movement and emerging capabilities like agentic payments, we're making complex financial workflows feel remarkably simple.

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help bring these products to market, communicate their value, and make sure customers discover and use what we're building.

This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, and Revenue. You'll develop positioning, lead go-to-market strategies, drive successful product launches, and identify opportunities to increase adoption and revenue.

We care deeply about craft, but successful product marketing is about more than a beautiful campaign or a well-executed announcement. It's about understanding customers, building an effective plan, and driving meaningful results.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

In this role, you'll:

  • Lead impactful product launches. Own end-to-end go-to-market strategy and execution for new banking and payments capabilities, including emerging agentic features. Develop launch plans, align cross-functional teams, prepare customer-facing partners, and measure impact on product adoption and business goals.
  • Get close to our customers. Build a deep understanding of how founders and finance teams manage money, what challenges they face, and why they choose one financial product over another. Turn these insights into compelling positioning, messaging, and GTM strategies.
  • Execute AI-first. Use AI to work smarter, move faster, and produce better outcomes. You’ll build and use existing workflows, automations, and repeatable processes that improve how you approach research, launch execution, competitive intelligence, and other core responsibilities.
  • Help more customers discover and use Mercury. Partner with Product, Lifecycle, Activation, and Revenue to drive adoption of banking and payments capabilities. Identify growth opportunities, test hypotheses, and improve product usage over time.
  • Become an expert on our market. Develop a sharp understanding of the banking and payments competitive landscape, including emerging fintech products and traditional financial institutions. Translate market insights into differentiated positioning and actionable recommendations.
  • Equip our Revenue teams to win. Build trusted relationships with customer-facing teams and develop the competitive intelligence, battlecards, messaging, and training they need to communicate Mercury's value confidently and accurately.
  • Work with exceptional cross-functional partners. Collaborate with Product, Brand, Creative, Lifecycle, and Revenue to bring go-to-market strategies to life. Help shape strong campaign briefs and channel strategies, drawing on specialized creative expertise when needed.
  • Connect marketing to business impact. Define clear objectives for launches and growth initiatives, track meaningful performance indicators, and communicate what worked, what didn't, and what we should do next.
  • Own the full picture. Manage multiple projects and product areas simultaneously, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and prioritize the work that will have the greatest impact on Mercury and its customers.

You might be a great fit if you:

  • Have 2-3 years of B2B product marketing experience and have taken meaningful ownership of product launches and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Have successfully brought new products or features to market and can explain the business impact of your work.
  • Know how to build a complete GTM strategy, from customer insight and positioning through launch execution, field readiness, and post-launch measurement.
  • Are an AI-native operator who goes beyond using AI for basic tasks. You've built workflows, automations, or systems that meaningfully improve the efficiency or quality of your work and your team's, and you're constantly experimenting with new ways to work better.
  • Are deeply curious about customers and naturally look for the insights behind their behaviors, needs, and decisions.
  • Can translate complex products and capabilities into clear, compelling messaging.
  • Understand that great product marketing extends beyond launches into product adoption, competitive positioning, and revenue growth.
  • Are comfortable using customer feedback, data, and experimentation to evaluate and improve marketing performance.
  • Enjoy working closely with Product, Marketing, and Revenue teams and know how to build trusted relationships across functions.
  • Can manage several competing priorities, make good decisions with incomplete information, and independently move important work forward.
  • Experience in fintech, banking*, or payments is a plus, but it's not required. We're equally interested in people who have done exceptional work in other B2B industries and are excited to learn something new.

Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. Role Title: Principal Research Scientist (Computer Science / Computational Physics)

Role Type: Contractor (flexible, Part-Time or Full-Time)

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Principal Research Scientist (Computer Science / Computational Physics)s to contribute to an advanced customer project at the intersection of computational theory and AI. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. You will work with frontier AI models and agents to tackle open problems, drive research direction, and define standards for scientific breakthroughs. Your insights and rigorous approach will be pivotal in charting what counts as genuine progress within your subfield.

Scope of Work

  1. Identify, frame, and articulate foundational open problems, theoretical bounds, or simulation challenges where verifiable progress can be demonstrated.
  2. Guide AI models and agents in multi-step research processes—ranging from proofs and algorithms to numerical experiments and high-performance simulations.
  3. Critically assess and validate results, utilizing proof checks, computational reproduction, and formal methods to pinpoint the limits of model-generated reasoning.
  4. Evaluate and document the novelty, correctness, and significance of research outputs relative to current literature and established results.
  5. Produce clear, concise research memos detailing research attempts, partial solutions, and observed model limitations or failure patterns.
  6. Advise on research directions, recommending promising subfields and open problems suitable for advancement via AI models and computational tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. 7 - 10+ years of active research in computer science or mathematical/computational physics, with a strong record of scholarly contributions.
  2. Recognition at the field level—such as major prizes, society fellowships, or plenary/invited talks at top scholarly events.
  3. A consistent publication record in leading venues within your domain, with recent results published in the past year.
  4. Demonstrated success resolving named open problems or introducing influential concepts adopted by peers.
  5. Deep, hands-on experience with computational research methods: simulation, numerical analysis, algorithmic implementation, and/or high-performance computing environments.
  6. Proven ability to rigorously examine technical work outside your immediate area of expertise.
  7. Experience on program committees, editorial boards, or with formal research tools (e.g., Lean, Coq, SAT/SMT solvers) is a strong plus, as is a public record of outlining open problems or showcasing research with advanced AI systems.

Alliances & Channels Leader

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We have new senior leadership opportunities in our Global Alliances and Channels organisations, to lead business development and partnership with some of the most important actors in the global technology sector. As the publisher of Ubuntu and a leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, Canonical works across a broad partner ecosystem that includes global system integrators, value-added resellers, regional distributors, independent software vendors, independent hardware vendors, silicon companies, public clouds and other strategic technology brands.

These partners shape the platforms, solutions, marketplaces, hardware and delivery motions through which enterprises adopt open source at scale. We are looking for exceptional partner leaders who can build durable, mutually valuable relationships, develop joint solutions, drive global go-to-market programmes, and convert partner potential into measurable customer impact, revenue growth and market expansion for Canonical.

Opportunities are available for both people leaders and senior individual contributors. In these roles, you will lead, build or scale one or more strategic partner motions for Canonical, either by managing a team or by directly driving high-impact partner initiatives. You will work closely with partners throughout their sales, product, delivery and executive planning cycles to make Canonical their trusted partner for enterprise open source solutions. Depending on your experience and Canonical’s business priorities, your focus may include Channels, GSI, ISV, IHV/OEM, Silicon, Cloud or cross-ecosystem partnerships.

Our Alliances and Channels teams build trusted relationships with partners at executive level, increase Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelise the partnership, and lead business interactions from engineers to CxO level. This role will own strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions across assigned partners or sectors, as well as promotion of partner-related activities, from campaigns, enablement and executive engagement, to strategic opportunities and partner events.

Location: These are globally remote positions.

The role entails

  • Own and drive partner strategy, forecast, bookings and revenues for Canonical across one or more indirect routes to market
  • Lead and evolve a team or strategic partner portfolio towards accelerated revenue growth and market impact
  • Build strategic relationships with global and regional partners at executive levels
  • Design and execute joint go-to-market plans with partners, sales, product management, product marketing and engineering teams
  • Develop partner capability through sales engagement, technical enablement, joint marketing and disciplined business planning
  • Guide our offering from product management, to product marketing, and scale it through the support of our global sales organisation
  • Establish operating cadence, pipeline governance and data-driven accountability across complex partner relationships

What we are looking for in you:

  • 10+ years of experience in alliance, channel, partner, ecosystem or indirect sales management roles
  • Experience in one or more of GSIs, VARs, distributors, ISVs, IHVs/OEMs, silicon, public cloud, marketplaces or strategic technology alliances
  • Deep commercial experience encompassing revenue, margins, pipeline, forecasting and partner economics
  • Proven leadership and presentation skills, with the ability to engage confidently from engineer to CxO level
  • Ability to build trusted executive relationships while aligning product, sales, marketing, engineering and operations teams
  • Insight into open source, Ubuntu, enterprise infrastructure, cloud, AI, security and Canonical’s competition and opportunities
  • Track record of data-driven decision-making and disciplined execution across complex, global relationships
  • An autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.
  • Business level written and spoken English.
  • Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.
  • International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.

In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:

  • Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.
  • Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.
  • Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.
  • Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

raw.description:
Tradewater is on a mission to bend the curve on global warming as quickly as possible, directly combating climate change by identifying, collecting, and mitigating the release of non-CO₂ superpollutants—including old refrigerants, excess halons, and methane. These actions reduce potent greenhouse gases, protect the ozone layer, and generate high-integrity carbon credits that fund and expand our mission worldwide. Our projects also create measurable social and economic value for local communities, creating long-lasting benefits that strengthen economies and improve ecosystems endangering public health.

Targeting superpollutants offers one of the fastest, most cost-effective climate strategies available today. These non-CO₂ gases drive nearly half of all human-caused warming, are exponentially more potent than CO₂, and cannot be removed from the atmosphere once released. Cutting halocarbons and methane delivers bigger and faster climate benefits than CO₂ reductions alone and leading models, from MIT to the IPCC, agree that tackling superpollutants is essential to any credible net-zero pathway. Since 2012, Tradewater has prevented over 12.4 million tons of CO₂ equivalent from releasing into the atmosphere and are on path to prevent at least 30 million tons by 2030. We are committed to bending the curve on global warming as quickly as possible and delivering trusted, measurable, scalable climate impact today.

The Opportunity
The Senior Paralegal, Regulatory and Risk Compliance position is a core legal operations and risk mitigation role supporting Tradewater’s legal function, field operations, and commercial teams. Working closely with the General Counsel and cross-functional teams, this role manages contract workflows, tracks multi-jurisdictional regulatory obligations, and coordinates insurance compliance and risk mitigation across active field sites, contractors, and carbon credit programs.

This position is primarily remote; however, candidates must be available, able, and willing to travel as needed to support operations, diligence, or meetings. Applications for this position will be accepted through December 2, 2026. Please include as part of your application a cover letter detailing your interest and experience with respect to this role.

Key Responsibilities and Duties

Contracts & Transactions
  • Proof and track contractor, plugging service, landowner access, vendor, NDA, and partnership agreements.
  • Maintain contract renewal calendars and insurance/indemnity obligation logs.
Insurance Compliance & Risk Mitigation
  • Track, verify, and support requests for proof of valid Certificates of Insurance (COIs), policy limits, additional insured endorsements, and renewal deadlines for contractors, vendors, operators, and field partners.
  • Coordinate with the Finance Department regarding communication with insurance brokers, risk managers, and operational teams to align coverage with project risks (such as well plugging, site access, environmental/pollution exposure, and commercial activity).
  • Support incident intake, claim documentation, and risk-mitigation tracking to help prevent coverage gaps or compliance lapses.
Legal Operations
  • Support updates to and creation of templates, and support contract management system and playbooks so routine agreements, insurance riders, and filings move quickly.
  • Coordinate with outside counsel at the direction of the General Counsel, track matters, budgets, and invoices, and support records retention.
  • Schedule, prepare, and keep materials organized for the General Counsel.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage technology to improve speed, accuracy, and efficiency.
Regulatory & Compliance Support
  • Support legal and regulatory compliance for halocarbon program and carbon credit sales.
  • Maintain a compliance calendar and tracking system for deadlines, approvals, permits, bonds/financial assurances, and post-plugging documentation.
  • Work with methane program project managers and field operations to keep regulatory and risk files complete and audit-ready.
  • Flag regulatory and compliance changes that affect Tradewater’s projects and share summaries with the General Counsel and program teams.
  • Manage regulatory filings for methane team on state-by-state basis.

Requirements
  • 10+ years of paralegal or legal support experience.
  • 3+ years supporting oil and gas regulatory compliance, land, title, or related work preferred.
  • Associate degree required; bachelor’s degree or paralegal certificate preferred (and/or substantial equivalent experience considered).
  • Regulatory compliance and risk management support experience, including hands-on work with insurance compliance (such as COI tracking, endorsement verification, policy renewals, and risk mitigation workflows).
  • Working knowledge of how state oil and gas regulators operate, including permitting, well records, financial assurances/bonding, and plugging requirements preferred.
  • Strong legal research and drafting skills, with the ability to read and apply statutes, regulations, agency rules, and contractual risk provisions.
  • Experience tracking regulatory and compliance deadlines and filings across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Ability to manage many matters at once and work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Sound judgment and discretion with confidential information.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and contract management tools.
  • Familiarity with environmental regulation, carbon markets, or methane emissions rules is a plus.

raw.description:
About the role

The Services Architect – AI Data Center is the technical services counterpart to the Services Specialist, responsible for translating complex AI Data Center customer requirements into scalable, executable, and commercially sound Professional Services solutions. The role supports the full services pursuit lifecycle—from discovery and scope definition through solution design, estimating, statement of work development, technical closure, and transition to delivery. The ideal candidate understands how large-scale AI Data Center programs are actually delivered across integration centers and customer sites, including rack integration, fiber and structured cabling, infrastructure deployment, cluster bring-up, testing and validation, project/program management, logistics, and lifecycle services.

Annual Compensation: $150K-$200K USD

What you'll be doing

  • Partner directly with the Services Specialist to develop Professional Services opportunities across strategic AI Data Center customers and programs.
  • Lead services discovery sessions to understand customer scope, deployment model, schedule, volumes, site conditions, technical dependencies, and desired outcomes.
  • Translate customer requirements into an end-to-end services architecture, delivery methodology, resource model, assumptions, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
  • Design services solutions spanning integration center activities, onsite deployment, rack integration, fiber/structured cabling, compute/network/storage implementation, testing, validation, and operational handoff.
  • Develop detailed scopes of work, work breakdown structures, labor models, resource plans, skill requirements, schedules, deliverables, and responsibility matrices.
  • Support estimating and pricing by defining labor assumptions, productivity rates, staffing profiles, travel requirements, equipment/tooling, partner content, and delivery risk.
  • Develop scalable delivery models for large multi-site and high-volume AI Data Center programs, including repeatable deployment waves and standardized methods of procedure.
  • Coordinate with Solution Architects across Fiber, Rack Integration, Compute, Network, and Storage to ensure the technical architecture and services scope are fully aligned.
  • Engage Professional Services delivery, RDD, project management, operations, integration centers, supply chain, and partners to validate solution feasibility and capacity.
  • Identify delivery risks, customer dependencies, scope gaps, assumptions, and commercial exposure before contract signature.
  • Support RFQs/RFPs, proposals, customer workshops, technical presentations, SOW reviews, and services solution defense.
  • Own the technical services handoff from presales into delivery and help ensure sold scope, assumptions, financial model, and customer commitments are understood by the execution team.
  • Develop reusable services offerings, reference scopes, estimating models, delivery playbooks, and standardized methodologies for the AI Data Center Business.

Core Services Domains

  • AI Data Center deployment and integration services
  • Offsite rack integration, staging, configuration, and pre-build
  • Onsite rack installation and infrastructure deployment
  • Fiber, structured cabling, patching, testing, and remediation
  • GPU / compute, network, and storage implementation services
  • Cluster bring-up, configuration, acceptance testing, and validation
  • High-density and liquid-cooled infrastructure deployment
  • Project and program management / PMO
  • Site readiness, deployment planning, and mobilization
  • Logistics, material coordination, and deployment sequencing
  • QA/QC, documentation, as-builts, and customer acceptance
  • Day 2, lifecycle, optimization, and recurring services

What you have

  • 7+ years of experience in Professional Services architecture, services presales, data center consulting, infrastructure deployment, technical program delivery, or a related role.
  • Strong background designing and scoping complex technology Professional Services engagements.
  • Experience supporting data center, hyperscale, cloud, AI infrastructure, HPC, or other large-scale infrastructure deployment programs.
  • Strong understanding of how compute, networking, storage, rack integration, fiber, power, cooling, and physical data center infrastructure come together during deployment.
  • Demonstrated experience developing statements of work, labor estimates, resource models, schedules, assumptions, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and responsibility matrices.
  • Ability to translate technical architecture into a practical delivery plan with clearly defined tasks, skills, effort, dependencies, and risks.
  • Experience estimating large field services or Professional Services engagements using productivity assumptions, unit rates, staffing models, and deployment volumes.
  • Understanding of integration center / factory services and the relationship between offsite pre-integration and onsite deployment.
  • Experience with subcontractors, strategic partners, or variable labor models supporting geographically distributed delivery is strongly preferred.
  • Strong commercial awareness, including scope control, change management, margin, risk, utilization, and delivery economics.
  • Strong customer-facing communication, workshop facilitation, technical writing, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to operate across sales, architecture, engineering, Professional Services, RDD, operations, project management, sourcing, partners, and field delivery.
  • AI CSP, hyperscale, NCP / neocloud, HPC, or large cloud infrastructure programs
  • Large-scale GPU infrastructure deployments
  • Rack integration and pre-build services
  • High-volume fiber and structured cabling deployments
  • Data center compute, network, and storage implementation
  • Cluster build, acceptance, validation, and production handoff
  • Liquid-cooled and high-density AI infrastructure
  • Multi-site deployment programs with aggressive schedules
  • Service center / integration center operating models
  • PMO and complex program governance
  • Partner-led and blended workforce delivery models
  • Development of repeatable services methodologies and standardized SOWs
  • Services Architecture – Converts complex customer requirements into a complete and executable Professional Services solution.
  • Scoping & Estimating – Defines the work, resources, effort, assumptions, dependencies, and cost required to deliver successfully.
  • AI Data Center Knowledge – Understands the deployment requirements associated with GPU compute, network, storage, racks, fiber, power, and cooling.
  • Design-to-Deliver Thinking – Ensures the proposed solution can actually be mobilized, executed, tested, accepted, and scaled.
  • Commercial Acumen – Balances customer outcomes with scope discipline, delivery risk, margin, and commercial viability.
  • Customer Engagement – Leads discovery, solution workshops, scope reviews, and technical/commercial services discussions.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership – Connects sales and solution architecture with Professional Services, RDD, operations, partners, and delivery.
  • Standardization & Scale – Builds repeatable service models that can support very large AI Data Center programs.

Measures of Success

  • Services pipeline supported and converted
  • Quality and accuracy of Professional Services solutions and SOWs
  • Accuracy of labor, resource, and delivery estimates
  • Services contribution and margin performance
  • Reduction in scope gaps, delivery surprises, and unplanned change
  • Speed from customer requirement to executable services solution
  • Successful transition from presales into delivery
  • Customer confidence in the proposed delivery model
  • Development and adoption of repeatable AI Data Center service offerings
  • Alignment between Services Specialists, technical architects, and delivery teams

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a services-focused architect who understands both the technical requirements of AI infrastructure and the operational realities of deploying it at scale. They should be able to take a customer requirement or technical architecture and determine exactly how the organization will deliver it—what work must be performed, where it should be performed, what skills and resources are required, how long it will take, what it will cost, and what risks and dependencies must be managed.

This individual should be a strong partner to the Services Specialist: the Services Specialist drives the customer relationship, opportunity, and commercial pursuit, while the Services Architect owns the technical services solution, scope, methodology, estimating inputs, and design-to-delivery integrity.

What you can expect

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. In addition to offering competitive compensation plans and long-term career opportunities, we provide an attractive mix of benefit plans to contribute to your good health, future financial security, and peace of mind.

About us

Computacenter is a leading independent technology partner, trusted by large corporate and public sector organizations. We help our world-renowned customers to source, transform, and manage their IT infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling users and their business. We’re a public company quoted on the London FTSE 250 (CCC.L) and employ over 21,000 people worldwide. In the US, we support some of the country’s best-known businesses with regional hubs in San Francisco and Irvine, CA; Norcross, GA; Plano, TX; and New York City; and Integration Centers in Silicon Valley and Atlanta.

As part of NIQ’s Global Payroll Center of Excellence, the Regional Payroll Director, Americas has end-to-end accountability for accurate, timely, compliant, and controlled payroll delivery across 32 countries and approximately 8,000 employees.

The role leads payroll delivered through in-house, outsourced, and global solutions, including U.S. headquarters and executive payroll, established country operations, and countries transitioning to NIQ’s global payroll platform. It leads a geographically dispersed organization of regional managers, cluster leaders, country teams, offshore resources, and external providers.

Working closely with HR, Employee Experience, Benefits, Compensation, Equity, Finance, Tax, Treasury, Technology, Legal, and Audit, the role drives operational performance, financial integrity, regulatory compliance, vendor accountability, and payroll transformation.

The position also serves as senior regional deputy to the VP, Head of Global Payroll, leading global priorities and escalations when required.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Payroll Delivery and Compliance

  • Own accurate, complete, timely, and compliant payroll delivery across the Americas
  • Lead regional managers, cluster leaders, country teams, offshore resources, and external providers, setting clear priorities and accountability
  • Oversee the payroll lifecycle, including inputs, calculations, approvals, funding, payments, statutory remittances, accounting, and reconciliations
  • Maintain effective governance, controls, procedures, calendars, escalation routes, business-continuity plans, and role coverage
  • Identify and resolve payroll issues, compliance risks, and control gaps through root-cause analysis and sustainable corrective action
  • Apply consistent regional service standards while meeting country-specific statutory requirements

U.S. Payroll

  • Provide leadership and governance for U.S. headquarters and executive payroll
  • Oversee federal, state, and local payroll tax compliance, year-end reporting, employee tax statements, statutory filings, and corrections
  • Ensure appropriate confidentiality, system access, segregation of duties, reviews, and approvals
  • Lead resolution of tax notices, assessments, penalties, amended filings, and government inquiries with payroll providers and Corporate Tax
  • Oversee payroll requirements relating to leave programs, workers’ compensation, unemployment insurance, benefits, taxable benefits, equity, and employee deductions

Payroll Accounting and Financial Close

  • Partner with Record-to-Report and Financial Controllership to ensure accurate and timely period-end and year-end close
  • Oversee payroll journals, accruals, balance-sheet reconciliations, statutory liabilities, accounting interfaces, and supporting documentation
  • Maintain clear ownership and closure plans for aged items, unmatched balances, historical differences, and other payroll-related concerns
  • Investigate material or recurring accounting differences and coordinate resolution across Payroll, Finance, Technology, offshore teams, and providers

People and Vendor Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop payroll leaders and teams, building technical capability, succession readiness, and operational resilience
  • Foster an inclusive culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and employee-focused service
  • Manage payroll providers against contractual obligations, KPIs, SLAs, compliance requirements, and implementation milestones
  • Lead vendor governance and escalations, challenging underperformance and ensuring sustainable corrective action
  • Monitor regional performance and provide concise, evidence-based updates to senior stakeholders

Controls and Transformation

  • Ensure payroll controls are appropriately designed, performed, documented, and evidenced
  • Lead readiness for SOX reviews, internal and external audits, statutory audits, payroll tax audits, and regulatory assessments
  • Oversee country transitions to NIQ’s global payroll solution, addressing payroll, statutory, tax, banking, accounting, data, integration, reporting, and control requirements
  • Protect employee pay, compliance, financial controls, and business continuity throughout each transition
  • Simplify, standardize, automate, and strengthen payroll processes, systems, interfaces, and controls

Required:

  • University degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Human Resources, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience
  • At least 10 years of progressive payroll experience, including significant leadership responsibility for complex, multi-country payroll operations
  • Deep knowledge of U.S. payroll operations, taxation, controls, compliance, and year-end requirements, together with practical Latin American payroll experience
  • Experience managing in-house, outsourced, or co-sourced payroll models and geographically dispersed teams
  • Demonstrated success managing providers against KPIs, SLAs, contractual obligations, and improvement plans
  • Experience transitioning countries to new payroll providers, systems, or global payroll solutions
  • Experience with payroll accounting, financial close, SOX controls, audits, reconciliations, and statutory requirements
  • Strong leadership, communication, influencing, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills
  • Full professional fluency in English and Spanish

Preferred:

  • Experience in a Global Business Services, shared-services, or Center of Excellence environment
  • Experience with Workday, global payroll platforms, payroll middleware, and system integrations
  • Experience in a publicly listed, regulated, or SOX-controlled organization
  • Relevant payroll, accounting, tax, HR, or project-management certification

Measures of Success:

  • Accurate, timely, compliant, and controlled payroll delivery
  • Achievement of regional KPIs and vendor SLAs
  • Successful transition and stabilization of countries on NIQ’s global payroll solution
  • Accurate payroll accounting and timely financial-close support
  • Reduction in aged items, unreconciled balances, control failures, and recurring issues
  • Effective performance and development of regional and vendor teams
  • Timely completion of year-end, audit, tax, and regulatory requirements
  • Improved standardization, scalability, resilience, controls, and employee experience

raw.description:
The Program Director owns the execution and delivery integrity of Sapiens customer programs. This role sits within the Delivery Success team and is the primary accountable leader for program governance, milestone management, and value delivery inside a customer engagement.

The Program Director is a senior delivery leader who brings deep insurance industry fluency, commercial discipline, and the judgment to manage complex, multi-workstream programs with clarity and speed. The role is accountable for ensuring that every milestone is delivered to agreed exit criteria, that every risk is visible before it becomes a crisis, and that the delivery model operates at the pace that shortens time-to-value for the customer.

The Program Director operates an AI-native delivery model in which the execution layer is progressively automated, enabling the role to focus on discernment, governance, and the customer relationship. The role works in close partnership with the Customer Success team, together stewarding the Customer Value Journey – the end-to-end path from implementation through to long-term success and value realization. Commercial outcomes – NRR, ARR, account margin, and customer referenceability – are shared responsibilities.

Job Responsibilities

Program Delivery & Commercial Outcomes:
  • End-to-end delivery ownership: Leads the full program lifecycle from initiation through planning, execution, and closure. Accountable for delivery on time, within scope, and within budget across all workstreams – including platform implementation, integration, data migration, and business change.
  • Time to Value: Owns the pace at which the customer realizes measurable business outcomes from the Sapiens engagement. Defines the time-to-value baseline at program initiation, tracks progress at every milestone, and uses delivery decisions to actively shorten it.
  • AI-led SaaS implementation velocity: Moves programs toward faster implementation cycles consistent with Sapiens’ AI-led SaaS delivery model, applying configuration-over-customization discipline.
  • Commercial Outcomes: In partnership with Customer Success, owns NRR contribution of the customer portfolio, drives expansion levers, and reports against them.
  • Growth: Identifies upsell and cross-sell potential during delivery and converts insight into pipeline opportunities.
  • AI-native execution model: Operates a delivery model in which AI supports execution activities such as status tracking, risk summarization, documentation, and reporting cadence.

Milestone Management & Exit Criteria:
  • Milestone ownership: Defines, manages, and tracks program milestones with clear definitions of done, agreed exit criteria, and formal customer acceptance.
  • Exit criteria discipline: Works with the customer to agree exit criteria at the start of each phase; manages scope through change orders aligned to those criteria.
  • Milestone-based billing alignment: Ensures delivery milestones align with billing triggers and commercial events.
  • Risk and dependency management: Maintains a live program risk register, manages interdependencies across teams, and drives resolution proactively.

Insurance Industry Fluency & Customer Understanding:
  • Insurance domain depth: Develops deep understanding of the customer’s business, operating model, and regulatory environment.
  • Customer relationship ownership: Holds the customer relationship at the program level, including C-suite engagement and trust-based partnership.

Proactive Customer Relationship & Escalation Management:
  • Customer relationship ownership at the program level: Holds the customer relationship at the C-suite level on substance and trust. Is the person the customer calls when something genuinely matters.
  • Proactive escalation management: Anticipates delivery risks and customer concerns, addressing issues before they escalate.
  • Customer Success partnership: Works in close coordination with the Customer Success Manager on the account. The PDCA owns delivery execution; the CS team owns the commercial relationship and expansion trajectory. Together, the PDCA and CS team own the Customer Value Journey – the handoff between these functions is deliberate, documented, and clean. Customer health is a shared metric.

Resource Orchestration & Team Leadership:
  • Cross-functional team orchestration: Manages delivery across blended teams: Sapiens employees, offshore delivery resources, SI partners, and customer-side teams. Ensures alignment, accountability, and pace across all.
  • Team leadership and development: Treats team development as a commercial lever, not an HR task – holding growth conversations early and building capability with intention. Leads the full talent lifecycle with candor and integrity, from onboarding through to role transitions.
  • Sapiens ambassadorship: Carries the Sapiens point of view into customer environments. Knows the Insurance Ontology argument, the AutonomousInsurer thesis, and the AI moat – and can hold them in a room.
  • Project Manager leadership: Directly leads a team of Project Managers across the program. Sets standards, drives accountability, and develops PM capability with intention. The PDCA is the delivery standard-setter on the account – the team performs to the level the PDCA models and demands.

Job Requirements

  • 15+ years of experience leading complex enterprise software programs, including at least 5 years in senior delivery leadership roles.
  • Deep insurance domain knowledge (Life & Pension, Property & Casualty, or equivalent specialty lines), with familiarity in insurance technology platforms.
  • Demonstrated expertise in milestone-based delivery governance, exit criteria design, scope control, and change management.
  • Experience leading global cross-functional teams, including SI partners and offshore delivery resources.
  • AI transformation experience, including use of AI tools across program management and delivery.
  • Strong program financial management skills, including budgeting, forecasting, and cost-to-serve awareness.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive-level presentations.
  • Preferred: Experience with SaaS implementation programs, Scaled Agile (SAFe), or hybrid delivery models; PMP, PgMP, or PRINCE2 certification.
  • Undergraduate degree required; relevant postgraduate qualification is a plus.

Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

About the Role:

Lyra Health is looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager I who is energized by engaging with customers, building relationships, and delivering results. You should be highly organized, detail-oriented, and resourceful. This role will be a great fit for you if you are a doer, who is passionate about making a difference, comfortable with ambiguity, and is naturally collaborative. In this high-visibility role you will be partnering directly with senior benefits leaders and external benefits consultants to shape their workforce mental health strategy on a global scale.   • Contribute to product roadmap planning, providing an important customer and patient voice, and champion new product offerings with your customers

The Role

We’re hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with the world’s leading AI labs and enterprises as a technical research and implementation partner. This role sits at the intersection of applied AI, ML infrastructure, data intelligence, and partner-facing product development.

You’ll help strategic partners define research directions, structure and curate high-quality data, implement ML and evaluation pipelines, and build the agentic systems that extend multi-turn agents and workflows in production.   1. Able to operate independently in ambiguous, partner-facing settings with strong technical and product ownership.

  3. Experience working with LLMs, agentic systems, multi-turn workflows, tool use, RAG, or AI automation.
  4. Built or maintained data pipelines, ML infrastructure, evaluation systems, or research workflows.

raw.description:
Tradewater is on a mission to bend the curve on global warming as quickly as possible, directly combating climate change by identifying, collecting, and mitigating the release of non-CO₂ superpollutants—including old refrigerants, excess halons, and methane. These actions reduce potent greenhouse gases, protect the ozone layer, and generate high-integrity carbon credits that fund and expand our mission worldwide. Our projects also create measurable social and economic value for local communities, creating long-lasting benefits that strengthen economies and improve ecosystems endangering public health.

Targeting superpollutants offers one of the fastest, most cost-effective climate strategies available today. These non-CO₂ gases drive nearly half of all human-caused warming, are exponentially more potent than CO₂, and cannot be removed from the atmosphere once released. Cutting halocarbons and methane delivers bigger and faster climate benefits than CO₂ reductions alone and leading models, from MIT to the IPCC, agree that tackling superpollutants is essential to any credible net-zero pathway. Since 2012, Tradewater has prevented over 12.4 million tons of CO₂ equivalent from releasing into the atmosphere and are on path to prevent at least 30 million tons by 2030. We are committed to bending the curve on global warming as quickly as possible and delivering trusted, measurable, scalable climate impact today.

The Opportunity
The Senior Paralegal, Regulatory and Risk Compliance position is a core legal operations and risk mitigation role supporting Tradewater’s legal function, field operations, and commercial teams. Working closely with the General Counsel and cross-functional teams, this role manages contract workflows, tracks multi-jurisdictional regulatory obligations, and coordinates insurance compliance and risk mitigation across active field sites, contractors, and carbon credit programs.

This position is primarily remote; however, candidates must be available, able, and willing to travel as needed to support operations, diligence, or meetings. Applications for this position will be accepted through December 2, 2026. Please include as part of your application a cover letter detailing your interest and experience with respect to this role.

Key Responsibilities and Duties

Contracts & Transactions
  • Proof and track contractor, plugging service, landowner access, vendor, NDA, and partnership agreements.
  • Maintain contract renewal calendars and insurance/indemnity obligation logs.
Insurance Compliance & Risk Mitigation
  • Track, verify, and support requests for proof of valid Certificates of Insurance (COIs), policy limits, additional insured endorsements, and renewal deadlines for contractors, vendors, operators, and field partners.
  • Coordinate with the Finance Department regarding communication with insurance brokers, risk managers, and operational teams to align coverage with project risks (such as well plugging, site access, environmental/pollution exposure, and commercial activity).
  • Support incident intake, claim documentation, and risk-mitigation tracking to help prevent coverage gaps or compliance lapses.
Legal Operations
  • Support updates to and creation of templates, and support contract management system and playbooks so routine agreements, insurance riders, and filings move quickly.
  • Coordinate with outside counsel at the direction of the General Counsel, track matters, budgets, and invoices, and support records retention.
  • Schedule, prepare, and keep materials organized for the General Counsel.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage technology to improve speed, accuracy, and efficiency.
Regulatory & Compliance Support
  • Support legal and regulatory compliance for halocarbon program and carbon credit sales.
  • Maintain a compliance calendar and tracking system for deadlines, approvals, permits, bonds/financial assurances, and post-plugging documentation.
  • Work with methane program project managers and field operations to keep regulatory and risk files complete and audit-ready.
  • Flag regulatory and compliance changes that affect Tradewater’s projects and share summaries with the General Counsel and program teams.
  • Manage regulatory filings for methane team on state-by-state basis.

Requirements
  • 10+ years of paralegal or legal support experience.
  • 3+ years supporting oil and gas regulatory compliance, land, title, or related work preferred.
  • Associate degree required; bachelor’s degree or paralegal certificate preferred (and/or substantial equivalent experience considered).
  • Regulatory compliance and risk management support experience, including hands-on work with insurance compliance (such as COI tracking, endorsement verification, policy renewals, and risk mitigation workflows).
  • Working knowledge of how state oil and gas regulators operate, including permitting, well records, financial assurances/bonding, and plugging requirements preferred.
  • Strong legal research and drafting skills, with the ability to read and apply statutes, regulations, agency rules, and contractual risk provisions.
  • Experience tracking regulatory and compliance deadlines and filings across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Ability to manage many matters at once and work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Sound judgment and discretion with confidential information.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and contract management tools.
  • Familiarity with environmental regulation, carbon markets, or methane emissions rules is a plus.

The Application Process

Salary & Benefits

The expected annual salary range for a U.S. based candidate is between $90,000-$120,000 USD. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors including relevant experience, other position-related qualifications/skills, geographic location, and business needs.

This position may be based in a variety of locations within the United States. Tradewater’s compensation approach is determined by geographic location as well as relevant experience, qualifications, and skills.

Benefits vary and may include:

  • Multiple paid time away from work offerings; including personal and sick time, parental leave, and company and floating (flex) holidays.

About the role

The Services Architect – AI Data Center is the technical services counterpart to the Services Specialist, responsible for translating complex AI Data Center customer requirements into scalable, executable, and commercially sound Professional Services solutions. The role supports the full services pursuit lifecycle—from discovery and scope definition through solution design, estimating, statement of work development, technical closure, and transition to delivery. The ideal candidate understands how large-scale AI Data Center programs are actually delivered across integration centers and customer sites, including rack integration, fiber and structured cabling, infrastructure deployment, cluster bring-up, testing and validation, project/program management, logistics, and lifecycle services.

Annual Compensation: $150K-$200K USD

What you'll be doing

  • Partner directly with the Services Specialist to develop Professional Services opportunities across strategic AI Data Center customers and programs.
  • Lead services discovery sessions to understand customer scope, deployment model, schedule, volumes, site conditions, technical dependencies, and desired outcomes.
  • Translate customer requirements into an end-to-end services architecture, delivery methodology, resource model, assumptions, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
  • Design services solutions spanning integration center activities, onsite deployment, rack integration, fiber/structured cabling, compute/network/storage implementation, testing, validation, and operational handoff.

Core Services Domains

  • AI Data Center deployment and integration services
  • Offsite rack integration, staging, configuration, and pre-build
  • Onsite rack installation and infrastructure deployment
  • Fiber, structured cabling, patching, testing, and remediation
  • GPU / compute, network, and storage implementation services

What you have

  • 7+ years of experience in Professional Services architecture, services presales, data center consulting, infrastructure deployment, technical program delivery, or a related role.
  • Strong background designing and scoping complex technology Professional Services engagements.
  • Experience supporting data center, hyperscale, cloud, AI infrastructure, HPC, or other large-scale infrastructure deployment programs.

  • Experience estimating large field services or Professional Services engagements using productivity assumptions, unit rates, staffing models, and deployment volumes.
  • Understanding of integration center / factory services and the relationship between offsite pre-integration and onsite deployment.
  • Experience with subcontractors, strategic partners, or variable labor models supporting geographically distributed delivery is strongly preferred.
  • Strong commercial awareness, including scope control, change management, margin, risk, utilization, and delivery economics.
  • Strong customer-facing communication, workshop facilitation, technical writing, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to operate across sales, architecture, engineering, Professional Services, RDD, operations, project management, sourcing, partners, and field delivery.
  • AI CSP, hyperscale, NCP / neocloud, HPC, or large cloud infrastructure programs
  • Large-scale GPU infrastructure deployments
  • Rack integration and pre-build services
  • High-volume fiber and structured cabling deployments
  • Data center compute, network, and storage implementation
  • Cluster build, acceptance, validation, and production handoff
  • Liquid-cooled and high-density AI infrastructure
  • Multi-site deployment programs with aggressive schedules
  • Service center / integration center operating models
  • PMO and complex program governance
  • Partner-led and blended workforce delivery models
  • Development of repeatable services methodologies and standardized SOWs
  • Services Architecture – Converts complex customer requirements into a complete and executable Professional Services solution.
  • Scoping & Estimating – Defines the work, resources, effort, assumptions, dependencies, and cost required to deliver successfully.
  • AI Data Center Knowledge – Understands the deployment requirements associated with GPU compute, network, storage, racks, fiber, power, and cooling.

  • AI-led SaaS implementation velocity: Moves programs toward faster implementation cycles consistent with Sapiens’ AI-led SaaS delivery model, applying configuration-over-customization discipline.
  • Commercial Outcomes: In partnership with Customer Success, owns NRR contribution of the customer portfolio, drives expansion levers, and reports against them.
  • Growth: Identifies upsell and cross-sell potential during delivery and converts insight into pipeline opportunities.
  • AI-native execution model: Operates a delivery model in which AI supports execution activities such as status tracking, risk summarization, documentation, and reporting cadence.

Milestone Management & Exit Criteria:
  • Milestone ownership: Defines, manages, and tracks program milestones with clear definitions of done, agreed exit criteria, and formal customer acceptance.
  • Exit criteria discipline: Works with the customer to agree exit criteria at the start of each phase; manages scope through change orders aligned to those criteria.
  • Milestone-based billing alignment: Ensures delivery milestones align with billing triggers and commercial events.
  • Risk and dependency management: Maintains a live program risk register, manages interdependencies across teams, and drives resolution proactively.

Insurance Industry Fluency & Customer Understanding:

Proactive Customer Relationship & Escalation Management:
  • Customer relationship ownership at the program level: Holds the customer relationship at the C-suite level on substance and trust. Is the person the customer calls when something genuinely matters.
  • Proactive escalation management: Anticipates delivery risks and customer concerns, addressing issues before they escalate.
  • Customer Success partnership: Works in close coordination with the Customer Success Manager on the account. The PDCA owns delivery execution; the CS team owns the commercial relationship and expansion trajectory. Together, the PDCA and CS team own the Customer Value Journey – the handoff between these functions is deliberate, documented, and clean. Customer health is a shared metric.

Resource Orchestration & Team Leadership:

Job Requirements

raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Service Liaison (Marine Corps/Air Force)to support a Department of Defense (DoD) enterprise modernization effort in partnership with the United States Marine Corps Casualty and Mortuary Affairs (CMA) Office. The analyst will serve as a liaison between Marine Corps stakeholders and technical development teams to gather, validate, and translate operational and policy requirements into mission-ready business and data solutions.

This position plays a critical role in aligning business processes, system enhancements, and information management practices with Marine Corps casualty reporting, mortuary affairs, and benefits operations, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and continuity across the enterprise.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary liaison between the Marine Corps Casualty and Mortuary Affairs (CMA) Office and the enterprise modernization team, ensuring all business and functional requirements reflect Marine Corps policies, workflows, and terminology.
  • Lead requirements-gathering sessions, stakeholder interviews, and validation workshops to capture operational needs across casualty reporting, mortuary affairs, and benefits and entitlements.
  • Analyze current-state (As-Is) workflows and develop future-state (To-Be) models that enhance mission performance, accuracy, and interagency coordination.
  • Develop and maintain traceability documentation, ensuring Marine Corps requirements are fully represented in system enhancements, user stories, and design documentation.
  • Collaborate with data architects and developers to design data interfaces and integration points between Marine Corps personnel systems and enterprise case management platforms.
  • Validate Marine Corps processes for compliance with DoDD 1300.22, DoDI 1300.18, and other relevant DoD casualty and mortuary affairs standards.
  • Facilitate user acceptance testing (UAT) and stakeholder validation sessions to confirm system functionality and data accuracy.
  • Provide input for mission performance analytics, developing dashboards and reports to track case volume, timeliness, and data integrity for Marine Corps leadership.
  • Support continuous improvement by incorporating user feedback and operational lessons learned during testing, deployment, and sustainment.
  • Stay informed of policy, procedural, and system changes that impact Marine Corps casualty and mortuary operations to ensure alignment across modernization efforts.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement:

  • Must hold an active Secret clearance.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Experience:

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in requirements management, stakeholder engagement, or business analysis for federal or defense programs, including at least 3 years supporting DoD or service-specific operations (Marine Corps experience preferred).

Technical Knowledge:

  • Demonstrated expertise in business process modeling, requirements elicitation, and functional design documentation.
  • Experience working within Agile or iterative development environments.
  • Proficiency with business intelligence (BI) and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau for mission reporting and analytics.
  • Familiarity with DoD casualty operations, mortuary affairs, and personnel system integration.
  • Knowledge of secure cloud environments and data interoperability principles is desirable.

Certifications (Preferred):

  • Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) or PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA).
  • ITIL Foundation or Lean Six Sigma certification.
  • Agile or Scrum Master certification.

Skills:

  • Strong communication, facilitation, and documentation skills across technical and operational audiences.
  • Ability to coordinate across diverse stakeholder groups and service components.
  • Analytical thinker with attention to compliance, data quality, and mission outcomes.
  • Commitment to iterative improvement, collaboration, and excellence in service delivery.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

The financial industry is growing at a record pace, but our data providers are still stuck in the past — with cumbersome onboarding processes, complicated APIs, slow infrastructure, and expensive licensing costs.

Databento is the market data platform for modern finance. The company provides real-time and historical data across futures, options, and equities through a unified API. By owning the entire market data stack end-to-end, Databento is the first platform of its kind to combine the performance and reliability demanded by the world's leading trading firms with a dramatically simpler developer experience. Our team includes alumni of Two Sigma, Citadel Securities, Flow Traders, IMC, Tower Research, Jump Trading, HRT, Jane Street, and SIG.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to make institutional-grade market data easy to use for everyone, from individual developers to large financial institutions. We grow through our product, so design matters at every stage of the user journey: discovery, onboarding, activation, and team-wide adoption. You'll shape experiences across our web app, docs, and new developer workflows.

You'll take on two types of work, from the blank page to the last pixel. The first is new features and initiatives. You'll take loosely defined problems from framing to launch, from how people find and access our data to how teams manage licenses, and help shape new business initiatives that take Databento into new markets, products, and customer segments. The second is high-stakes refinements. A routine update, like expanding our market coverage, can ripple across docs, the web app, and marketing pages. You'll refine these surfaces so every update is clear and leaves no room for confusion.

This is a high-ownership role on a small team. When a project doesn't have a PM, you'll step in to define the problem and move the work forward.

Responsibilities

  • Lead complex, ambiguous design projects from problem definition through launch and iterationAlign cross-functional stakeholders and drive decisions when the path forward isn't clear
  • Balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints to make pragmatic design calls
  • Use product analytics (Amplitude, PostHog) to understand behavior, validate decisions, and measure what you ship
  • Work closely with engineers so what ships matches what was designed
  • Contribute to our design system and help raise the bar across a growing design team
  • Step into PM responsibilities when needed: scoping problems, writing specs, and driving work through to launch

Requirements

  • 5+ years in product design, ideally on API, developer, data, or B2B SaaS products, including account, billing, and licensing workflows (e.g. Stripe, Twilio, Plaid, Vercel, Supabase)
  • A track record of independently driving complex projects with unclear requirements
  • You define the problem before solving it and make decisions with clear rationale and explicit trade-offs
  • Strong visual and interaction craft for dense, technical content: typography, hierarchy, motion, and information density
  • A high bar for detail, even on unglamorous work and under tight deadlines
  • Clear communication: you explain design rationale in plain language to engineers and executives alike
  • AI fluency: you bring AI tools into your process with your own judgment and deliver high-quality work efficiently
  • Based in or able to work in North American time zones

Nice-to-haves

  • Fintech or market data knowledge
  • Working front-end skills (HTML/CSS/JS)
  • Data fluency: comfortable reading product analytics and pulling your own answers from SQL databases with the help of AI tools
  • Experience working as a PM or stepping into the role when a project needs one

Please include a portfolio or website in your application, if possible.

We offer health, dental, disability, and life insurance benefits, as well as 401(k) matching for full-time employees. We accommodate 100% remote work, with teammates living around the globe and paid in their local currency.

The base salary range for this role is $95,000–$185,000, benchmarked to Tier 1 locations in each country. Total compensation may also include bonuses, commissions, and equity, depending on the role.

Notice about phishing scams

Be cautious of phishing scams impersonating Databento that offer fake job interviews and request purchases. Official emails come only from @databento.com or us.greenhouse-mail.io (our ATS). Any other domains (e.g., databento-careers.com, databento.online) are fraudulent.

--

We comply with federal, state, and local nondiscrimination laws in every location where we operate. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leave, compensation, and training. About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit . Come join us.

Duration: 6 month contract (potential to extend contract and/or become full time)

About the Team:

The Global Talent Acquisition team is a high-performing group of recruitment subject matter experts who are committed to building strong partnerships with candidates as well as our internal stakeholders across the globe. We strive to provide exceptional, reliable recommendations and service, while fostering a flawless candidate experience. We value creativity, free-thinking/ideation as well as collaboration. It is our belief that bringing diverse perspectives and experiences together provides a strong foundation for both personal and professional growth and development.

About the Role:

You will join a fast-growing global Talent Acquisition team responsible for full-cycle recruitment of the best talent in the market as we build and scale AlphaSense. As a TA Coordinator, you'll work alongside an established team of coordinators and recruiters, providing the administrative and operational support that keeps the candidate experience running smoothly at all times.

This is a launchpad role, not a destination. We're looking for someone early in their career with a genuine passion for becoming a recruiter. We'll invest in your development through hands-on exposure to the full recruiting lifecycle, mentorship from our recruiters, and training, with the goal of growing you into a Talent Acquisition Specialist.

Who You Are:

  • Passionate About Recruiting: You're genuinely excited about a career in talent acquisition and see this role as your first step toward becoming a recruiter. You're curious about what makes a great hire, how great teams are built, and what makes candidates say yes.
  • Eager to Learn and Grow: You're hungry for feedback and mentorship, and you'll take full advantage of the training and tools available to advance your career at AlphaSense.
  • Exceptional Communicator: With strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills, you engage warmly and professionally with a high volume of candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers, and serve as an approachable, positive point of contact for everyone you work with.
  • Organized and Detail-Oriented: You excel at creating and documenting processes that keep your team consistent and efficient, and you have a sharp eye for detail, ensuring candidate-facing communications are polished and error-free.
  • Driven, Adaptable, and Accountable: You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, bring a sense of urgency and strong follow-through, and take ownership of projects with a creative, entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Trustworthy and Tech-Savvy: You handle sensitive information with integrity and discretion, and you're proficient in Google Suite (Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Docs). Experience with ATS systems, particularly Greenhouse, is a plus.

What You’ll Do:

  • Provide administrative support to the Talent Acquisition team, such as posting job openings, sending offer letters, pulling reports, organizing Google Drive, editing presentations, etc.
  • Correspond with candidates throughout the entire interview process, including scheduling phone/video interviews, sending out case studies/assignments, managing candidates in our Applicant Tracking System (Greenhouse) and providing updates to the team.
  • Become a Greenhouse power-user and assist in the management and administration of the system so that our team can be efficient, consistent, and have accurate data at all times.
  • Partner closely with our team of coordinators and recruiters to learn and improve upon our existing programs and processes.
  • Build your recruiting skills by shadowing recruiter calls and intake meetings, supporting sourcing and resume review, and gradually taking on pieces of the recruiting process as you grow.
  • As needed, collaborate with the people operations team to ensure a seamless transition from candidate to employee, and ensure that everyone has what they need for new hire orientation.

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered equity, and a generous benefits program.

Compensation Range
$27—$30 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @ email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.
