Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

Role Overview:

The Account Management (AM) Mid-Market role is newer within the Customer Success organization at Apollo.io. We are looking for someone who can thrive with a high level of ambiguity and change while maintaining a customer centric approach at scale. In this role you will act as the primary and often sole point of contact for a Tier 1 / Tier 2 Mid Market customer portfolio and will be responsible for continuous activation and use case expansion across your book of business.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Close Incremental Business Opportunities: Identify and close expansion opportunities within Tier 1/Tier 2 Mid Market accounts.
  • Drive Value and Growth: Conduct virtual meetings, including enablement and product activation sessions and business reviews, to drive value and growth with customers.
  • Portfolio Ownership: Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail, taking ownership of customer situations and seeing them through to resolution.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.

Core Competencies:

  • Customer-Centric Mentality: Balance customer needs with business objectives.
  • Product Aptitude: Enthusiastically explore product capabilities to drive usage and adoption.
  • Revenue Mindset: Proven ability to generate pipeline and close revenue through upsell, cross-sell, and upgrades.
  • Curiosity: Eagerness to learn about sales tech, customer business models, and industry trends.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with internal teams to achieve mutual success.

Qualifications:

  • 4-5 years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, preferably in product-led growth environments.
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting monthly or quarterly revenue targets.
  • Experience in developing a 3x pipeline through a blend of inbound leads and targeted account planning.
  • Comfortable identifying additional use cases and expansion opportunities.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with customer success, support, marketing, legal, and product teams.

Goals & Activity Expectations:

  • Achieve Monthly Revenue Targets: Consistently meet or exceed monthly revenue targets as a fully-ramped account manager.
  • Generate 3x Pipeline Coverage: Develop and maintain a pipeline that is three times the coverage needed, based on a 40% win rate.
  • Account Plans Development: Create detailed account plans for the top 20% of your book of accounts, focusing on growth strategies and potential opportunities.
  • Drive Product Activation: Conduct in-depth analysis of accounts' current usage to identify opportunities for product activation and increased adoption.
  • Schedule Customer Meetings: Conduct at pace (pre determined) customer meetings per week to engage with and understand customer needs and opportunities.
  • Deliver on Account Touches: Make at pace (pre determined) account touches per week to ensure consistent and proactive customer engagement.

The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity; company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; at least 10 paid holidays per year, flex PTO, and parental leave; employee assistance program and wellbeing benefits; global travel coverage; life/AD&D/STD/LTD insurance; FSA/HSA and medical, dental, and vision benefits.

Pay Transparency Range
$200,000—$210,000 USD

We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

raw.excerpt: About 2hourglass 2hourglass is a fast, mobile window and door glass repair company based in Pennsylvania.
raw.description:
About 2hourglass

2hourglass is a fast, mobile window and door glass repair company based in Pennsylvania. Our technicians go to the customer's home or business and fix broken glass, foggy (failed-seal) glass and window hardware on site, often the same or next day. About 80% of our work is residential and 20% commercial.

Our promise is in the name: speed and certainty. Customers send a photo, get a price, and we fix the one window they need. We don't push them to replace five. That approach has earned us roughly 1,300 five-star Google reviews.

Our biggest opportunity is the homeowners who don't know their window can be repaired at all, so they live with it. Our new website is live. Over the next 6–12 months we're improving its conversion, sharpening our Google and Facebook ads, and launching email and SMS follow-up. Over the next 2–3 years we want a marketing machine that runs without depending on the founder. This role is the first step toward that.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a results-driven, hands-on person to join our team. The role is remote, part-time, and headquartered in Pennsylvania (US Eastern time).

The role

As our Marketing Coordinator, you'll plan, coordinate and carry out our marketing across the website, Google Ads, Facebook/Meta, email, SMS and reviews. You'll be our first and only in-house marketing person.

You'll work directly with the founder. He sets the strategy and big-picture goals; you own the day-to-day execution and keep projects moving. We also work with an outside marketing coach, so you'll have a clear plan and support.

Hours

Starts at 20 hours/week, with potential to grow toward full-time

Location

Remote; overlap with US Eastern business hours required

Reports to

Founder

Pay

[$25–35/hour] depending on experience

You'll need to organize, plan and structure your own workload. We don't have the time or the inclination to micromanage. You'll get a lot of freedom and a lot of responsibility.

What you'll do

  1. Website performance and metrics (top priority). Our new website is live. Track how it and our Google Ads landing pages perform (traffic, bounce rate, calls and quote requests) and make the adjustments the numbers call for: copy, offers, reviews and calls to action. Keep each county and service page current and working.
  2. Paid ads coordination. Support our Google Ads (people ready to book now) and Facebook/Meta ads (people who don't know repair is possible). Brief and manage ad creative, and work with any outside agency or freelancer.
  3. Content and social media. Plan and run a content calendar that teaches homeowners their broken, foggy or sticking windows can be repaired. Create, schedule and post content, reply to comments, and repurpose content across channels.
  4. Copywriting. Write and edit copy for the website, ads, emails, SMS and social posts in a clear, friendly, local-business voice.
  5. Email, SMS and CRM. Build and manage welcome, follow-up and reactivation campaigns in our CRM (Close). Re-engage stalled leads and past customers.
  6. Reviews and social proof. Turn our ~1,300 five-star Google reviews into marketing assets. Keep our Google Business Profile active and fresh.
  7. Offers and referrals. Help launch and promote a low-cost entry offer and simple referral and repeat-customer programs.
  8. Tracking and reporting. Maintain a weekly marketing dashboard: leads by source, cost per lead and per job, landing-page performance and ad return. Flag what's working and what isn't.
  9. Project management. Create and keep project timelines, manage freelancers and vendors, and make sure campaigns ship on time.
  10. Coordination with the team. Work with the founder and office team so marketing, lead follow-up and scheduling stay aligned.

Your first 90 days

By day 90, we should see clearly which marketing produces booked jobs, and the website should be converting better than at your start.

Timeframe

What success looks like

Days 1–30

You know our services, customers, brand and tools (Close CRM, website, ad accounts). Our weekly marketing dashboard is up to date. Stalled leads from Facebook have been followed up.

Days 31–60

You've set a baseline for website and landing-page conversion and made a first round of data-driven adjustments, such as stronger use of our reviews and the "send a photo, get a price" offer. A content calendar is running on Facebook.

Days 61–90

Website and landing-page conversion has improved against the day-30 baseline. Welcome and reactivation email/SMS sequences are live. The entry offer and a referral program are launched. You present a monthly results report to the founder.

What we're looking for

The six non-negotiables

  • Copywriting. You'll write for the web, ads, email, SMS and social media. Your writing must be excellent, and we'll ask for samples.
  • Tech-savvy. You don't need to be a technical expert, but you pick up new tools fast: CRMs, website builders, ad platforms, email tools and AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity.
  • Project management. You set deadlines, keep them, and move several projects forward at once.
  • Self-starter. Goals will be clear. Often it'll be up to you to decide what needs to happen, when and how, and then do it without being chased.
  • Teachable and coachable. We do marketing differently, and there's a lot to learn on the job. We hire mainly on attitude.
  • Leadership potential. You'll start as our only marketer. As you hit goals, we expect this role to grow into leading a small marketing team.

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing a local or home-services business (trades, cleaning, HVAC, roofing, real estate)
  • Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager or Google Business Profile
  • Experience with Close or a similar CRM, and with email/SMS automations
  • Basic design skills (Canva or similar) and basic video editing
  • Comfort with dashboards and numbers (Looker Studio, Airtable, Google Sheets)

Perks of the job

  • Fully remote, with flexible hours you set around US Eastern business hours
  • Starts at 20 hours/week, with potential to grow to full-time
  • Real ownership: your work goes live fast and you'll see its impact on booked jobs
  • Hands-on marketing and management experience, with coaching from an experienced marketing team
  • Pay: [$25–35/hour depending on experience]

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Commercial Account Executive, Mid-Market, you’ll be the primary point of contact for prospective and existing customers in our mid-market segment, helping organizations modernize how they plan, build, secure, and ship software with GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll own a broad book of business in your territory and serve as a strategic, trusted advisor to your accounts as you prospect, run complex sales cycles, and guide customers on their journey with GitLab to achieve clear business outcomes while supporting adoption and reducing churn. You’ll collaborate closely with Sales Development, Solutions Consultant, Renewals, Partners, and Sales leadership, using value-based selling and structured sales methodologies (such as MEDDPICC and Command of the Message) to build a healthy pipeline, run accurate forecasts, and support revenue goals across a wide range of deal sizes.

Must be located in East or Central timezones in the US.

What you’ll do

  • Own and manage a broad Mid-Market book of business as the primary point of contact in your territory, focusing on new and expansion opportunities.
  • Focus on customer accounts with 250 to 1,999 employees, managing the spectrum of project sizes and complexity within the mid-market segment.
  • Articulate the value of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform to Mid-Market prospects and customers, tailoring messaging to their business and technical needs.
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through consistent prospecting, qualification, and advancement of opportunities, using structured methodologies (such as MEDDPICC and Command of the Message) to support your pipeline and revenue goals.
  • Document buying criteria, decision processes, next steps, and key stakeholders to run disciplined, well-orchestrated sales cycles.
  • Collaborate with sales development, customer success, renewals, marketing, technical teams, and partners to deliver a cohesive pre- and post-sales experience, co-sell and close opportunities, and expand GitLab’s footprint while delivering added value for customers.
  • Support customer adoption of GitLab solutions, proactively work to reduce churn and contraction, and participate in quarterly forecasting and territory planning.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing win/loss insights, updating the sales handbook, and being a clear voice of the customer into the product via our public issue tracker.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience selling SaaS solutions by leading value-based conversations with technical and business stakeholders, ideally including development or DevSecOps teams.
  • Ability to manage a broad mid-market territory as the primary point of contact, owning a book of business from prospecting through close, adoption, and expansion.
  • Skill in building and maintaining strong customer relationships, including effective discovery, negotiation, and closing to support long-term customer outcomes.
  • Comfortable driving consistent outbound prospecting activity, creating and maintaining a healthy pipeline, and maintaining accurate territory and forecast documentation.
  • Ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional partners (sales development, customer success, renewals, marketing, partners, and technical teams) to coordinate account strategies.
  • Clear and structured communication skills, including presenting the GitLab value proposition to different audience levels and documenting customer insights and lessons learned.
  • Interest in GitLab, open source, and tools that support software development, with the ability to connect customer business challenges to GitLab’s DevSecOps platform.
  • Willingness to travel to meet customers and attend events as needed, and openness to bringing relevant, transferable sales experience from a variety of backgrounds.

About the team

The Commercial Account Executive - Mid-Market role sits within GitLab’s broader Sales organization, focused on helping mid-market customers adopt and expand their use of our AI powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll be part of a distributed team of Account Executives, Sales Development, Solution Consultants, Renewals, and Partners who work asynchronously across regions to manage a broad book of business and a wide range of opportunity sizes. Our mission is to guide customers through their journey with GitLab, from first evaluation to long term value realization, by developing new business, strengthening customer relationships, and supporting healthy product adoption. We collaborate closely through shared playbooks, our sales handbook, and GitLab itself to stay aligned on territory plans, pipeline health, and best practices. For more on how we work, see the Commercial Account Executive Handbook.

Remote-Global

raw.description:
Position Summary...

The Director, Supply Chain Management is responsible for developing and implementing supply chain strategies, optimizing processes, and managing major projects to ensure efficient operations and superior customer experience across all channels.

What you'll do...

The Director, Supply Chain Management oversees the design and implementation of end-to-end supply chain planning capabilities, infrastructure, and technology programs, managing annual budgets exceeding $100M. This role develops new tools and processes to optimize flow, inventory, capacity, service, and cost across the supply chain, leveraging global relationships and best practices while using data, analytics, and scenario modelling to inform strategic decisions.

This position leads a team responsible for creating and validating integrated supply chain plans and forecasts, aligning logistics, replenishment, store operations, and eCommerce activities. The Director also manages strategic activities such as seasonal and promotional flow plans, collaborating with 3PL partners and internal teams to balance customer availability, operational capacity, inventory, speed, and cost-effectiveness.

The Director develops supply chain strategy and leads major transformation initiatives, ensuring strong execution, financial governance, and regulatory compliance. The role coordinates cross-functional teams, evaluates end-to-end business trade-offs, oversees progress against strategic objectives, and drives continuous improvement across the supply chain network.

Additionally, the Director develops and maintains critical external partnerships, improves the end-to-end customer experience, and integrates planning and operational processes across the broader supply chain to enhance speed, quality, availability, and cost. This position plays a vital role in the strategic alignment, transformation, and operational excellence of the end-to-end supply chain network.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, Operations, Finance, Analytics, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in supply chain, retail operations, logistics, replenishment, or planning, including significant people leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end supply chain planning and strategy, connecting demand, inventory, transportation, distribution center capacity, store operations, and eCommerce to deliver business and customer objectives.
  • Strong expertise in integrated planning, forecasting, inventory and flow management, capacity planning, and network optimization, with the ability to translate long-term growth into actionable supply chain plans.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale transformation and technology initiatives, including planning platforms, automation, advanced analytics, and/or AI-enabled capabilities, while managing significant budgets and complex programs.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, with experience using scenario modelling, business cases, and financial analysis to optimize trade-offs across service, availability, inventory, capacity, productivity, cost, and ROI.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across complex, cross-functional organizations, including Merchandising, Replenishment, Supply Chain, Transportation, Store Operations, eCommerce, Finance, Technology, suppliers, and external partners.
  • Strong people leadership and executive communication skills, with demonstrated success building high-performing teams, developing talent, leading through change, and influencing senior-level decisions.

Leadership Expectations:

Respect the Individual:

Builds high-performing teams; seeks, and embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas and experiences; creates a workplace and experiences where all associates feel seen, supported and connected through culture of belonging so associates thrive and perform; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all.

Creates a discipline and focus around developing talent through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; builds the talent pipeline, fosters an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work, empowers associates and partners to act in the best interest of the customer and company, and regularly recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments; supports strategies and drives initiatives that attract and retain the best talent.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively and cross-functionally to achieve objectives; and communicates and listens attentively, with energy and positivity to motivate, influence, and inspire commitment and action.

Acts with Integrity:

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by taking action to advance opportunity, sustainability, community, and integrity (e.g., creating fair opportunities for associates and suppliers, driving local giving efforts).

Ensures that teams follow the law, our code of conduct and company policies; promotes an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns, and models our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action, and enables others to do the same; holds self and teams accountable for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Acts as an altruistic servant leader and is consistently humble, self-aware.

Serve our Customers:

Delivers expected business results while putting the customer first and consistently applying an omni-merchant mindset and acting with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a holistic perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans and implementing strategies.

Strive for Excellence:

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions, and fosters an environment that supports learning, innovation, learning from mistakes, and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Drives continuous improvements, supervises the adoption of new technology, and supports digital disruption in line with Walmart’s business model.

raw.description:
The Role

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Power Platform Support, Testing & Deployment Engineer to join our growing technology team.

This role will focus on ensuring the stability, quality and successful delivery of Microsoft Power Platform solutions across both client and internal environments.

You will act as a key bridge between users, developers and project teams, providing application support, coordinating testing activities, managing deployments and helping to maintain high-quality Power Platform solutions.

The ideal candidate will have strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with experience supporting business-critical applications built on the Microsoft Power Platform.

Job Details

Work set up: Work from home

Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8 AM to 5 PM | UK Time

Holiday: Will follow UK holidays

Key Responsibilities

Application Support & Incident Management

  • Provide 1st and 2nd line support for Power Apps, Power Automate and Power Pages solutions.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot and resolve application incidents, defects and user-reported issues.
  • Analyse root causes of recurring issues and work with development teams to implement permanent fixes.
  • Monitor solution health, performance, integrations and automation processes.
  • Maintain support documentation, knowledge base articles and troubleshooting guides.
  • Liaise directly with business users and clients to manage support requests and expectations.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Create and maintain test plans, test cases and test scripts for new and existing solutions.
  • Coordinate and execute functional, regression, integration and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Identify, log, track and verify defects through to resolution.
  • Support development teams in validating fixes and enhancements prior to release.
  • Ensure solutions meet business requirements and quality standards before deployment.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes and quality assurance practices.

Deployments & Release Management

  • Support the planning, coordination and execution of deployments across Development, Test, UAT and Production environments.
  • Manage Power Platform solution packaging and deployment using established release processes.
  • Validate deployed solutions and perform post-deployment verification activities.
  • Assist with release documentation, deployment schedules, rollback plans and change records.
  • Support change management and ensure releases are delivered with minimal business disruption.
  • Work with development teams to improve deployment automation and DevOps practices.

Platform & Process Improvement

  • Analyse business processes and identify opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency and user experience.
  • Assist in documenting functional requirements for enhancements and change requests.
  • Support governance, security and compliance activities across Power Platform environments.
  • Keep up to date with emerging Power Platform features, best practices and Microsoft's release roadmap.

About You

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Experience supporting business applications within Microsoft Power Platform environments.
  • Knowledge of Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse and Microsoft 365 technologies.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills.
  • Experience executing software testing and managing defect lifecycles.
  • Understanding of application deployment and release management processes.
  • Experience creating and maintaining test documentation and support procedures.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritise workloads and manage multiple support and testing activities simultaneously.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Experience with Azure DevOps.
  • Understanding of CI/CD practices and deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams and Dynamics 365.
  • Knowledge of Power Platform administration and environment management.
  • Understanding of SQL, APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience working within ITIL, support or service management environments.
  • Exposure to automated testing methodologies and test management tools.

Personal Attributes

  • Customer-focused, with a strong commitment to service quality.
  • Methodical and process-driven approach to work.
  • Self-motivated, with a desire to learn and develop technical skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment supporting business-critical applications.
  • Strong team player who can collaborate effectively across support, development and project teams.

raw.description:
Ready to accelerate your career?

Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.

Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we’re building toward that vision every single day.

Join us and you’ll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them.

We’re looking for a Product Manager (Payments) that will help to shape, build and scale our Payments products within our B2B SaaS Platform. This role blends hands-on product execution with strategic product leadership. You’ll spend meaningful time acting as a product owner, writing stories, curating backlogs, and running refinements, while also owning customer discovery, competitive intelligence, and product strategy as part of our Product team.

This role reports directly to the VP of Product and works closely with Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Sales, Support, Marketing, and Executive Leadership.

What You'll Be Doing

Product Strategy & Discovery

  • Align customer needs, business objectives, and technical constraints as part of our product strategy.
  • Conduct regular customer and user research through interviews, feedback analysis, and usage data.
  • Navigate multi-persona product experiences for complex B2B customers.
  • Perform competitive and market intelligence to inform roadmap decisions and positioning.
  • Translate company-level strategy into clear product initiatives and outcomes.

Product Execution (Product Owner Responsibilities)

  • Own and prioritize the product backlog in close partnership with Engineering.
  • Write clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Lead backlog grooming and sprint refinement sessions.
  • Collaborate daily with Engineering and Design to ensure high-quality delivery.
  • Make pragmatic tradeoffs between scope, speed, and quality.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Support, Sales, and Marketing.
  • Act as a clear, credible product voice with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support go-to-market efforts by aligning roadmap priorities with customer and revenue needs.
  • Communicate plans, progress, and tradeoffs effectively to leadership.

What You'll Bring

Required Experience

  • 2-5 years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS environments. Experience in Payments or FinTech is preferred.
  • Hands-on integration and partnership experience with various technology providers.
  • Experience building multi-persona B2B products with complex workflows.
  • Strong experience balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Experience acting as a Product Owner within Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Strong technical fluency (APIs, system concepts, tradeoffs—even if you don’t code).
  • Solid understanding of UX and design principles; comfortable collaborating deeply with designers.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to tie product decisions to revenue, retention, and growth.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized, self-directed, and accountable.

Nice to Have

  • Proven success helping scale products or companies from roughly $10M to $100M ARR (or similar growth stages).
  • Experience with B2C or consumer-grade product experiences.
  • Experience working closely with Support or Operations teams.
  • Experience in regulated or compliance-heavy industries.
  • Experience building internal tooling or platform-style products.

Why this role is Compelling

  • High influence over product direction.
  • Direct partnership with senior leadership.
  • Opportunity to shape both the product as the company scales.
  • Meaningful exposure to customers, strategy, and execution—not just one slice of product work.
  • A team culture that values collaboration, clarity, and doing the right thing for customers.

Why you’ll love working at Cardata:

We’ll be honest — Cardata isn’t for everyone. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take extreme ownership, and constantly push yourself (and your work) to be the best, you’ll fit right in.

You’ll be surrounded by driven teammates who genuinely care — about the work, about our customers, and about helping each other succeed. Together, we take on ambitious goals and celebrate the wins along the way.

What we offer in return for you bringing your best:

  • Remote work and flexible working hours
  • Mentorship and development opportunities (to help you achieve your career goals!)
  • Extended medical & dental benefits
  • Healthcare spending account
  • $3,000 annual Health and Wellness Spending Account to support your overall wellbeing
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • Flexible (Unlimited) Time Off: No annual cap on vacation, supported by a trust-based, flexible approach to time away.

Cardata is an equal opportunity employer. All candidates will be equally considered without regard to race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, language, citizenship, creed, religion, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, physical and/or mental handicap or financial ability. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to bring their authentic selves to work.

If you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know.
